-- [ SAFE PARENT GUI HELPER ] --
local function safeParentGui(gui)
    if not gui then return end
    local success = false
    if gethui then
        success = pcall(function()
            gui.Parent = gethui()
        end)
        if success and gui.Parent then return end
    end
    success = pcall(function()
        gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end)
    if success and gui.Parent then return end
    pcall(function()
        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer or LocalPlayer
        if lp then
            gui.Parent = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) or lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        end
    end)
end

-- ================================================================================
-- [ XENON STARTUP LOGO & PURPLE AURORA BOREALIS INTRO SPLASH ]
-- ================================================================================
-- [ XENON STARTUP: ЧЕРНЫЙ ФОН + РЕАЛИСТИЧНОЕ СЕВЕРНОЕ СИЯНИЕ + ЛОГОТИП + АВТО-ОТКРЫТИЕ GUI ]
-- ================================================================================
-- [ XENON STARTUP: ЧЁРНЫЙ ФОН + ЭМБЛЕМА + НЕОНОВОЕ КОЛЬЦО ЗАГРУЗКИ (2 СЕК) ]
-- ================================================================================
local function spawnXenonStartupAurora()
    task.spawn(function()
        local splashGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        splashGui.Name = "XenonStartupSplash"
        splashGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        splashGui.DisplayOrder = 999999
        splashGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true -- НАСТОЯЩИЙ ПОЛНЫЙ ЭКРАН (ПЕРЕКРЫВАЕТ ТОПБАР ROBLOX НА 100%)
        splashGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

        safeParentGui(splashGui)

        -- 1. ЧИСТЫЙ ГЛУБОКИЙ ЧЁРНЫЙ ФОН НА ВЕСЬ ЭКРАН
        local blackBackdrop = Instance.new("Frame")
        blackBackdrop.Name = "BlackBackdrop"
        blackBackdrop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 100, 1, 100)
        blackBackdrop.Position = UDim2.new(0, -50, 0, -50)
        blackBackdrop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        blackBackdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        blackBackdrop.BorderSizePixel = 0
        blackBackdrop.ZIndex = 1
        blackBackdrop.Parent = splashGui

        -- Мягкое неоновое фиолетовое свечение позади логотипа
        local auraGlow = Instance.new("Frame")
        auraGlow.Name = "AuraGlow"
        auraGlow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        auraGlow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 360)
        auraGlow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -30)
        auraGlow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 70, 255)
        auraGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
        auraGlow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        auraGlow.ZIndex = 2
        auraGlow.Parent = blackBackdrop
        Instance.new("UICorner", auraGlow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local auraGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        auraGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(225, 120, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(150, 45, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(70, 0, 160))
        })
        auraGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, 0.3),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.7),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, 1.0)
        })
        auraGrad.Parent = auraGlow

        -- 2. ЦЕНТРАЛЬНЫЙ ЛОГОТИП (XENON TRIANGLE WINGS EMBLEM)
        local logoAsset = nil
        pcall(function()
            if writefile and (getcustomasset or getsynasset) then
                local getAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
                local fileName = "xenon_emblem_logo.png"
                if not isfile or not isfile(fileName) then
                    local b64 = ""
                    local raw = nil
                    pcall(function()
                        if crypt and crypt.base64decode then raw = crypt.base64decode(b64)
                        elseif crypt and crypt.base64 and crypt.base64.decode then raw = crypt.base64.decode(b64)
                        elseif base64_decode then raw = base64_decode(b64) end
                    end)
                    if not raw then
                        local b64chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
                        local chars = {}
                        for idx = 1, #b64chars do chars[b64chars:sub(idx, idx)] = idx - 1 end
                        chars["="] = 0
                        local out = {}
                        local buf, bits = 0, 0
                        for idx = 1, #b64 do
                            local c = b64:sub(idx, idx)
                            local v = chars[c]
                            if v then
                                buf = buf * 64 + v
                                bits = bits + 6
                                if bits >= 8 then
                                    bits = bits - 8
                                    table.insert(out, string.char(math.floor(buf / (2^bits)) % 256))
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        raw = table.concat(out)
                    end
                    writefile(fileName, raw)
                end
                logoAsset = getAsset(fileName)
            end
        end)

        local mainCard = Instance.new("Frame")
        mainCard.Name = "MainCard"
        mainCard.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        mainCard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 320)
        mainCard.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        mainCard.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        mainCard.ZIndex = 3
        mainCard.Parent = blackBackdrop

        local logoImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        logoImage.Name = "LogoImage"
        logoImage.Size = UDim2.new(0, 185, 0, 205)
        logoImage.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -92, 0, 10)
        logoImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        logoImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        logoImage.ImageTransparency = 1
        if logoAsset then
            logoImage.Image = logoAsset
        else
            logoImage.Image = "rbxassetid://9069609268"
            logoImage.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 220, 255)
        end
        logoImage.ZIndex = 3
        logoImage.Parent = mainCard

        local titleText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        titleText.Name = "TitleText"
        titleText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        titleText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 225)
        titleText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        titleText.Text = "X E N O N"
        titleText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 235, 255)
        titleText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        titleText.TextSize = 19
        titleText.TextTransparency = 1
        titleText.ZIndex = 3
        titleText.Parent = mainCard

        -- 3. НЕОНОВОЕ КОЛЬЦО ЗАГРУЗКИ (SPINNER LOADING RING)
        local spinnerFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        spinnerFrame.Name = "SpinnerRing"
        spinnerFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        spinnerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 34)
        spinnerFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 278)
        spinnerFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        spinnerFrame.ZIndex = 3
        spinnerFrame.Parent = mainCard
        Instance.new("UICorner", spinnerFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local spinnerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        spinnerStroke.Name = "SpinnerStroke"
        spinnerStroke.Thickness = 2.8
        spinnerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(195, 95, 255)
        spinnerStroke.Transparency = 1
        spinnerStroke.Parent = spinnerFrame

        local spinnerGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        spinnerGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(235, 140, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(175, 65, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(100, 20, 210))
        })
        spinnerGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, 0.0),   -- яркая светящаяся голова кольца
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, 0.85),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, 1.0)   -- прозрачный хвост кольца
        })
        spinnerGrad.Parent = spinnerStroke

        -- Плавное появление логотипа и кольца загрузки
        TweenService:Create(logoImage, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            ImageTransparency = 0
        }):Play()

        TweenService:Create(titleText, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            TextTransparency = 0.05
        }):Play()

        TweenService:Create(spinnerStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Transparency = 0
        }):Play()

        -- Вращение кольца загрузки и мягкое дыхание ауры
        local startTime = os.clock()
        local isAlive = true

        local spinConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not isAlive or not splashGui.Parent then return end
            local t = os.clock() - startTime

            -- Высокоскоростное плавное вращение неонового кольца (360 град/сек)
            spinnerFrame.Rotation = (t * 420) % 360

            -- Мягкое дыхание ауры позади эмблемы
            local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 3.5)
            auraGlow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340 + (pulse * 30), 0, 340 + (pulse * 30))
            auraGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85 + (pulse * 0.08)
        end)

        -- 4. РОВНО 2 СЕКУНДЫ ЗАГРУЗКИ (КАК ПРОСИЛ ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЬ)
        task.wait(2.0)

        isAlive = false
        if spinConn then spinConn:Disconnect() end

        -- 5. БЫСТРОЕ И ПЛАВНОЕ РАСТВОРЕНИЕ (~0.45 сек)
        local fadeOut = TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

        TweenService:Create(blackBackdrop, fadeOut, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(logoImage, fadeOut, { ImageTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(titleText, fadeOut, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(spinnerStroke, fadeOut, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(auraGlow, fadeOut, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()

        -- 6. СРАЗУ ПОСЛЕ ЗАГРУЗКИ ПОЯВЛЯЕТСЯ CLICKGUI
        task.delay(0.45, function()
            if SETTINGS and SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui and not SETTINGS.IsClickGuiOpen then
                pcall(SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui)
            end
        end)

        task.wait(0.55)
        pcall(function() splashGui:Destroy() end)
    end)
end
task.spawn(spawnXenonStartupAurora)

-- [ PLAYER / THIRD PERSON НАСТРОЙКИ ] --
local defaultCameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
pcall(function()
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    if lp and lp.CameraMode then
        defaultCameraMode = lp.CameraMode
    end
end)

local playerSettings = {
    ThirdPerson = false,
    MaxZoomDistance = 1000,
    MinZoomDistance = 0.5,
    CustomZoom = 15
}

local thirdPersonLoop = nil

local function updateThirdPersonCamera()
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    if not lp then return end

    if thirdPersonLoop then
        thirdPersonLoop:Disconnect()
        thirdPersonLoop = nil
    end

    if playerSettings.ThirdPerson then
        lp.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = playerSettings.MaxZoomDistance or 1000

        local targetDist = playerSettings.CustomZoom or 15
        lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = targetDist
        task.delay(0.12, function()
            if playerSettings.ThirdPerson and lp then
                lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = playerSettings.MinZoomDistance or 0.5
            end
        end)

        thirdPersonLoop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not playerSettings.ThirdPerson then
                if thirdPersonLoop then
                    thirdPersonLoop:Disconnect()
                    thirdPersonLoop = nil
                end
                return
            end
            if lp.CameraMode ~= Enum.CameraMode.Classic then
                lp.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
            end
            local targetMax = playerSettings.MaxZoomDistance or 1000
            if lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance < targetMax then
                lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = targetMax
            end
        end)
    else
        -- [ ПОЛНЫЙ И МГНОВЕННЫЙ ВОЗВРАТ В 1-Е ЛИЦО (FTAP DEFAULT) ] --
        lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
        lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 0.5
        lp.CameraMode = defaultCameraMode or Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson

        task.delay(0.08, function()
            if not playerSettings.ThirdPerson and lp then
                lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
                lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 0.5
                lp.CameraMode = defaultCameraMode or Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
            end
        end)
    end
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    if playerSettings.ThirdPerson then
        updateThirdPersonCamera()
    else
        pcall(function()
            LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 0.5
            LocalPlayer.CameraMode = defaultCameraMode or Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
        end)
    end
end)

-- [ НАСТРОЙКИ TRAIL (ШЛЕЙФ ЗА ИГРОКОМ) ] --
local trailSettings = {
    Enabled = false,
    Rainbow = false,
    Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 50),
    Lifetime = 0.7,
    Width = 1.6,
    Transparency = 0.25
}

local activeTrail = nil
local trailAtt0 = nil
local trailAtt1 = nil

local function updateTrailVisuals()
    if not activeTrail then return end
    activeTrail.Lifetime = trailSettings.Lifetime
    activeTrail.Width0 = trailSettings.Width
    activeTrail.Width1 = 0.05
    activeTrail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, trailSettings.Transparency),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
    })
    if not trailSettings.Rainbow then
        activeTrail.Color = ColorSequence.new(trailSettings.Color)
    end
end

local function applyPlayerTrail()
    if not trailSettings.Enabled then
        if activeTrail then
            pcall(function() activeTrail:Destroy() end)
            activeTrail = nil
        end
        if trailAtt0 then
            pcall(function() trailAtt0:Destroy() end)
            trailAtt0 = nil
        end
        if trailAtt1 then
            pcall(function() trailAtt1:Destroy() end)
            trailAtt1 = nil
        end
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    if not activeTrail or not activeTrail.Parent then
        if trailAtt0 then pcall(function() trailAtt0:Destroy() end) end
        if trailAtt1 then pcall(function() trailAtt1:Destroy() end) end

        trailAtt0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        trailAtt0.Name = "CardinalTrailAtt0"
        trailAtt0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.7, 0)
        trailAtt0.Parent = hrp

        trailAtt1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        trailAtt1.Name = "CardinalTrailAtt1"
        trailAtt1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.2, 0)
        trailAtt1.Parent = hrp

        activeTrail = Instance.new("Trail")
        activeTrail.Name = "CardinalPlayerTrail"
        activeTrail.Attachment0 = trailAtt0
        activeTrail.Attachment1 = trailAtt1
        activeTrail.FaceCamera = true
        activeTrail.LightEmission = 0.75
        activeTrail.LightInfluence = 0
        activeTrail.Texture = "rbxassetid://258128463"
        activeTrail.Parent = hrp
    end

    updateTrailVisuals()
end

local function cleanupTrail()
    if activeTrail then
        pcall(function() activeTrail:Destroy() end)
        activeTrail = nil
    end
    if trailAtt0 then
        pcall(function() trailAtt0:Destroy() end)
        trailAtt0 = nil
    end
    if trailAtt1 then
        pcall(function() trailAtt1:Destroy() end)
        trailAtt1 = nil
    end
end
getgenv().CleanupCardinalTrail = cleanupTrail

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    if trailSettings.Enabled then
        applyPlayerTrail()
    end
end)

-- Анимация радужного трейла
local trailRainbowHue = 0
local trailConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if trailSettings.Enabled and trailSettings.Rainbow and activeTrail and activeTrail.Parent then
        trailRainbowHue = (trailRainbowHue + dt * 0.45) % 1
        local c1 = Color3.fromHSV(trailRainbowHue, 0.9, 1)
        local c2 = Color3.fromHSV((trailRainbowHue + 0.35) % 1, 0.9, 1)
        activeTrail.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c1),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c2)
        })
    end
end)
table.insert(getgenv().XenonConnections, trailConn)

    Custom = customThemeColors

local currentThemeMode = "Dark"
local currentAccent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 138, 128)

local function resolveEffectiveMode()
    if currentThemeMode == "System" then
        if SETTINGS.NightMode or (Lighting.ClockTime < 6.5 or Lighting.ClockTime > 18) then
            return "Dark"
        else
            return "Light"
        end
    elseif currentThemeMode == "Custom" then
        return "Custom"
    end
    return currentThemeMode or "Dark"
end

local function computeCurrentTheme()
    local effMode = resolveEffectiveMode()
    local base = THEMES[effMode] or THEMES.Dark
    local res = {}
    for k, v in pairs(base) do res[k] = v end

    res.Accent = currentAccent
    if effMode == "Light" then
        res.AccentText = currentAccent:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 0.25)
        res.AccentDim = currentAccent:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.8)
    elseif effMode == "Custom" then
        res.AccentText = currentAccent:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.2)
        res.AccentDim = currentAccent:Lerp(res.MainBackground, 0.5)
    else
        res.AccentText = currentAccent:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.35)
        res.AccentDim = currentAccent:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 0.75)
    end
    return res, effMode
end

ZenithLib:SetTheme(computeCurrentTheme())

local function createAccessoryPart(meshId, textureId, baseScale, userScale, itemType, userColor)
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Name = "AccessoryPart"
    part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.CanTouch = false
    part.CanQuery = false
    part.Massless = true
    part.CastShadow = false

    local col, vCol = getAccessoryColors(itemType, userColor)
    part.Color = col
    part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

    local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
    mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
    mesh.MeshId = meshId
    mesh.TextureId = (textureId and textureId ~= "") and textureId or ""
    mesh.VertexColor = vCol

    local finalScale = (userScale or 1.0)
    mesh.Scale = baseScale * finalScale
    mesh.Parent = part

    attachAccessoryParticles(part, itemType, userColor)

    return part
end

local function getBackCFrame(preset, isDual, index)
    if preset.IsWings then
        return preset.BackCFrame or CFrame.new(0, 0.25, 0.75)
    end
    if isDual then
        if index == 1 then
            return CFrame.new(-0.15, 0.12, 0.63)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-135))
                * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
        else
            return CFrame.new(0.15, 0.12, 0.67)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-45))
                * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
        end
    else
        local angle = preset.BackAngle or -135
        local yOff = preset.BackY or 0.12
        local zOff = preset.BackZ or 0.63
        return CFrame.new(0, yOff, zOff)
            * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(angle))
            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
            * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
    end
end

local function getHandCFrame(preset, isDual, index, isR15)
    local handY = isR15 and -0.15 or -1.0
    local gripOffset = preset.GripOffset or 1.2

    local baseCF = CFrame.new(0, handY, 0)
        * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        * CFrame.new(0, 0, gripOffset)

    -- Пользовательские выверенные координаты (Offset X: 0, Y: -1.1, Z: -1.1 | Pitch: 95°, Yaw: 0°, Roll: -80°)
    local offX = 0.0
    local offY = -1.1
    local offZ = -1.1
    local rotX = math.rad(95)
    local rotY = math.rad(0)
    local rotZ = math.rad(-80)

    if isDual and index == 2 then
        offX = -offX
        rotZ = -rotZ
    end

    return baseCF
        * CFrame.new(offX, offY, offZ)
        * CFrame.Angles(rotX, rotY, rotZ)
end

local function attachAccessoryPart(part, targetLimb, offsetCF)
    if not part or not targetLimb then return end
    part.CFrame = targetLimb.CFrame * offsetCF
    local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    weld.Part0 = targetLimb
    weld.Part1 = part
    weld.Parent = part
end

local function startWingAnimation(wingPart, wingMesh, wingWeld, baseC0, baseScale)
    if wingAnimConnection then
        pcall(function() wingAnimConnection:Disconnect() end)
        wingAnimConnection = nil
    end
    if not (wingPart and wingMesh and wingWeld) then return end

    wingAnimConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not (accessorySettings.Enabled and accessorySettings.Type == "Wings" and wingPart.Parent and wingWeld.Parent) then
            if wingAnimConnection then
                pcall(function() wingAnimConnection:Disconnect() end)
                wingAnimConnection = nil
            end
            return
        end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local isMoving = (hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1)

        -- Динамическая скорость взмахов крыльев (спокойное парение vs энергичный взмах при беге)
        local speed = isMoving and 5.2 or 3.2
        local t = os.clock() * speed

        -- 1. Основной взмах вперед/назад
        local flapPitch = math.sin(t) * 15
        -- 2. Взмах по крену
        local flapRoll = math.sin(t * 0.5) * 3
        -- 3. Волнообразный подъем по высоте
        local flapY = math.sin(t) * 0.12
        -- 4. Смещение по глубине
        local flapZ = math.cos(t) * 0.08

        local animCF = CFrame.new(0, flapY, flapZ)
            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(flapPitch), 0, math.rad(flapRoll))

        wingWeld.C0 = baseC0 * animCF

        -- 5. Эффект размаха крыльев: при взмахе крылья распахиваются шире (+-18%)
        local curUserScale = accessorySettings.Scale or 2.0
        local spanSpread = 1.0 + math.sin(t) * 0.18
        local depthSpread = 1.0 + math.cos(t) * 0.12
        if wingMesh and wingMesh.Parent then
            wingMesh.Scale = baseScale * curUserScale * Vector3.new(spanSpread, 1.0, depthSpread)
        end
    end)
end

local function attachWingAccessory(part, targetLimb, baseCF, baseScale)
    if not part or not targetLimb then return end
    local mesh = part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")

    local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
    weld.Name = "WingWeld"
    weld.Part0 = targetLimb
    weld.Part1 = part
    weld.C0 = baseCF
    weld.C1 = CFrame.new()
    weld.Parent = part

    startWingAnimation(part, mesh, weld, baseCF, baseScale)
end

applyAccessory = function()
    removeAccessory()
    if not accessorySettings.Enabled then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end

    local isR15 = (char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil)
    local torso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    local rightLimb = isR15 and (char:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerArm")) or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
    local leftLimb = isR15 and (char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") or char:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerArm")) or char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")

    if not torso then return end

    local preset = ACCESSORY_PRESETS[accessorySettings.Type] or ACCESSORY_PRESETS["Katana"]
    local isHand = (accessorySettings.Slot == "Hand") and not preset.IsBackOnly

    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "CardinalVisualAccessory"
    folder.Parent = char
    currentAccessoryFolder = folder

    if preset.Dual then
        if isHand then
            local cf1 = getHandCFrame(preset, true, 1, isR15)
            local p1 = createAccessoryPart(preset.MeshId, preset.TextureId, preset.Scale, accessorySettings.Scale, accessorySettings.Type, accessorySettings.Color)
            p1.Parent = folder
            attachAccessoryPart(p1, rightLimb or torso, cf1)

            local cf2 = getHandCFrame(preset, true, 2, isR15)
            local p2 = createAccessoryPart(preset.MeshId, preset.TextureId, preset.Scale, accessorySettings.Scale, accessorySettings.Type, accessorySettings.Color)
            p2.Parent = folder
            attachAccessoryPart(p2, leftLimb or torso, cf2)
        else
            local cf1 = getBackCFrame(preset, true, 1)
            local p1 = createAccessoryPart(preset.MeshId, preset.TextureId, preset.Scale, accessorySettings.Scale, accessorySettings.Type, accessorySettings.Color)
            p1.Parent = folder
            attachAccessoryPart(p1, torso, cf1)

            local cf2 = getBackCFrame(preset, true, 2)
            local p2 = createAccessoryPart(preset.MeshId, preset.TextureId, preset.Scale, accessorySettings.Scale, accessorySettings.Type, accessorySettings.Color)
            p2.Parent = folder
            attachAccessoryPart(p2, torso, cf2)
        end
    else
        local targetLimb = isHand and (rightLimb or torso) or torso
        local targetCF = isHand and getHandCFrame(preset, false, 1, isR15) or getBackCFrame(preset, false, 1)
        local p = createAccessoryPart(preset.MeshId, preset.TextureId, preset.Scale, accessorySettings.Scale, accessorySettings.Type, accessorySettings.Color)
        p.Parent = folder
        if preset.IsWings then
            attachWingAccessory(p, targetLimb, targetCF, preset.Scale)
        else
            attachAccessoryPart(p, targetLimb, targetCF)
        end
    end
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.6)
    if accessorySettings.Enabled then
        pcall(applyAccessory)
    end
end)

-- [ XENON/PROJECT PLAYER AURA & SERVER FRIENDS TRACKER ]
-- ================================================================================
local auraSettings = {
    Enabled = false,
    Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 138, 128),
    Rainbow = false,
    Speed = 1.2,
    Scale = 1.0,
    FloorCircle = true,
    OrbitRings = true,
    Particles = true
}

local activeAuraFolder = nil
local auraRotConnection = nil
local auraRainbowHue = 0
local activeAuraEmitters = {}

removeAura = function()
    if auraRotConnection then
        pcall(function() auraRotConnection:Disconnect() end)
        auraRotConnection = nil
    end

    for _, pe in ipairs(activeAuraEmitters) do
        if pe and pe.Parent then
            pe.Enabled = false
            pcall(function() pe:Clear() end)
            pcall(function() pe:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    activeAuraEmitters = {}

    if activeAuraFolder then
        pcall(function() activeAuraFolder:Destroy() end)
        activeAuraFolder = nil
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if obj.Name == "XenonPlayerAura" or obj.Name == "CardinalPlayerAura" then
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and (obj.Name:find("Aura") or obj.Name:find("Xenon")) then
                obj.Enabled = false
                pcall(function() obj:Clear() end)
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
end

applyAura = function()
    removeAura()
    if not auraSettings.Enabled then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "XenonPlayerAura"
    folder.Parent = char
    activeAuraFolder = folder

    -- 1. Напольный круг
    local floorRing = nil
    if auraSettings.FloorCircle then
        floorRing = Instance.new("Part")
        floorRing.Name = "AuraFloorRing"
        floorRing.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
        floorRing.CanCollide = false
        floorRing.CanTouch = false
        floorRing.CanQuery = false
        floorRing.Massless = true
        floorRing.CastShadow = false
        floorRing.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        floorRing.Color = auraSettings.Color
        floorRing.Transparency = 0.28

        local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://47260990"
        mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(auraSettings.Scale * 3.4, auraSettings.Scale * 3.4, 0.35)
        mesh.Parent = floorRing
        floorRing.Parent = folder
    end

    -- 2. Орбитальные кольца энергии
    local ring1, ring2 = nil, nil
    if auraSettings.OrbitRings then
        local function createOrbitRing(name)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = name
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CanTouch = false
            p.CanQuery = false
            p.Massless = true
            p.CastShadow = false
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            p.Color = auraSettings.Color
            p.Transparency = 0.25

            local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
            mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://47260990"
            mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(auraSettings.Scale * 2.7, auraSettings.Scale * 2.7, 0.55)
            mesh.Parent = p
            p.Parent = folder
            return p
        end
        ring1 = createOrbitRing("AuraOrbitRing1")
        ring2 = createOrbitRing("AuraOrbitRing2")
    end

    -- 3. Восходящие частицы
    local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
    att.Name = "AuraAttachment"
    att.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.2, 0)
    att.Parent = hrp

    if auraSettings.Particles then
        local sparks = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        sparks.Name = "AuraSparks"
        sparks.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
        sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(auraSettings.Color)
        sparks.LightEmission = 1
        sparks.LightInfluence = 0
        sparks.Rate = 28
        sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.2)
        sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4 * auraSettings.Scale), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.8 * auraSettings.Scale), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
        sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.2, 2.8)
        sparks.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
        sparks.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3.0, 0)
        sparks.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
        sparks.Parent = att
        table.insert(activeAuraEmitters, sparks)

        local flames = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        flames.Name = "AuraFlames"
        flames.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
        flames.Color = ColorSequence.new(auraSettings.Color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
        flames.LightEmission = 0.95
        flames.LightInfluence = 0
        flames.Rate = 18
        flames.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.9)
        flames.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.9 * auraSettings.Scale), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
        flames.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.6, 2.0)
        flames.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(50, 50)
        flames.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
        flames.Parent = att
        table.insert(activeAuraEmitters, flames)
    end

    local rotAngle = 0
    auraRotConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not (auraSettings.Enabled and char and hrp and hrp.Parent and folder.Parent) then
            removeAura()
            return
        end

        rotAngle = rotAngle + dt * (auraSettings.Speed * 120)

        local currentColor = auraSettings.Color
        if auraSettings.Rainbow then
            auraRainbowHue = (auraRainbowHue + dt * 0.4) % 1
            currentColor = Color3.fromHSV(auraRainbowHue, 0.85, 1)
        end

        if floorRing and floorRing.Parent then
            floorRing.Color = currentColor
            floorRing.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -2.85, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-rotAngle * 0.7), 0)
        end

        if ring1 and ring1.Parent and ring2 and ring2.Parent then
            ring1.Color = currentColor
            ring2.Color = currentColor
            local baseCF = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.2, 0)
            ring1.CFrame = baseCF * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(28), math.rad(rotAngle), 0)
            ring2.CFrame = baseCF * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-28), math.rad(-rotAngle * 0.85), 0)
        end
    end)
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.6)
    if auraSettings.Enabled then pcall(applyAura) end
end)

openAuraSettings = function()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Aura Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
        local mkToggle = _G.XenonModalToggle or createModalToggleRow
        local mkSlider = _G.XenonModalSlider or createModalSliderRow
        local mkColor = _G.XenonColorPicker or createColorPickerCard

        if mkSlider then
            mkSlider(container, "Размер ауры (Scale)", auraSettings.Scale, 0.5, 2.5, false, function(v)
                auraSettings.Scale = math.floor(v * 10) / 10
                if auraSettings.Enabled then applyAura() end
            end)

            mkSlider(container, "Скорость вращения (Speed)", auraSettings.Speed, 0.5, 3.0, false, function(v)
                auraSettings.Speed = math.floor(v * 10) / 10
            end)
        end

        if mkToggle then
            mkToggle(container, "🌈 Радужный режим (Rainbow)", auraSettings.Rainbow, function(v)
                auraSettings.Rainbow = v
            end)

            mkToggle(container, "⭕ Напольный круг (Floor Circle)", auraSettings.FloorCircle, function(v)
                auraSettings.FloorCircle = v
                if auraSettings.Enabled then applyAura() end
            end)

            mkToggle(container, "💫 Орбитальные кольца (Orbit Rings)", auraSettings.OrbitRings, function(v)
                auraSettings.OrbitRings = v
                if auraSettings.Enabled then applyAura() end
            end)

            mkToggle(container, "✨ Частицы пламени (Sparks & Fire)", auraSettings.Particles, function(v)
                auraSettings.Particles = v
                if auraSettings.Enabled then applyAura() end
            end)
        end

        if mkColor then
            mkColor(container, "Цвет ауры (Aura Color)", auraSettings.Color, function(newC)
                auraSettings.Color = newC
                auraSettings.Rainbow = false
                if auraSettings.Enabled then applyAura() end
            end)
        end
    end)
end

                Position = UDim2.new(0, -430, 1, -25)

local REGISTERED_CARD_TOGGLES = {}

-- [ FREEZE VARIABLES ]
local function setFreeze(state)
    SETTINGS.Freeze = state
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    
    if state then
        pcall(function() hrp:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer) end)
        local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("FreezeVelocity")
        if not bv then
            bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "FreezeVelocity"
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
            bv.Parent = hrp
        end
    else
        local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("FreezeVelocity")
        if bv then bv:Destroy() end
    end
end

-- [ CROSSHAIR INITIALIZATION ] --
local function createCrosshairDrawing(thickness, color)
    if Drawing and Drawing.new then
        local l = Drawing.new("Line")
        l.Thickness = thickness
        l.Color = color
        l.Transparency = 1
        l.Visible = false
        return l
    end
    return { Visible = false, Destroy = function() end }
end

for _, side in ipairs({"R", "L", "T", "B"}) do
    crosshairOutlines[side] = createCrosshairDrawing(3, Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
    crosshairLines[side] = createCrosshairDrawing(1.5, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
end
getgenv().CardinalCrosshairLines = crosshairLines
getgenv().CardinalCrosshairOutlines = crosshairOutlines

-- [ DONATOR LINE (2 ЧЕРНЫХ, 1 КРАСНЫЙ) ] --
function ActivateRealDonatorLine()
    local old = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("FartherReach")
    if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end

    local bv = Instance.new("BoolValue")
    bv.Name = "FartherReach"
    bv.Value = true
    bv.Parent = LocalPlayer

    pcall(function()
        local gs = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("GrabbingScript")
        if gs then 
            gs.Enabled = false
            task.wait(0.1)
            gs.Enabled = true 
        end
    end)

    local cBlack = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local cRed = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
    local sequence = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, cBlack),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.33, cBlack),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.66, cRed),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, cBlack)
    })

    local args = {sequence}
    for i = 2, 10 do 
        args[i] = (i % 3 == 0) and cRed or cBlack 
    end
    
    pcall(function()
        if ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DataEvents") and ReplicatedStorage.DataEvents:FindFirstChild("UpdateLineColorsEvent") then
            ReplicatedStorage.DataEvents.UpdateLineColorsEvent:FireServer(table.unpack(args))
        end
    end)
end

-- [ LEGIT STOP (B) ] --
function performLegitStop()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not root or not hum then return end
    
    local startVel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local horizontalVel = Vector3.new(startVel.X, 0, startVel.Z)
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = horizontalVel
    
    local steps = 15
    local duration = 1.5
    local stepTime = duration / steps
    
    for i = 1, steps do
        task.delay(i * stepTime, function()
            if root and root.Parent then
                local factor = 1 - (i / steps)
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = horizontalVel * factor
            end
        end)
    end
    
    task.delay(duration + 0.05, function()
        if root and root.Parent then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            if not SETTINGS.Freeze then
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics)
            end
            ActivateRealDonatorLine()
        end
    end)
end

-- [ RESET CHARACTER & KEYBIND ] --
local isListeningForResetKey = false
local resetKeyConn = nil
local resetKeyBtnZenith = nil

function resetCharacter()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.Health = 0
    end
    pcall(function()
        char:BreakJoints()
    end)
end

function changeResetKeybind()
    if isListeningForResetKey then return end
    isListeningForResetKey = true

    local function updateLabels(text)
        if resetKeyBtnZenith then
            local textLbl = resetKeyBtnZenith:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
            if textLbl then textLbl.Text = text end
        end
        if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
    end

    updateLabels("Reset Key: [ Нажмите клавишу... ]")
    if Window and Window.Notify then
        Window:Notify({
            Title = "Смена клавиши Reset",
            Content = "Нажмите любую клавишу на клавиатуре (или Esc для отмены)...",
            Duration = 3
        })
    end

    if resetKeyConn then resetKeyConn:Disconnect(); resetKeyConn = nil end
    resetKeyConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
        if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end

        isListeningForResetKey = false
        if resetKeyConn then resetKeyConn:Disconnect(); resetKeyConn = nil end

        if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
            updateLabels("Reset Key: [" .. (SETTINGS.ResetKey and SETTINGS.ResetKey.Name or "None") .. "]")
            if Window and Window.Notify then
                Window:Notify({ Title = "Keybind", Content = "Отменено", Duration = 1.5 })
            end
            return
        end

        SETTINGS.ResetKey = inp.KeyCode
        updateLabels("Reset Key: [" .. SETTINGS.ResetKey.Name .. "]")

        if Window and Window.Notify then
            Window:Notify({
                Title = "Кейбинд изменен",
                Content = "Клавиша сброса (Reset) установлена на: " .. inp.KeyCode.Name,
                Duration = 2.5
            })
        end
    end)
end

-- [ SPAWN PALLET (X) ] --
function spawnPallet()
    local SpawnRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("MenuToys") and ReplicatedStorage.MenuToys:FindFirstChild("SpawnToyRemoteFunction")
    if not SpawnRemote then return end
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    
    local playerPos = hrp.Position
    local lv = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local spawnPos = Vector3.new(playerPos.X + lv.X * 15, playerPos.Y, playerPos.Z + lv.Z * 15)
    
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            SpawnRemote:InvokeServer("PalletLightBrown", CFrame.lookAt(spawnPos, spawnPos + lv), Vector3.new(0, 70, 0))
        end)
    end)
    ActivateRealDonatorLine()
end

-- [ RAGDOLL GRAB HELPERS ] --
local function getGrabTargetPart()
    local grabParts = Workspace:FindFirstChild("GrabParts")
    if not grabParts then return nil end
    local grabPart = grabParts:FindFirstChild("GrabPart")
    if not grabPart then return nil end
    local weldConstraint = grabPart:FindFirstChild("WeldConstraint")
    if weldConstraint and weldConstraint.Part1 then
        return weldConstraint.Part1, grabPart
    end
    return grabPart, grabPart
end

-- [ Ragdoll Grab removed ]

-- [ FORCE ADJUST GRAB DISTANCE ] --
local LastSetLimit = 33
function ForceAdjust(distance)
    local registry = (debug and debug.getregistry) and debug.getregistry()
    if not registry then return end
    for _, func in pairs(registry) do
        if type(func) == "function" then
            local info = debug.getinfo(func)
            if info and (info.name == "grab" or (info.source and info.source:find("Grab"))) then
                local nups = info.nups or 0
                for i = 1, nups do
                    local success, value = pcall(debug.getupvalue, func, i)
                    if success and type(value) == "number" then
                        if value ~= distance and (value == 20 or value == 100 or value == 33 or value == LastSetLimit) then
                            pcall(debug.setupvalue, func, i, distance)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    LastSetLimit = distance
end

local grabNamecallHook
grabNamecallHook = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
    local method = getnamecallmethod()
    local args = {...}
    if not checkcaller() and method == "FireServer" then
        if self.Name == "ExtendGrabLine" then
            if type(args[1]) == "number" and args[1] > SETTINGS.TargetLimit then
                args[1] = SETTINGS.TargetLimit
                return grabNamecallHook(self, unpack(args))
            end
        end
        if self.Name == "Beam" and tostring(args[1]) == "make" then
            task.spawn(ForceAdjust, SETTINGS.TargetLimit)
        end
    end
    return grabNamecallHook(self, ...)
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.5) do
        pcall(ForceAdjust, SETTINGS.TargetLimit)
    end
end)

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    task.spawn(ForceAdjust, SETTINGS.TargetLimit)
end

-- [ CUSTOM ANTI-GRAB (100% PROPRIETARY & SELF-CONTAINED) ] --
local AntiGrabEngine = {
    connections = {},
    friendsCache = {},
    isProcessing = false,
    openSettings = nil
}

function AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")

    -- 1. Ищем PartOwner на частях тела персонажа
    for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local po = p:FindFirstChild("PartOwner")
            if po and po.Value then
                local v = po.Value
                if typeof(v) == "Instance" then
                    if v:IsA("Player") then return v.Name end
                    local pObj = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(v) or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(v.Parent)
                    if pObj then return pObj.Name end
                elseif tostring(v) ~= "" and tostring(v) ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
                    return tostring(v)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- 2. Ищем через физические соединения и констрейнты
    for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            for _, c in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("Constraint") or c:IsA("WeldConstraint") or c:IsA("Weld") or c:IsA("JointInstance") then
                    local other = (c.Part0 == p and c.Part1) or (c.Part1 == p and c.Part0)
                    if other then
                        local m = other:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        if m and m ~= char then
                            local pl = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)
                            if pl and pl ~= LocalPlayer then return pl.Name end
                        end
                        local f = other:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Folder")
                        if f and f.Name:find("SpawnedInToys") then
                            local oName = f.Name:gsub("SpawnedInToys", "")
                            if oName ~= "" and oName ~= LocalPlayer.Name then return oName end
                        end
                        local oPo = other:FindFirstChild("PartOwner")
                        if oPo and oPo.Value and tostring(oPo.Value) ~= "" and tostring(oPo.Value) ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
                            return tostring(oPo.Value)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- 3. Проверяем GrabLine в workspace
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj.Name:find("GrabLine") or obj.Name == "GrabLine" then
            local po = obj:FindFirstChild("PartOwner")
            if po and po.Value and tostring(po.Value) ~= "" and tostring(po.Value) ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
                return tostring(po.Value)
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function AntiGrabEngine.isGrabAllowed(grabberName)
    if not grabberName or grabberName == "" then return false end

    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local pl = Players:FindFirstChild(grabberName)
    if not pl then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.DisplayName == grabberName or p.Name == grabberName then
                pl = p
                break
            end
        end
    end

    local realName = pl and pl.Name or grabberName
    local realDisplayName = pl and pl.DisplayName or grabberName

    -- 1. Ручной вайтлист игроков (работает всегда для добавленных игроков!)
    if SETTINGS.AntiGrabWhitelistedPlayers then
        if SETTINGS.AntiGrabWhitelistedPlayers[realName] == true 
           or SETTINGS.AntiGrabWhitelistedPlayers[realDisplayName] == true 
           or SETTINGS.AntiGrabWhitelistedPlayers[grabberName] == true then
            return true
        end
    end

    -- 2. Вайтлист друзей в Roblox (если включен переключатель друзей)
    if SETTINGS.AntiGrabFriendWhitelist and pl then
        if AntiGrabEngine.friendsCache[pl.UserId] ~= nil then
            return AntiGrabEngine.friendsCache[pl.UserId]
        end
        local ok, isF = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:IsFriendsWith(pl.UserId) end)
        local res = (ok and isF == true)
        AntiGrabEngine.friendsCache[pl.UserId] = res
        return res
    end

    return false
end

function AntiGrabEngine.start()
    for _, conn in ipairs(AntiGrabEngine.connections) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(AntiGrabEngine.connections)

    local StruggleEvent = nil
    pcall(function()
        if CharacterEvents then
            StruggleEvent = CharacterEvents:FindFirstChild("Struggle")
        end
        if not StruggleEvent then
            local ce = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CharacterEvents")
            if ce then StruggleEvent = ce:FindFirstChild("Struggle") end
        end
    end)

    local DestroyGrabLine = nil
    pcall(function()
        local ge = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents")
        if ge then DestroyGrabLine = ge:FindFirstChild("DestroyGrabLine") end
    end)

    -- Защита от смерти при повреждении соединений
    local function protectHumanoid(char)
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            pcall(function()
                hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
                hum.RequiresNeck = false
            end)
        end
    end

    -- Восстановление сварки конечностей (исправляет мгновенную смерть при захвате!)
    local function restoreCharacterWelds(char)
        if not char then return end
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "Head" then
                local bsc = p:FindFirstChild("BallSocketConstraint")
                if bsc then bsc.Enabled = false end
                local rlp = p:FindFirstChild("RagdollLimbPart")
                if rlp and rlp:FindFirstChild("WeldConstraint") then
                    rlp.WeldConstraint.Enabled = true -- ВАЖНО: ВКЛЮЧАЕМ сварку, чтобы конечности не отваливались!
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function breakGrabCleanly(grabberName)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")

        protectHumanoid(char)

        -- Состояние Dead оставляем включенным для ресета, но не даем умереть от отрыва конечностей
        if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
            pcall(function()
                hum.PlatformStand = false
                hum.Sit = false
                hum.AutoRotate = true
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
            end)
        end

        -- 1. Спамим борьбу (Struggle) и снятие рэгдолла
        if StruggleEvent then
            pcall(function()
                StruggleEvent:FireServer(LocalPlayer)
                StruggleEvent:FireServer()
            end)
        end
        if RagdollRemote and hrp then
            pcall(function() RagdollRemote:FireServer(hrp, 0) end)
        end

        -- 2. Разрываем линию захвата через официальный remote FTAP (только себя и захватчика)
        if DestroyGrabLine then
            if head then pcall(function() DestroyGrabLine:FireServer(head) end) end
            if hrp then pcall(function() DestroyGrabLine:FireServer(hrp) end) end
            if grabberName then
                local gPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(grabberName)
                if gPlr and gPlr.Character then
                    local gRoot = gPlr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if gRoot then pcall(function() DestroyGrabLine:FireServer(gRoot) end) end
                end
            end
        end

        -- 3. Восстанавливаем целостность тела
        restoreCharacterWelds(char)

        -- 4. Физический срыв захвата: микро-анкор срывает захват в FTAP
        if hrp and not hrp.Anchored then
            pcall(function()
                hrp.Anchored = true
                if SETTINGS.AntiGrabWalk and hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + hum.MoveDirection * 0.43
                end
                task.wait(0.04)
                hrp.Anchored = false
            end)
        end
    end

    -- Слушатель IsHeld
    local isHeld = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("IsHeld")
    if isHeld then
        local heldConn = isHeld.Changed:Connect(function(val)
            if not SETTINGS.AntiGrab then return end
            if val then
                task.spawn(function()
                    task.wait(0.02)
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local gName = AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(char)
                    if not AntiGrabEngine.isGrabAllowed(gName) then
                        breakGrabCleanly(gName)
                        local t0 = tick()
                        while SETTINGS.AntiGrab and isHeld.Value and (tick() - t0 < 3) do
                            local gNow = AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(LocalPlayer.Character)
                            if not AntiGrabEngine.isGrabAllowed(gNow) then
                                breakGrabCleanly(gNow)
                            else
                                break
                            end
                            task.wait(0.04)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(AntiGrabEngine.connections, heldConn)
        if isHeld.Value then
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.02)
                local gName = AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(LocalPlayer.Character)
                if not AntiGrabEngine.isGrabAllowed(gName) then
                    breakGrabCleanly(gName)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    -- Слушатель появления PartOwner или чужих констрейнтов
    local function watchChar(char)
        if not char then return end
        protectHumanoid(char)
        restoreCharacterWelds(char)

        local descConn = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
            if not SETTINGS.AntiGrab then return end
            if desc.Name == "PartOwner" or desc:IsA("Constraint") or desc:IsA("WeldConstraint") or desc:IsA("Weld") or desc:IsA("RopeConstraint") then
                task.spawn(function()
                    if desc.Name == "PartOwner" and desc:IsA("StringValue") and desc.Value == "" then
                        local t0 = tick()
                        while desc.Parent and desc.Value == "" and (tick() - t0 < 0.05) do
                            task.wait(0.01)
                        end
                    end
                    local gName = AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(char)
                    if not AntiGrabEngine.isGrabAllowed(gName) then
                        breakGrabCleanly(gName)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(AntiGrabEngine.connections, descConn)

        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
        if hum then
            protectHumanoid(char)
            local humConn = hum.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
                if not SETTINGS.AntiGrab then return end
                if prop == "Sit" and hum.Sit then
                    if not hum.SeatPart or hum.SeatPart.Parent.Name ~= "CreatureBlobman" then
                        local gName = AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(char)
                        if not AntiGrabEngine.isGrabAllowed(gName) then
                            hum.Sit = false
                            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                            breakGrabCleanly(gName)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            table.insert(AntiGrabEngine.connections, humConn)

            local ragVal = hum:FindFirstChild("Ragdolled")
            if ragVal then
                local ragConn = ragVal.Changed:Connect(function(v)
                    if SETTINGS.AntiGrab and v then
                        local gName = AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(char)
                        if not AntiGrabEngine.isGrabAllowed(gName) then
                            breakGrabCleanly(gName)
                        end
                    end
                end)
                table.insert(AntiGrabEngine.connections, ragConn)
            end
        end
    end

    watchChar(LocalPlayer.Character)
    local charAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchChar)
    table.insert(AntiGrabEngine.connections, charAddedConn)

    -- Предохранитель на Heartbeat
    local hbConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not SETTINGS.AntiGrab then return end
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        local isHeldVal = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("IsHeld")
        if c and isHeldVal and isHeldVal.Value then
            local gName = AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(c)
            if not AntiGrabEngine.isGrabAllowed(gName) then
                breakGrabCleanly(gName)
            end
        end
    end)
    table.insert(AntiGrabEngine.connections, hbConn)
end

function AntiGrabEngine.stop()
    for _, conn in ipairs(AntiGrabEngine.connections) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(AntiGrabEngine.connections)

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false end
    if hum then
        pcall(function()
            hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
            hum.Sit = false
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
        end)
    end
end

-- [ ANTI EXPLOSION DEFENSE (FTAP ENGINE FROM MESSAGE 45) ] --
local AntiExplosionEngine = {
    connections = {}
}

function AntiExplosionEngine.start()
    for _, conn in ipairs(AntiExplosionEngine.connections) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(AntiExplosionEngine.connections)

    local function setupChar(char)
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not hrp or not hum then return end

        pcall(function()
            hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
            hum.RequiresNeck = false
        end)

        local childConn = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(model)
            if not SETTINGS.AntiExplosion then return end
            -- В FTAP взрывы спавнят BasePart с именем "Part" или объекты с характерными именами
            local isExplosionPart = (model.Name == "Part") or (model.Name:lower():find("bomb")) or (model.Name:lower():find("rocket")) or (model.Name:lower():find("barrel"))
            if not isExplosionPart then return end
            if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end

            local partPos = nil
            if model:IsA("BasePart") then
                partPos = model.Position
            elseif model:IsA("Model") then
                local prim = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if prim then partPos = prim.Position end
            end
            if not partPos then return end

            local mag = (partPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            if mag <= 28 then
                pcall(function()
                    hrp.Anchored = true
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)

                task.spawn(function()
                    task.wait(0.01)
                    local t0 = tick()
                    while (tick() - t0) < 0.15 do
                        task.wait(0.005)
                        local rArm = char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or char:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
                        local rlp = rArm and rArm:FindFirstChild("RagdollLimbPart")
                        if rlp and not rlp.CanCollide then
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        hrp.Anchored = false
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        if RagdollRemote then
                            RagdollRemote:FireServer(hrp, 0)
                        end
                        if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
                            hum.Sit = false
                            hum.PlatformStand = false
                            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(AntiExplosionEngine.connections, childConn)
    end

    setupChar(LocalPlayer.Character)
    local charAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupChar)
    table.insert(AntiExplosionEngine.connections, charAddedConn)
end

function AntiExplosionEngine.stop()
    for _, conn in ipairs(AntiExplosionEngine.connections) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(AntiExplosionEngine.connections)

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = false end) end
end

-- [ ANTI KICK SYSTEM (KUNAI / SHURIKEN IN STOMACH WITH HIGHLIGHT) ] --
local AntiKickEngine = {
    active = false,
    activeToy = nil,
    loopTask = nil,
    charConn = nil
}

function AntiKickEngine.clearToy()
    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local destroyRE = RS:FindFirstChild("MenuToys") and RS.MenuToys:FindFirstChild("DestroyToy")
    local inv = workspace:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name .. "SpawnedInToys")
    if inv and destroyRE then
        for _, v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do
            if v.Name == "AntiKick" or v.Name == "NinjaShuriken" or v.Name == "NinjaKunai" then
                pcall(function() destroyRE:FireServer(v) end)
            end
        end
    end
    if AntiKickEngine.activeToy and AntiKickEngine.activeToy.Parent and destroyRE then
        pcall(function() destroyRE:FireServer(AntiKickEngine.activeToy) end)
    end
    AntiKickEngine.activeToy = nil
end

function AntiKickEngine.stickAndHighlight(toy)
    if not toy or not toy.Parent then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or hrp
    if not hrp or not torso then return end

    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local setOwner = RS:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents") and RS.GrabEvents:FindFirstChild("SetNetworkOwner")
    local stickyEvent = RS:FindFirstChild("PlayerEvents") and RS.PlayerEvents:FindFirstChild("StickyPartEvent")

    local stickyPart = toy:FindFirstChild("StickyPart") or toy:WaitForChild("StickyPart", 1.5)
    local soundPart = toy:FindFirstChild("SoundPart") or toy:WaitForChild("SoundPart", 1.5)

    -- Позиционируем предмет прямо ВНУТРЬ живота (центр Torso)
    local bellyCF = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.15, 0)
    pcall(function()
        toy:PivotTo(bellyCF)
        if stickyPart then stickyPart.CFrame = bellyCF end
        if soundPart then soundPart.CFrame = bellyCF end
    end)

    -- 1. Мгновенно забираем сетевое владение предметом
    if setOwner then
        if soundPart then pcall(function() setOwner:FireServer(soundPart, bellyCF) end) end
        if stickyPart then pcall(function() setOwner:FireServer(stickyPart, bellyCF) end) end
    end

    -- 2. Приклеиваем предмет прямо В ЖИВОТ быстрой серией
    local targetAttachment = hrp:FindFirstChild("FirePlayerPart") or torso
    if stickyEvent and stickyPart and targetAttachment then
        local attachOffset = CFrame.new(0, -0.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), math.rad(90))
        for _ = 1, 3 do
            pcall(function()
                stickyEvent:FireServer(stickyPart, targetAttachment, attachOffset)
                if torso ~= targetAttachment then
                    stickyEvent:FireServer(stickyPart, torso, attachOffset)
                end
            end)
            task.wait(0.01)
        end
    end

    -- 3. Настройка коллизий и полная прозрачность (предмет внутри тела невидим, без серого цвета и обводок)
    for _, obj in ipairs(toy:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            obj.CanTouch = false
            obj.CanCollide = false
            obj.CanQuery = false
            obj.Transparency = 1
        end
        if obj:IsA("Highlight") or obj:IsA("SelectionBox") or obj:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") then
            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        for _, c in ipairs(toy:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("Highlight") or c:IsA("SelectionBox") then c:Destroy() end
        end
    end)

    toy.Name = "AntiKick"
    AntiKickEngine.activeToy = toy
end

function AntiKickEngine.spawnToy(toyName)
    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local spawnRF = RS:FindFirstChild("MenuToys") and RS.MenuToys:FindFirstChild("SpawnToyRemoteFunction")
    local canSpawn = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("CanSpawnToy")
    if not spawnRF then return nil end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local torso = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or hrp)
    if not hrp then return nil end

    if canSpawn and not canSpawn.Value then
        local t0 = tick()
        while canSpawn and not canSpawn.Value and (tick() - t0 < 1.2) do task.wait(0.04) end
    end

    -- Спавним ровно в позиции живота игрока
    local spawnCF = (torso and torso.CFrame) or hrp.CFrame
    pcall(function()
        spawnRF:InvokeServer(toyName, spawnCF, Vector3.zero)
    end)

    local inv = workspace:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name .. "SpawnedInToys")
    if inv then
        local toy = inv:FindFirstChild(toyName) or inv:FindFirstChild("AntiKick")
        if not toy then
            local t0 = tick()
            while not toy and (tick() - t0 < 1.2) do
                toy = inv:FindFirstChild(toyName) or inv:FindFirstChild("AntiKick")
                if toy then break end
                task.wait(0.02)
            end
        end
        return toy
    end
    return nil
end

function AntiKickEngine.start()
    AntiKickEngine.clearToy()
    AntiKickEngine.active = true

    AntiKickEngine.loopTask = task.spawn(function()
        while AntiKickEngine.active do
            if SETTINGS.AntiKick then
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local torso = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or hrp)

                if char and hum and hum.Health > 0 and torso then
                    local toy = AntiKickEngine.activeToy
                    if not toy or not toy.Parent then
                        local toyName = SETTINGS.AntiKickToy or "NinjaShuriken"
                        local newToy = AntiKickEngine.spawnToy(toyName)
                        if newToy then
                            AntiKickEngine.stickAndHighlight(newToy)
                        end
                    else
                        local stickyPart = toy:FindFirstChild("StickyPart")
                        if stickyPart then
                            local dist = (stickyPart.Position - torso.Position).Magnitude
                            if dist > 2 or stickyPart.CanTouch then
                                AntiKickEngine.stickAndHighlight(toy)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.12)
        end
    end)

    if AntiKickEngine.charConn then AntiKickEngine.charConn:Disconnect() end
    AntiKickEngine.charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.4)
        if AntiKickEngine.active and SETTINGS.AntiKick then
            local toyName = SETTINGS.AntiKickToy or "NinjaShuriken"
            local newToy = AntiKickEngine.spawnToy(toyName)
            if newToy then AntiKickEngine.stickAndHighlight(newToy) end
        end
    end)
end

function AntiKickEngine.stop()
    AntiKickEngine.active = false
    if AntiKickEngine.charConn then
        AntiKickEngine.charConn:Disconnect()
        AntiKickEngine.charConn = nil
    end
    AntiKickEngine.clearToy()
end
