function AntiInputEngine.clearToy()
    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local destroyRE = RS:FindFirstChild("MenuToys") and RS.MenuToys:FindFirstChild("DestroyToy")
    local inv = workspace:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name .. "SpawnedInToys")
    if inv and destroyRE then
        for _, item in ipairs(AntiInputEngine.Items) do
            local found = inv:FindFirstChild(item.Id)
            if found then pcall(function() destroyRE:FireServer(found) end) end
        end
    end
    if AntiInputEngine.activeToy and AntiInputEngine.activeToy.Parent and destroyRE then
        pcall(function() destroyRE:FireServer(AntiInputEngine.activeToy) end)
    end
    AntiInputEngine.activeToy = nil
end

function AntiInputEngine.start()
    AntiInputEngine.clearToy()
    AntiInputEngine.active = true

    AntiInputEngine.taskHandle = task.spawn(function()
        local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local spawnRF = RS:FindFirstChild("MenuToys") and RS.MenuToys:FindFirstChild("SpawnToyRemoteFunction")

        while AntiInputEngine.active do
            if SETTINGS.AntiInput then
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local selectedToyId = SETTINGS.AntiInputItem or "FoodPizzaCheese"

                if char and hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 and spawnRF then
                    local toysFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name .. "SpawnedInToys")
                    local toy = toysFolder and toysFolder:FindFirstChild(selectedToyId)

                    if not toy then
                        pcall(function()
                            spawnRF:InvokeServer(selectedToyId, hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.zero)
                        end)
                        local t0 = tick()
                        repeat
                            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                            toysFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name .. "SpawnedInToys")
                            toy = toysFolder and toysFolder:FindFirstChild(selectedToyId)
                        until toy or tick() - t0 > 1.2 or not AntiInputEngine.active
                    end

                    if toy and toy.Parent then
                        AntiInputEngine.activeToy = toy
                        local holdPart = toy:FindFirstChild("HoldPart")
                        if holdPart then
                            local holdingPlr = holdPart:FindFirstChild("HoldingPlayer")
                            local holder = holdingPlr and holdingPlr.Value

                            if holder and holder ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
                                local dropRF = holdPart:FindFirstChild("DropItemRemoteFunction")
                                if dropRF then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        dropRF:InvokeServer(toy, hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2000, 0), Vector3.zero)
                                    end)
                                end
                                pcall(function() toy:Destroy() end)
                            else
                                local holdRF = holdPart:FindFirstChild("HoldItemRemoteFunction")
                                if holdRF then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        holdRF:InvokeServer(toy, char)
                                    end)
                                end
                                task.wait(0.04)
                                local dropRF = holdPart:FindFirstChild("DropItemRemoteFunction")
                                if dropRF then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        dropRF:InvokeServer(toy, hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2000, 0), Vector3.zero)
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
    end)
end

function AntiInputEngine.stop()
    AntiInputEngine.active = false
    if AntiInputEngine.taskHandle then
        task.cancel(AntiInputEngine.taskHandle)
        AntiInputEngine.taskHandle = nil
    end
    AntiInputEngine.clearToy()
end

local TeamProtectEngine = {
    active = false,
    taskHandle = nil,
    friendToys = {},
    lastRescueTick = {},
    friendCache = {},
    openSettings = nil
}

function TeamProtectEngine.isPlayerProtected(plr)
    if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
    -- 1. Whitelisted in UI (Name or DisplayName)
    if SETTINGS.TeamProtectedPlayers and (
        SETTINGS.TeamProtectedPlayers[plr.Name] == true or 
        SETTINGS.TeamProtectedPlayers[plr.DisplayName] == true
    ) then
        return true
    end
    -- 2. Same Team
    if plr.Team ~= nil and plr.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
        return true
    end
    -- 3. Cache
    if TeamProtectEngine.friendCache[plr.UserId] ~= nil then
        return TeamProtectEngine.friendCache[plr.UserId]
    end
    -- 4. Roblox Friend API (check both ways safely)
    local ok, res = pcall(function() return plr:IsFriendsWith(LocalPlayer.UserId) end)
    if ok and res == true then
        TeamProtectEngine.friendCache[plr.UserId] = true
        return true
    end
    local ok2, res2 = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:IsFriendsWith(plr.UserId) end)
    if ok2 and res2 == true then
        TeamProtectEngine.friendCache[plr.UserId] = true
        return true
    end
    TeamProtectEngine.friendCache[plr.UserId] = false
    return false
end

function TeamProtectEngine.clearToys()
    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local destroyRE = RS:FindFirstChild("MenuToys") and RS.MenuToys:FindFirstChild("DestroyToy")
    for pName, toy in pairs(TeamProtectEngine.friendToys) do
        if toy and toy.Parent and destroyRE then
            pcall(function() destroyRE:FireServer(toy) end)
        end
    end
    TeamProtectEngine.friendToys = {}
end

function TeamProtectEngine.stickToyToPlayer(toy, targetChar)
    if not toy or not toy.Parent or not targetChar then return end
    local hrp = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local torso = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Torso") or targetChar:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or hrp
    if not torso then return end

    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local setOwner = RS:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents") and RS.GrabEvents:FindFirstChild("SetNetworkOwner")
    local stickyEvent = RS:FindFirstChild("PlayerEvents") and RS.PlayerEvents:FindFirstChild("StickyPartEvent")

    local stickyPart = toy:FindFirstChild("StickyPart") or toy:WaitForChild("StickyPart", 1.5)
    local soundPart = toy:FindFirstChild("SoundPart") or toy:WaitForChild("SoundPart", 1.5)

    local bellyCF = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.15, 0)
    pcall(function()
        toy:PivotTo(bellyCF)
        if stickyPart then stickyPart.CFrame = bellyCF end
        if soundPart then soundPart.CFrame = bellyCF end
    end)

    if setOwner then
        if soundPart then pcall(function() setOwner:FireServer(soundPart, bellyCF) end) end
        if stickyPart then pcall(function() setOwner:FireServer(stickyPart, bellyCF) end) end
    end

    local targetAttachment = (hrp and hrp:FindFirstChild("FirePlayerPart")) or torso
    if stickyEvent and stickyPart and targetAttachment then
        local attachOffset = CFrame.new(0, -0.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), math.rad(90))
        for _ = 1, 3 do
            pcall(function()
                stickyEvent:FireServer(stickyPart, targetAttachment, attachOffset)
                if torso ~= targetAttachment then
                    stickyEvent:FireServer(stickyPart, torso, attachOffset)
                end
            end)
            task.wait(0.01)
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(toy:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            obj.CanTouch = false
            obj.CanCollide = false
            obj.CanQuery = false
            local hl = obj:FindFirstChild("TeamAntiKickHL")
            if not hl then
                hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                hl.Name = "TeamAntiKickHL"
                hl.Adornee = obj
                hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 140)
                hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                hl.FillTransparency = 0.2
                hl.Parent = obj
            end
        end
    end
end

function TeamProtectEngine.checkIsGrabbed(char)
    if not char then return false end
    for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            if p:FindFirstChild("PartOwner") then return true end
            local isHeld = p:FindFirstChild("IsHeld")
            if isHeld and (isHeld.Value == true or isHeld.Value == 1) then return true end
            for _, c in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("Constraint") or c:IsA("WeldConstraint") or c:IsA("Weld") or c:IsA("JointInstance") then
                    local other = (c.Part0 == p and c.Part1) or (c.Part1 == p and c.Part0)
                    if other then
                        local m = other:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        if m and m ~= char and m ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
                            local pl = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)
                            if pl and pl ~= LocalPlayer then return true end
                        end
                        local f = other:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Folder")
                        if f and f.Name:find("SpawnedInToys") then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if char:GetAttribute("IsHeld") == true then return true end
    local isHeldVal = char:FindFirstChild("IsHeld")
    if isHeldVal and (isHeldVal.Value == true or isHeldVal.Value == 1) then return true end

    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if obj.Name == "GrabLine" or obj.Name:find("GrabLine") then
                local a0 = obj:FindFirstChild("Attachment0") or obj:FindFirstChild("Attach0")
                local a1 = obj:FindFirstChild("Attachment1") or obj:FindFirstChild("Attach1")
                if (a0 and a0.Parent and a0.Parent.Parent == char) or (a1 and a1.Parent and a1.Parent.Parent == char) then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and (hum.PlatformStand or hum.Sit) then
        if AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(char) ~= nil then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

function TeamProtectEngine.start()
    TeamProtectEngine.clearToys()
    TeamProtectEngine.active = true

    TeamProtectEngine.taskHandle = task.spawn(function()
        local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")

        while TeamProtectEngine.active do
            if SETTINGS.TeamProtect then
                local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                for _, friendPlr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if TeamProtectEngine.isPlayerProtected(friendPlr) then
                        local fChar = friendPlr.Character
                        local fHum = fChar and fChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local fHrp = fChar and (fChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or fChar:FindFirstChild("Torso"))

                        if fChar and fHum and fHum.Health > 0 and fHrp then
                            -- 1. Anti-Kick для тиммейта (сюрикен прямо в живот)
                            if SETTINGS.TeamAntiKick then
                                local existingToy = TeamProtectEngine.friendToys[friendPlr.Name]
                                if not existingToy or not existingToy.Parent then
                                    local toyName = SETTINGS.AntiKickToy or "NinjaShuriken"
                                    local newToy = AntiKickEngine.spawnToy(toyName)
                                    if newToy then
                                        TeamProtectEngine.friendToys[friendPlr.Name] = newToy
                                        TeamProtectEngine.stickToyToPlayer(newToy, fChar)
                                    end
                                else
                                    local sp = existingToy:FindFirstChild("StickyPart")
                                    local torso = fChar:FindFirstChild("Torso") or fChar:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or fHrp
                                    if sp and torso and (sp.Position - torso.Position).Magnitude > 2 then
                                        TeamProtectEngine.stickToyToPlayer(existingToy, fChar)
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            -- 2. Anti-Grab МГНОВЕННОЕ спасение тиммейта
                            if SETTINGS.TeamAntiGrab and myHrp then
                                local isHeldVal = friendPlr:FindFirstChild("IsHeld") or fChar:FindFirstChild("IsHeld")
                                local isGrabbed = (isHeldVal and (isHeldVal.Value == true or isHeldVal.Value == 1))
                                    or (fChar:GetAttribute("IsHeld") == true)
                                    or TeamProtectEngine.checkIsGrabbed(fChar)
                                    or (AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(fChar) ~= nil)

                                if isGrabbed then
                                    local now = tick()
                                    if now - (TeamProtectEngine.lastRescueTick[friendPlr.Name] or 0) > 0.08 then
                                        TeamProtectEngine.lastRescueTick[friendPlr.Name] = now

                                        local ge = RS:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents")
                                        local destroyLine = ge and ge:FindFirstChild("DestroyGrabLine")
                                        local ce = RS:FindFirstChild("CharacterEvents")
                                        local struggleEvent = ce and ce:FindFirstChild("Struggle")
                                        local ragdollRemote = ce and ce:FindFirstChild("RagdollRemote")

                                        local grabberName = AntiGrabEngine.getGrabberName(fChar)

                                        -- 1. Снимаем линии захвата со ВСЕХ частей тела друга
                                        if destroyLine then
                                            for _, p in ipairs(fChar:GetChildren()) do
                                                if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                                                    pcall(function() destroyLine:FireServer(p) end)
                                                end
                                            end

                                            -- Снимаем линии с захватчика (врага)
                                            if grabberName then
                                                local gp = Players:FindFirstChild(grabberName)
                                                local gc = gp and gp.Character
                                                if gc then
                                                    for _, p in ipairs(gc:GetChildren()) do
                                                        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                                                            pcall(function() destroyLine:FireServer(p) end)
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end

                                            -- Уничтожаем любые GrabLine в workspace
                                            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                                                if obj.Name == "GrabLine" or obj.Name:find("GrabLine") then
                                                    pcall(function() destroyLine:FireServer(obj) end)
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end

                                        -- 2. Выводим друга из рэгдолла и вызываем Struggle
                                        if struggleEvent then
                                            pcall(function()
                                                struggleEvent:FireServer(friendPlr)
                                                struggleEvent:FireServer(fChar)
                                                struggleEvent:FireServer()
                                            end)
                                        end
                                        if ragdollRemote and fHrp then
                                            pcall(function() ragdollRemote:FireServer(fHrp, 0) end)
                                        end

                                        -- 3. Телепорт-спасение (если включено и друг далеко)
                                        local dist = (myHrp.Position - fHrp.Position).Magnitude
                                        if dist > 8 and SETTINGS.TeamTeleportRescue then
                                            local oldPos = myHrp.CFrame
                                            pcall(function()
                                                myHrp.CFrame = fHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                                            end)
                                            task.wait(0.02)
                                            if destroyLine then
                                                for _, p in ipairs(fChar:GetChildren()) do
                                                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                                                        pcall(function() destroyLine:FireServer(p) end)
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if struggleEvent then
                                                pcall(function() struggleEvent:FireServer(friendPlr) end)
                                            end
                                            task.wait(0.02)
                                            pcall(function()
                                                myHrp.CFrame = oldPos
                                            end)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.04)
        end
    end)
end

function TeamProtectEngine.stop()
    TeamProtectEngine.active = false
    if TeamProtectEngine.taskHandle then
        task.cancel(TeamProtectEngine.taskHandle)
        TeamProtectEngine.taskHandle = nil
    end
    TeamProtectEngine.clearToys()
end

local LoopKillEngine = {
    active = false,
    taskHandle = nil,
    lastKilledChar = {},
    lastAttackTick = {}
}

function LoopKillEngine.killTarget(targetPlr)
    if not targetPlr or targetPlr == LocalPlayer then return end
    local tChar = targetPlr.Character
    if not tChar then return end
    local tRoot = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or tChar:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    local tHum = tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (tRoot and tHum and tHum.Health > 0) then return end

    -- Если цель уже летит высоко в стратосфере (> 1200) или уже в войде (< -300) - не трогаем
    if tRoot.Position.Y > 1200 or tRoot.Position.Y < -300 then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local ge = RS:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents")
    local ce = RS:FindFirstChild("CharacterEvents")
    local setOwner = ge and ge:FindFirstChild("SetNetworkOwner")
    local createLine = ge and ge:FindFirstChild("CreateGrabLine")
    local destroyLine = ge and ge:FindFirstChild("DestroyGrabLine")
    local ragdollRemote = ce and ce:FindFirstChild("RagdollRemote")

    pcall(function()
        -- 1. Сохраняем ТОЧНУЮ позицию, где мы находились прямо перед этим нападением
        local returnCF = myRoot.CFrame

        -- 2. Телепортируемся вплотную к цели
        myRoot.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 2.5)
        myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        task.wait(0.06)

        -- 3. Спам сетевого овнершипа (8 раз для гарантированного захвата)
        if setOwner then
            for i = 1, 8 do
                setOwner:FireServer(tRoot, tRoot.CFrame)
                task.wait(0.01)
            end
        end

        -- 4. Переводим цель в регдолл на сервере
        if ragdollRemote then
            pcall(function() ragdollRemote:FireServer(tRoot, 0) end)
        end

        -- 5. Запуск линии захвата в небеса на высоту 1e8 студов
        if createLine then
            createLine:FireServer(tRoot, CFrame.new(tRoot.Position.X, 1e8, tRoot.Position.Z))
        end
        task.wait(0.02)

        if destroyLine then
            for i = 1, 3 do
                destroyLine:FireServer(tRoot)
                task.wait(0.01)
            end
        end

        -- 6. Мощнейший физический импульс в стратосферу
        pcall(function()
            tRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position.X, tRoot.Position.Y + 80, tRoot.Position.Z)
            tRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 1e8, 0)

            local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "StratosphereFling"
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 1e8, 0)
            bv.P = 1e6
            bv.Parent = tRoot
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(bv, 0.8)

            local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
            bav.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
            bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(600, 600, 600)
            bav.P = 1e6
            bav.Parent = tRoot
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(bav, 0.8)
        end)

        task.wait(0.05)

        -- 7. Возврат строго на место, где мы были перед телепортацией
        if myRoot and myRoot.Parent and returnCF then
            myRoot.CFrame = returnCF
            myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end

        LoopKillEngine.lastKilledChar[targetPlr.Name] = tChar
        LoopKillEngine.lastAttackTick[targetPlr.Name] = tick()
    end)
end

function LoopKillEngine.start()
    LoopKillEngine.stop()
    LoopKillEngine.active = true
    LoopKillEngine.lastKilledChar = {}
    LoopKillEngine.lastAttackTick = {}

    LoopKillEngine.taskHandle = task.spawn(function()
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        while LoopKillEngine.active do
            if SETTINGS.LoopKill then
                local now = tick()
                local targets = {}
                if SETTINGS.TargetPlayer == "All Players" or SETTINGS.SelectedTargets["All Players"] then
                    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(targets, p) end
                    end
                else
                    for pName, isSel in pairs(SETTINGS.SelectedTargets) do
                        if isSel then
                            local p = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
                            if p and p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(targets, p) end
                        end
                    end
                end

                for _, tPlr in ipairs(targets) do
                    if not (LoopKillEngine.active and SETTINGS.LoopKill) then break end
                    local pName = tPlr.Name
                    if tPlr.Character then
                        local tChar = tPlr.Character
                        local tHum = tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local tRoot = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or tChar:FindFirstChild("Torso")

                        if tHum and tHum.Health > 0 and tRoot then
                            local isNewChar = (LoopKillEngine.lastKilledChar[pName] ~= tChar)
                            local timeSinceAttack = now - (LoopKillEngine.lastAttackTick[pName] or 0)
                            local isStillGrounded = (tRoot.Position.Y < 600 and tRoot.Position.Y > -100)

                            if isNewChar or (timeSinceAttack > 3.0 and isStillGrounded) then
                                if isNewChar then
                                    task.wait(0.35)
                                end
                                if LoopKillEngine.active and SETTINGS.LoopKill then
                                    LoopKillEngine.killTarget(tPlr)
                                    task.wait(0.08)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
    end)
end

function LoopKillEngine.killSelected()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    if SETTINGS.TargetPlayer == "All Players" or SETTINGS.SelectedTargets["All Players"] then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer then
                LoopKillEngine.killTarget(p)
                task.wait(0.08)
            end
        end
    else
        for pName, isSel in pairs(SETTINGS.SelectedTargets) do
            if isSel then
                local tPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
                if tPlr and tPlr ~= LocalPlayer then
                    LoopKillEngine.killTarget(tPlr)
                    task.wait(0.08)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function LoopKillEngine.stop()
    LoopKillEngine.active = false
    if LoopKillEngine.taskHandle then
        task.cancel(LoopKillEngine.taskHandle)
        LoopKillEngine.taskHandle = nil
    end
    LoopKillEngine.lastKilledChar = {}
    LoopKillEngine.lastAttackTick = {}
end

-- ================================================================================
-- [ RAGDOLL KICK ENGINE (TARGET TAB POOPHUB METHOD: REPOSITION, AP/AO & DESYNC KICK) ]
-- ================================================================================

local LimbOffsetsRL = {
    Head = CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0),
    ["Left Arm"] = CFrame.new(-1.5, 0, 0),
    ["Right Arm"] = CFrame.new(1.5, 0, 0),
    ["Left Leg"] = CFrame.new(-0.5, -2, 0),
    ["Right Leg"] = CFrame.new(0.5, -2, 0),
    Torso = CFrame.new(),
    HumanoidRootPart = CFrame.new()
}

local RagdollKickEngine = {
    active = false,
    savedPos = nil,
    holding = {},
    kicked = {},
    mainTask = nil,
    grabInProgress = false
}

local function sendKickNotification(title, content, duration)
    pcall(function()
        if Window and Window.Notify then
            Window:Notify({ Title = title, Content = content, Duration = duration or 3 })
        elseif Library and Library.Notify then
            Library:Notify({ Title = title, Content = content, Duration = duration or 3 })
        end
    end)
end

function RagdollKickEngine.repositionLimbs(char, targetCF)
    if not char then return end
    local baseCF = targetCF or (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame)
    if not baseCF then return end
    for name, offset in pairs(LimbOffsetsRL) do
        local p = char:FindFirstChild(name)
        if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.CFrame = baseCF * offset
            p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            p.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
end

function RagdollKickEngine.attachMovers(part, pos, rotCF)
    if not part then return nil, nil end
    local bp = part:FindFirstChild("ZenithKickAP") or Instance.new("BodyPosition")
    bp.Name = "ZenithKickAP"
    bp.D = 500
    bp.P = 1e6
    bp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bp.Position = pos
    bp.Parent = part

    local bg = part:FindFirstChild("ZenithKickAO") or Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.Name = "ZenithKickAO"
    bg.D = 500
    bg.P = 1e6
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bg.CFrame = rotCF or CFrame.new()
    bg.Parent = part
    return bp, bg
end

function RagdollKickEngine.stripAntiKick(tChar)
    if not tChar then return end
    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local menuToys = RS:FindFirstChild("MenuToys")
    local destroyToy = menuToys and menuToys:FindFirstChild("DestroyToy")

    for _, desc in ipairs(tChar:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc.Name == "StickyPart" and desc.Parent then
            local toy = desc.Parent
            local name = toy.Name
            if name:find("Shuriken") or name:find("Ninja") or name:find("Kunai") or name:find("Pizza") then
                if destroyToy then pcall(function() destroyToy:FireServer(toy) end) end
                pcall(function() toy:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
end

function RagdollKickEngine.cleanupTargetMovers(tChar, tRoot, weldHRP)
    pcall(function()
        if tRoot then
            local bp = tRoot:FindFirstChild("ZenithKickAP")
            if bp then bp:Destroy() end
            local bg = tRoot:FindFirstChild("ZenithKickAO")
            if bg then bg:Destroy() end
            if weldHRP and weldHRP.Parent then
                weldHRP.Enabled = true
            end
        end
        if tChar and tChar.Parent then
            local torso = tChar:FindFirstChild("Torso") or tChar:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            if torso then
                local bp = torso:FindFirstChild("ZenithKickAP")
                if bp then bp:Destroy() end
                local bg = torso:FindFirstChild("ZenithKickAO")
                if bg then bg:Destroy() end
            end
            for _, p in ipairs(tChar:GetChildren()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                    p.CanCollide = true
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

function RagdollKickEngine.releaseTarget(targetPlr)
    if targetPlr then
        RagdollKickEngine.holding[targetPlr] = nil
        if targetPlr.Character then
            local tRoot = targetPlr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local weldHRP = tRoot and tRoot:FindFirstChild("WeldHRP")
            RagdollKickEngine.cleanupTargetMovers(targetPlr.Character, tRoot, weldHRP)
        end
    end
end

function RagdollKickEngine.releaseAll()
    for p in pairs(RagdollKickEngine.holding) do
        RagdollKickEngine.releaseTarget(p)
    end
    RagdollKickEngine.holding = {}
    RagdollKickEngine.savedPos = nil
end

-- [ ОСНОВНОЙ ПАСС СЕТЕВОГО КИКА (TARGET TAB ПООПХАБ МЕТОД) ] --
function RagdollKickEngine.kickPlayer(targetPlr, isLoop)
    if not targetPlr or targetPlr == LocalPlayer or not targetPlr.Parent then return false end
    local tChar = targetPlr.Character
    if not tChar then return false end
    local tRoot = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or tChar:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    local tTorso = tChar:FindFirstChild("Torso") or tChar:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    local tHum = tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (tRoot and tHum and tHum.Health > 0) then return false end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myRoot and myHum and myHum.Health > 0) then return false end

    local inPlot = targetPlr:FindFirstChild("InPlot")
    if inPlot and inPlot.Value == true then
        return false
    end
    local myInPlot = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("InPlot")
    if myInPlot and myInPlot.Value == true then
        sendKickNotification("Kick Warning", "Вы находитесь в привате! Выйдите из зоны для кика.", 3)
        return false
    end

    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local ge = RS:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents")
    local ce = RS:FindFirstChild("CharacterEvents")
    local setOwner = ge and ge:FindFirstChild("SetNetworkOwner")
    local destroyLine = ge and ge:FindFirstChild("DestroyGrabLine")
    local createLine = ge and ge:FindFirstChild("CreateGrabLine")
    local ragdollRemote = ce and ce:FindFirstChild("RagdollRemote")

    RagdollKickEngine.grabInProgress = true
    local kickSuccess = false

    pcall(function()
        -- 1. Снимаем анти-кик сюрикены с цели (DeleteShurInNK)
        if SETTINGS.RemoveAntiKick then
            RagdollKickEngine.stripAntiKick(tChar)
        end

        -- 2. Сбиваем с сиденья
        if tHum.Sit then
            tHum.Sit = false
            local sw = tRoot:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld") or (tTorso and tTorso:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld"))
            if sw then pcall(function() sw:Destroy() end) end
        end

        -- 3. Сохраняем исходную точку возврата
        if not RagdollKickEngine.savedPos then
            RagdollKickEngine.savedPos = myRoot.CFrame
        end
        local returnSpot = RagdollKickEngine.savedPos

        -- 4. Расчет позиции удержания над головой (учитывает слайдер KickHeight)
        local kh = tonumber(SETTINGS.KickHeight) or 20
        local holdCF = returnSpot * CFrame.new(0, kh, 0)
        local handPos = (returnSpot * CFrame.new(0, 1.593, 0)).Position

        -- 5. Подлет к цели если далеко
        if (myRoot.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude > 31 then
            myRoot.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 2)
            myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait(0.04)
        end

        -- 6. Отключаем WeldHRP и коллизии
        local weldHRP = tRoot:FindFirstChild("WeldHRP")
        if weldHRP then weldHRP.Enabled = false end
        for _, p in ipairs(tChar:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
        end

        -- 7. Установка моверов KickAP / KickAO (BodyPosition + BodyGyro) в позицию holdCF
        local bpRoot, bgRoot = RagdollKickEngine.attachMovers(tRoot, holdCF.Position, returnSpot)
        local bpTorso, bgTorso = nil, nil
        if tTorso and tTorso ~= tRoot then
            bpTorso, bgTorso = RagdollKickEngine.attachMovers(tTorso, holdCF.Position, returnSpot)
        end

        -- 8. Сборка конечностей по LimbOffsetsRL
        RagdollKickEngine.repositionLimbs(tChar, holdCF)

        -- 9. Серверный регдолл (RagdollInNK)
        if ragdollRemote then
            pcall(function() ragdollRemote:FireServer(tRoot, 1) end)
            pcall(function() ragdollRemote:FireServer(tRoot, 0) end)
        end

        -- 10. Захват сетевого овнершипа от руки (SetNetworkOwner)
        if setOwner then
            for i = 1, 8 do
                setOwner:FireServer(tRoot, CFrame.new(handPos, tRoot.Position))
                if tTorso and tTorso ~= tRoot then
                    setOwner:FireServer(tTorso, CFrame.new(handPos, tTorso.Position))
                end
                task.wait(0.006)
            end
        end

        -- 11. КЛЮЧЕВОЙ МОМЕНТ: КИК ЧЕРЕЗ СЕТЕВОЙ РАЗРЫВ ЛИНИИ (ReleaseKickOwnership)
        -- В Пупе именно DestroyGrabLine после захвата и смещения вызывает краш/кик физики цели!
        task.wait(0.12)

        -- Экстремальный десинк линии на 3e9 (из Пупа: createGrabLine на 3e9 + DestroyGrabLine)
        if createLine then
            pcall(function()
                createLine:FireServer(tRoot, CFrame.new(3e9, 4e9, 2e9))
                if tTorso and tTorso ~= tRoot then
                    createLine:FireServer(tTorso, CFrame.new(3e9, 4e9, 2e9))
                end
            end)
        end

        task.wait(0.02)

        -- Разрыв линии захвата (unsno / DestroyGrabLine)
        if destroyLine then
            for i = 1, 4 do
                destroyLine:FireServer(tRoot)
                if tTorso and tTorso ~= tRoot then
                    destroyLine:FireServer(tTorso)
                end
                task.wait(0.01)
            end
        end

        -- 12. Фиксация кика в таблицах состояния
        RagdollKickEngine.holding[targetPlr] = true
        RagdollKickEngine.kicked[targetPlr.UserId] = {
            time = tick(),
            char = tChar
        }
        kickSuccess = true

        -- 13. Очистка моверов через 0.45 сек (чтобы игрок не зависал над головой, а вылетал с сервера)
        task.delay(0.45, function()
            RagdollKickEngine.cleanupTargetMovers(tChar, tRoot, weldHRP)
        end)

        task.wait(0.05)

        -- 14. Возврат нашего персонажа на исходную позицию
        if myRoot and myRoot.Parent and returnSpot then
            myRoot.CFrame = returnSpot
            myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end)

    RagdollKickEngine.grabInProgress = false
    return kickSuccess
end

function RagdollKickEngine.getDesiredTargets()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local desired = {}
    if SETTINGS.TargetPlayer == "All Players" or SETTINGS.SelectedTargets["All Players"] then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer then
                local isTeamProt = SETTINGS.TeamProtect and (
                    SETTINGS.TeamProtectedPlayers[p.Name] or 
                    SETTINGS.TeamProtectedPlayers[p.DisplayName] or
                    (p.Team ~= nil and p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team)
                )
                if not isTeamProt then
                    table.insert(desired, p)
                end
            end
        end
    else
        for pName, isSel in pairs(SETTINGS.SelectedTargets) do
            if isSel then
                local p = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
                if p and p ~= LocalPlayer then
                    table.insert(desired, p)
                end
            end
        end
        if #desired == 0 and selectedKickPlayer and selectedKickPlayer.Parent and selectedKickPlayer ~= LocalPlayer then
            table.insert(desired, selectedKickPlayer)
        end
    end
    return desired
end

function RagdollKickEngine.kickSelected()
    local targets = RagdollKickEngine.getDesiredTargets()
    if #targets == 0 then
        sendKickNotification("Kick", "Цель не выбрана! Выберите игрока в списке.", 3)
        return
    end

    sendKickNotification("Kick Selected", "Кикаем " .. tostring(#targets) .. " цел(ей)...", 3)

    task.spawn(function()
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myRoot and not RagdollKickEngine.savedPos then
            RagdollKickEngine.savedPos = myRoot.CFrame
        end

        for _, tPlr in ipairs(targets) do
            if tPlr and tPlr.Parent and tPlr.Character then
                RagdollKickEngine.kickPlayer(tPlr, false)
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end

        if myRoot and myRoot.Parent and RagdollKickEngine.savedPos then
            myRoot.CFrame = RagdollKickEngine.savedPos
            myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            RagdollKickEngine.savedPos = nil
        end

        sendKickNotification("Kick Selected", "Выполнение кика завершено!", 3)
    end)
end

function RagdollKickEngine.start()
    RagdollKickEngine.stop()
    RagdollKickEngine.active = true
    RagdollKickEngine.kicked = {}

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if myRoot then
        RagdollKickEngine.savedPos = myRoot.CFrame
    end

    RagdollKickEngine.mainTask = task.spawn(function()
        while RagdollKickEngine.active do
            local myC = LocalPlayer.Character
            local myR = myC and myC:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local myH = myC and myC:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if myR and myH and myH.Health > 0 and not RagdollKickEngine.grabInProgress then
                local targets = RagdollKickEngine.getDesiredTargets()
                local now = tick()

                for _, tPlr in ipairs(targets) do
                    if not RagdollKickEngine.active then break end
                    if tPlr and tPlr.Parent and tPlr.Character then
                        local tChar = tPlr.Character
                        local tHum = tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local tRoot = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or tChar:FindFirstChild("Torso")

                        if tHum and tHum.Health > 0 and tRoot then
                            local kData = RagdollKickEngine.kicked[tPlr.UserId]
                            local canKick = (not kData) or (kData.char ~= tChar) or (now - kData.time > 4)
                            if canKick then
                                RagdollKickEngine.kickPlayer(tPlr, true)
                                task.wait(0.2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            task.wait(0.15)
        end
    end)
end

function RagdollKickEngine.stop()
    RagdollKickEngine.active = false
    if RagdollKickEngine.mainTask then
        pcall(function() task.cancel(RagdollKickEngine.mainTask) end)
        RagdollKickEngine.mainTask = nil
    end
    RagdollKickEngine.releaseAll()
    RagdollKickEngine.kicked = {}
    RagdollKickEngine.savedPos = nil
    RagdollKickEngine.grabInProgress = false
end

function ANIM_SYSTEM.stop()
    if ANIM_SYSTEM.CurrentTrack then
        pcall(function() ANIM_SYSTEM.CurrentTrack:Stop(0.15) end)
        ANIM_SYSTEM.CurrentTrack = nil
    end
    if ANIM_SYSTEM.AnimConn then
        pcall(function() ANIM_SYSTEM.AnimConn:Disconnect() end)
        ANIM_SYSTEM.AnimConn = nil
    end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if torso then
            local neck = torso:FindFirstChild("Neck") or (char:FindFirstChild("Head") and char.Head:FindFirstChild("Neck"))
            if neck and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.Neck then neck.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.Neck end
            local rs = torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder") or torso:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder")
            if rs and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS then rs.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS end
            local ls = torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder") or torso:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder")
            if ls and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS then ls.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS end
        end
        if hrp then
            local rj = hrp:FindFirstChild("RootJoint")
            if rj and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ then rj.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ end
        end
    end
end

function ANIM_SYSTEM.apply(animName)
    ANIM_SYSTEM.stop()
    if not SETTINGS.PlayerAnimations then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not torso or not hrp then return end

    local selectedData = nil
    for _, item in ipairs(ANIM_SYSTEM.Presets) do
        if item.Name == animName then
            selectedData = item
            break
        end
    end
    if not selectedData then selectedData = ANIM_SYSTEM.Presets[1] end

    -- Сохраняем исходные C0 суставов
    local neck = torso:FindFirstChild("Neck") or (char:FindFirstChild("Head") and char.Head:FindFirstChild("Neck"))
    local rj = hrp:FindFirstChild("RootJoint")
    local rs = torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder") or torso:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder")
    local ls = torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder") or torso:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder")

    if neck and not ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.Neck then ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.Neck = neck.C0 end
    if rj and not ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ then ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ = rj.C0 end
    if rs and not ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS then ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS = rs.C0 end
    if ls and not ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS then ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS = ls.C0 end

    if selectedData.Type == "Track" and (selectedData.Id or selectedData.R15Id) then
        local isR15 = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
        local animId = (isR15 and selectedData.R15Id) or selectedData.Id or selectedData.R15Id
        local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 2)
        if not animator then
            animator = Instance.new("Animator")
            animator.Parent = hum
        end
        local animObj = Instance.new("Animation")
        animObj.AnimationId = animId
        pcall(function()
            local track = nil
            if animator then
                track = animator:LoadAnimation(animObj)
            else
                track = hum:LoadAnimation(animObj)
            end
            if track then
                track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
                track.Looped = true
                track:Play(0.15)
                ANIM_SYSTEM.CurrentTrack = track
            end
        end)
    else
        -- Процедурные FE анимации (100% работают на R6 без блокировок asset ID)
        local angle = 0
        ANIM_SYSTEM.AnimConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not SETTINGS.PlayerAnimations or SETTINGS.CurrentAnimation ~= selectedData.Name then
                ANIM_SYSTEM.stop()
                return
            end
            angle = (angle + dt * 360) % 360

            if selectedData.Type == "FE_HeadSpin" and neck and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.Neck then
                neck.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.Neck * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(angle))
            elseif selectedData.Type == "FE_Helicopter" and rj and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ then
                rj.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(angle))
            elseif selectedData.Type == "FE_Zombie" and rs and ls and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS then
                rs.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
                ls.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -math.rad(90))
            elseif selectedData.Type == "FE_TPose" and rs and ls and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS then
                rs.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
                ls.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS * CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(90), 0, 0)
            elseif selectedData.Type == "FE_Float" and rj and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ then
                local bob = math.sin(tick() * 3) * 0.4
                rj.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.5 + bob)
            elseif selectedData.Type == "FE_Dab" and neck and rs and ls and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.Neck and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS then
                neck.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.Neck * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(25), 0, math.rad(35))
                rs.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(115), 0, math.rad(30))
                ls.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(35), 0, -math.rad(65))
            elseif selectedData.Type == "FE_Floss" then
                local flossTime = tick() * 6
                local flossSin = math.sin(flossTime)
                local flossCos = math.cos(flossTime)
                if rj and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ then
                    rj.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ * CFrame.new(flossSin * 0.35, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -flossSin * 0.2)
                end
                if rs and ls and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS then
                    rs.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -flossSin * 0.9) * CFrame.Angles(flossCos * 0.3, 0, 0)
                    ls.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.LS * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -flossSin * 0.9) * CFrame.Angles(flossCos * 0.3, 0, 0)
                end
            elseif selectedData.Type == "FE_Salute" and rs and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS then
                rs.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RS * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(110), 0, math.rad(45))
                if neck and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.Neck then
                    neck.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.Neck * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -math.rad(10))
                end
            elseif selectedData.Type == "FE_Tilt" and rj and ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ then
                rj.C0 = ANIM_SYSTEM.OrigJoints.RJ * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(35), 0, 0)
            end
        end)
    end
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    if SETTINGS.PlayerAnimations then
        ANIM_SYSTEM.apply(SETTINGS.CurrentAnimation)
    end

function createComet()
    local comet = Instance.new("Part")
    comet.Name = "CardinalComet"
    comet.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 6)
    comet.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    comet.Color = cometColor
    comet.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    comet.Anchored = true
    comet.CanCollide = false
    comet.CastShadow = false
    comet.Position = Vector3.new(
        math.random(-400, 400),
        math.random(200, 350),
        math.random(-400, 400)
    )
    comet.Parent = Workspace
    
    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Color = cometColor
    light.Brightness = 3
    light.Range = 25
    light.Parent = comet
    
    local smoke = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    smoke.Texture = "rbxassetid://258128463"
    smoke.Color = ColorSequence.new(smokeColor)
    smoke.Rate = 60
    smoke.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.5)
    smoke.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 6)
    smoke.Size = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.5), 
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 4)
    })
    smoke.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), 
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
    })
    smoke.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(15, 15)
    smoke.Parent = comet

    local att0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
    att0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -2)
    att0.Parent = comet
    
    local att1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
    att1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, 2)
    att1.Parent = comet
    
    local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
    trail.Attachment0 = att0
    trail.Attachment1 = att1
    trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(cometColor)
    trail.Lifetime = 0.4
    trail.FaceCamera = true
    trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
    trail.Parent = comet

    comet:SetAttribute("Speed", math.random(20, 40) / 10)
    comet:SetAttribute("DirX", math.random(-3, 3) / 10)
    comet:SetAttribute("DirZ", math.random(-3, 3) / 10)
    
    table.insert(activeComets, comet)
    return comet
end

function createLightning()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local basePos
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position
        basePos = Vector3.new(
            hrp.X + math.random(-200, 200),
            0,
            hrp.Z + math.random(-200, 200)
        )
    else
        basePos = Vector3.new(math.random(-200, 200), 0, math.random(-200, 200))
    end
    
    local startY = math.random(180, 280)
    local startPos = Vector3.new(basePos.X + math.random(-30, 30), startY, basePos.Z + math.random(-30, 30))
    local endPos = basePos + Vector3.new(0, math.random(0, 10), 0)
    
    local boltFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    boltFolder.Name = "CardinalLightningBolt"
    boltFolder.Parent = Workspace
    table.insert(activeLightnings, boltFolder)
    
    local segments = {}
    local numSegs = math.random(10, 18)
    local prevPos = startPos
    
    for i = 1, numSegs do
        local t = i / numSegs
        local nextPos = startPos:Lerp(endPos, t)
        if i < numSegs then
            local offset = (1 - t) * 40
            nextPos = nextPos + Vector3.new(math.random(-offset, offset), 0, math.random(-offset, offset))
        end
        
        local seg = Instance.new("Part")
        seg.Name = "Segment"
        seg.Anchored = true
        seg.CanCollide = false
        seg.CastShadow = false
        seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        seg.Color = lightningColor
        
        local dir = (nextPos - prevPos)
        local dist = dir.Magnitude
        local thickness = math.random(3, 6) / 10
        seg.Size = Vector3.new(thickness, thickness, dist)
        seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(prevPos, nextPos) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -dist / 2)
        seg.Parent = boltFolder
        
        local glow = Instance.new("PointLight")
        glow.Color = lightningColor
        glow.Brightness = 8
        glow.Range = 40
        glow.Parent = seg
        
        table.insert(segments, seg)
        prevPos = nextPos
    end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        for _ = 1, 4 do
            for _, seg in pairs(segments) do
                if seg and seg.Parent then seg.Transparency = 0.6 end
            end
            task.wait(0.04)
            for _, seg in pairs(segments) do
                if seg and seg.Parent then seg.Transparency = 0 end
            end
            task.wait(0.06)
        end
        for fade = 0, 1, 0.15 do
            for _, seg in pairs(segments) do
                if seg and seg.Parent then seg.Transparency = fade end
            end
            task.wait(0.03)
        end
        pcall(function() boltFolder:Destroy() end)
        for idx, folder in pairs(activeLightnings) do
            if folder == boltFolder then
                table.remove(activeLightnings, idx)
                break
            end
        end
    end)
    
    return boltFolder
end

-- Цикл движения комет
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    for i = #activeComets, 1, -1 do
        local comet = activeComets[i]
        if comet and comet.Parent then
            local speed = comet:GetAttribute("Speed") or 2
            local dirX = comet:GetAttribute("DirX") or 0
            local dirZ = comet:GetAttribute("DirZ") or 0
            comet.Position = comet.Position + Vector3.new(dirX * speed, -speed, dirZ * speed)
            comet.CFrame = comet.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0.04, 0.02, 0.01)
            if comet.Position.Y < -20 then
                pcall(function() comet:Destroy() end)
                table.remove(activeComets, i)
            end
        else
            table.remove(activeComets, i)
        end
    end
end)

-- Спавн эффектов погоды
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.5)
        if weatherRunning then
            if weatherMode == "Кометы" or weatherMode == "Оба" then
                for _ = 1, math.ceil(cometsPerSecond / 2) do
                    pcall(createComet)
                end
            end
            if weatherMode == "Молнии" or weatherMode == "Оба" then
                if math.random(1, 10) <= lightningsPerSecond then
                    pcall(createLightning)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function cleanupWeather()
    weatherRunning = false
    for _, obj in pairs(activeComets) do pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
    for _, obj in pairs(activeLightnings) do pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
    activeComets = {}
    activeLightnings = {}
end
getgenv().CleanupCardinalWeather = cleanupWeather
LocalPlayer.AncestryChanged:Connect(cleanupWeather)

-- ================================================================================
-- [ ULTRA HIGH-PERFORMANCE ANTI-LAG ENGINE (150-200+ FPS) ]
-- ================================================================================
local AntiLagEngine = {
    active = false,
    cleanConn = nil,
    origShadows = true
}

function AntiLagEngine.applyBoost()
    pcall(function()
        if setfpscap then
            setfpscap(240)
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local settingsObj = settings()
        if settingsObj and settingsObj.Rendering then
            settingsObj.Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level10
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        AntiLagEngine.origShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        Lighting.FogEnd = 9e9
        for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("PostEffect") and not v.Name:find("Xenon") then
                v.Enabled = false
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local Terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
        if Terrain then
            Terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
            Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
            Terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
        end
    end)
end

function AntiLagEngine.restore()
    pcall(function()
        local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = AntiLagEngine.origShadows
        for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("PostEffect") and not v.Name:find("Xenon") then
                v.Enabled = true
            end
        end
    end)
end

function AntiLagEngine.start()
    AntiLagEngine.stop()
    AntiLagEngine.active = true
    SETTINGS.AntiLag = true
    AntiLagEngine.applyBoost()

    AntiLagEngine.cleanConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not AntiLagEngine.active then return end
        if math.random(1, 180) == 1 then
            pcall(function()
                local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
                Lighting.FogEnd = 9e9
            end)
        end
    end)
    if getgenv().XenonConnections then
        table.insert(getgenv().XenonConnections, AntiLagEngine.cleanConn)
    end
end

function AntiLagEngine.stop()
    AntiLagEngine.active = false
    SETTINGS.AntiLag = false
    if AntiLagEngine.cleanConn then
        AntiLagEngine.cleanConn:Disconnect()
        AntiLagEngine.cleanConn = nil
    end
    AntiLagEngine.restore()
end

    task.wait(0.5)
    if SETTINGS.AntiLag then
        AntiLagEngine.start()
    end
end)

-- ================================================================================
-- [ TARGET ESP & TRACER SYSTEM (GREEN CHAMS + TRACERS + TARGET SELECTOR) ]
-- ================================================================================
TargetVisualsEngine = {
    tracer = nil,
    highlight = nil,
    currentTargetChar = nil,
    connections = {},
}

function TargetVisualsEngine.clearHighlight()
    if TargetVisualsEngine.highlight then
        pcall(function() TargetVisualsEngine.highlight:Destroy() end)
        TargetVisualsEngine.highlight = nil
    end
    TargetVisualsEngine.currentTargetChar = nil
end

function TargetVisualsEngine.init()
    if Drawing and Drawing.new then
        pcall(function()
            local tr = Drawing.new("Line")
            tr.Thickness = 1.8
            tr.Color = SETTINGS.TargetESP_Color or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
            tr.Transparency = 1
            tr.Visible = false
            TargetVisualsEngine.tracer = tr
        end)
    end

    local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        TargetVisualsEngine.step()
    end)
    table.insert(TargetVisualsEngine.connections, conn)
    table.insert(getgenv().XenonConnections, conn)
end

function TargetVisualsEngine.step()
    local isEnabled = SETTINGS.TargetESP_Enabled
    local tracer = TargetVisualsEngine.tracer

    if not isEnabled then
        TargetVisualsEngine.clearHighlight()
        if tracer then tracer.Visible = false end
        return
    end

    local targetName = (SETTINGS.TargetESP_Player and SETTINGS.TargetESP_Player ~= "" and SETTINGS.TargetESP_Player)
        or (SETTINGS.TargetPlayer and SETTINGS.TargetPlayer ~= "" and SETTINGS.TargetPlayer ~= "All Players" and SETTINGS.TargetPlayer)

    if not targetName or targetName == "" then
        TargetVisualsEngine.clearHighlight()
        if tracer then tracer.Visible = false end
        return
    end

    local targetPlayer = Players:FindFirstChild(targetName)
    local targetChar = targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character
    local hrp = targetChar and (targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or targetChar:FindFirstChild("Torso") or targetChar:FindFirstChild("Head"))
    local hum = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not targetChar or not hrp or (hum and hum.Health <= 0) then
        TargetVisualsEngine.clearHighlight()
        if tracer then tracer.Visible = false end
        return
    end

    -- 1. Зеленый Чамс подсветка цели (отдельно от обычного чамс)
    if SETTINGS.TargetESP_Chams then
        if TargetVisualsEngine.currentTargetChar ~= targetChar or not TargetVisualsEngine.highlight or not TargetVisualsEngine.highlight.Parent then
            TargetVisualsEngine.clearHighlight()
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "XenonTargetGreenChams"
            hl.FillColor = SETTINGS.TargetESP_Color or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
            hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.35
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.05
            hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            hl.Adornee = targetChar
            pcall(function() hl.Parent = targetChar end)
            TargetVisualsEngine.highlight = hl
            TargetVisualsEngine.currentTargetChar = targetChar
        end
        if TargetVisualsEngine.highlight then
            TargetVisualsEngine.highlight.Enabled = true
        end
    else
        TargetVisualsEngine.clearHighlight()
    end

    -- 2. Трекеры (Tracers) к игроку
    if SETTINGS.TargetESP_Tracers and tracer then
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera
        local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
        if onScreen then
            tracer.From = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y)
            tracer.To = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
            tracer.Color = SETTINGS.TargetESP_Color or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
            tracer.Visible = true
        else
            tracer.Visible = false
        end
    else
        if tracer then tracer.Visible = false end
    end
end

-- ================================================================================
-- [ VEHICLE SEAT AUTO-MUSIC: TRACTOR ("Я трактор") & SLED ("Дедо мразь") ]
-- ================================================================================
local VehicleMusicEngine = {
    tractorSound = nil,
    sledSound = nil,
    blobSound = nil
}

function VehicleMusicEngine.init()
    pcall(function()
        for _, s in ipairs(SoundService:GetChildren()) do
            if s:IsA("Sound") and (s.Name:find("XenonTractorMusic") or s.Name:find("XenonSledMusic") or s.Name:find("XenonBlobMusic")) then
                s:Stop()
                s:Destroy()
            end
        end
        if getgenv()._XenonVehicleSeatedConn then
            getgenv()._XenonVehicleSeatedConn:Disconnect()
            getgenv()._XenonVehicleSeatedConn = nil
        end
        if getgenv()._XenonVehicleCharConn then
            getgenv()._XenonVehicleCharConn:Disconnect()
            getgenv()._XenonVehicleCharConn = nil
        end
    end)

    local function getTractorSound()
        if VehicleMusicEngine.tractorSound and VehicleMusicEngine.tractorSound.Parent then
            return VehicleMusicEngine.tractorSound
        end
        local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
        snd.Name = "XenonTractorMusic"
        snd.Volume = 1.0
        snd.Looped = false
        snd.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
        snd.MaxDistance = 250
        snd.EmitterSize = 20

        local asset = nil
        pcall(function()
            if getcustomasset or getsynasset then
                local getAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
                if isfile and isfile("tractor_song.mp3") then
                    asset = getAsset("tractor_song.mp3")
                elseif isfile and isfile("silirada-ya-traktor-viganyayu.mp3") then
                    asset = getAsset("silirada-ya-traktor-viganyayu.mp3")
                end
            end
        end)
        if asset then
            snd.SoundId = asset
        end
        snd.Parent = SoundService
        VehicleMusicEngine.tractorSound = snd
        return snd
    end

    local function getSledSound()
        if VehicleMusicEngine.sledSound and VehicleMusicEngine.sledSound.Parent then
            return VehicleMusicEngine.sledSound
        end
        local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
        snd.Name = "XenonSledMusic"
        snd.Volume = 1.8
        snd.Looped = true
        snd.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
        snd.MaxDistance = 300
        snd.EmitterSize = 25

        local asset = nil
        pcall(function()
            if getcustomasset or getsynasset then
                local getAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
                if isfile and isfile("sled_song.mp3") then
                    asset = getAsset("sled_song.mp3")
                end
            end
        end)
        if asset then
            snd.SoundId = asset
        end
        snd.Parent = SoundService
        VehicleMusicEngine.sledSound = snd
        return snd
    end

    local function getBlobSound()
        if VehicleMusicEngine.blobSound and VehicleMusicEngine.blobSound.Parent then
            return VehicleMusicEngine.blobSound
        end
        local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
        snd.Name = "XenonBlobMusic"
        snd.Volume = 2.0
        snd.Looped = false
        snd.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
        snd.MaxDistance = 250
        snd.EmitterSize = 20

        local asset = nil
        pcall(function()
            if getcustomasset or getsynasset then
                local getAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
                if isfile and isfile("vtoruyu.mp3") then
                    asset = getAsset("vtoruyu.mp3")
                elseif isfile and isfile("blobman.mp3") then
                    asset = getAsset("blobman.mp3")
                elseif isfile and isfile("derzhis.mp3") then
                    asset = getAsset("derzhis.mp3")
                elseif isfile and isfile("vtoraya.mp3") then
                    asset = getAsset("vtoraya.mp3")
                end
            end
        end)
        if asset then
            snd.SoundId = asset
        end
        snd.Parent = SoundService
        VehicleMusicEngine.blobSound = snd
        return snd
    end

    local function setupChar(char)
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8)
        if not hum then return end

        local seatedConn = hum.Seated:Connect(function(isSeated, seatPart)
            local tractorSnd = getTractorSound()
            local sledSnd = getSledSound()
            local blobSnd = getBlobSound()

            if isSeated and seatPart then
                local isTractor = false
                local isSled = false
                local isBlob = false

                local cur = seatPart
                while cur and cur ~= workspace do
                    local n = cur.Name:lower()
                    if n:find("blob") or n:find("блуб") or n:find("creature") then
                        isBlob = true
                        break
                    elseif n:find("sled") or n:find("sleigh") or n:find("сани") or n:find("санк") or n:find("toboggan") or n:find("snow") then
                        isSled = true
                        break
                    elseif n:find("tractor") or n:find("трактор") or n:find("farm") then
                        isTractor = true
                        break
                    end
                    cur = cur.Parent
                end

                if not isTractor and not isSled and not isBlob then
                    local pName = (seatPart.Parent and seatPart.Parent.Name:lower()) or ""
                    if pName:find("blob") or pName:find("блуб") or pName:find("creature") then
                        isBlob = true
                    elseif not pName:find("tractor") and not pName:find("chair") and not pName:find("daycare") then
                        isSled = true
                    end
                end

                if isBlob then
                    pcall(function()
                        if tractorSnd then tractorSnd:Stop() end
                        if sledSnd then sledSnd:Stop() end
                        if blobSnd then
                            blobSnd.TimePosition = 0
                            blobSnd:Play()
                        end
                    end)
                elseif isSled then
                    pcall(function()
                        if tractorSnd then tractorSnd:Stop() end
                        if blobSnd then blobSnd:Stop() end
                        if sledSnd then
                            sledSnd.TimePosition = 0
                            sledSnd:Play()
                        end
                    end)
                elseif isTractor then
                    pcall(function()
                        if sledSnd then sledSnd:Stop() end
                        if blobSnd then blobSnd:Stop() end
                        if tractorSnd then
                            tractorSnd.TimePosition = 0
                            tractorSnd:Play()
                        end
                    end)
                end
            else
                pcall(function()
                    if tractorSnd then tractorSnd:Stop() end
                    if sledSnd then sledSnd:Stop() end
                    if blobSnd then blobSnd:Stop() end
                end)
            end
        end)
        getgenv()._XenonVehicleSeatedConn = seatedConn
    end

    if LocalPlayer.Character then task.spawn(setupChar, LocalPlayer.Character) end
    getgenv()._XenonVehicleCharConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupChar)
end

task.spawn(function()
    pcall(VehicleMusicEngine.init)
end)

-- ================================================================================
-- [ CHAIR SPAWN AUDIO ENGINE: "Разъезд ЧУШПАНЫ!" (STUDIO CLEAN V4) ]
-- ================================================================================
local ChairSpawnAudioEngine = {
    soundInstance = nil,
    lastPlayTick = 0
}

function ChairSpawnAudioEngine.init()
    -- Принудительно очищаем старые звуки из SoundService при перезапуске скрипта
    pcall(function()
        for _, s in ipairs(SoundService:GetChildren()) do
            if s:IsA("Sound") and (s.Name:find("Xenon") or s.Name:find("Chushpany") or s.Name:find("Razjezd")) then
                s:Stop()
                s:Destroy()
            end
        end
        if getgenv()._XenonChairConn then
            getgenv()._XenonChairConn:Disconnect()
            getgenv()._XenonChairConn = nil
        end
        if getgenv()._XenonChairWSConn then
            getgenv()._XenonChairWSConn:Disconnect()
            getgenv()._XenonChairWSConn = nil
        end
    end)

    local function getSound()
        if ChairSpawnAudioEngine.soundInstance and ChairSpawnAudioEngine.soundInstance.Parent then
            return ChairSpawnAudioEngine.soundInstance
        end
        local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
        snd.Name = "XenonRazjezdSoundV4"
        snd.Volume = 2.2
        snd.Looped = false

        local asset = nil
        pcall(function()
            if getcustomasset or getsynasset then
                local getAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
                if isfile and isfile("razjezd_v4.mp3") then
                    asset = getAsset("razjezd_v4.mp3")
                elseif isfile and isfile("razjezd_clean.mp3") then
                    asset = getAsset("razjezd_clean.mp3")
                elseif isfile and isfile("chushpany.mp3") then
                    asset = getAsset("chushpany.mp3")
                end
            end
        end)
        if asset then
            snd.SoundId = asset
        end
        snd.Parent = SoundService
        ChairSpawnAudioEngine.soundInstance = snd
        return snd
    end

    local function checkAndPlay(toy)
        if not toy then return false end
        if tick() - ChairSpawnAudioEngine.lastPlayTick < 0.5 then return false end

        local n = toy.Name:lower()
        local isChair = false

        -- Исключаем транспорт, ракеты, оружие и шары, чтобы звук не играл на посторонних предметах
        local isExcluded = n:find("car") or n:find("vehicle") or n:find("tractor") 
            or n:find("sleigh") or n:find("heli") or n:find("plane") or n:find("missile") 
            or n:find("balloon") or n:find("blobman") or n:find("katana") or n:find("sword") 
            or n:find("gun") or n:find("clock") or n:find("ball") or n:find("cleaver") 
            or n:find("fork") or n:find("pencil") or n:find("kunai") or n:find("shuriken")
            or n:find("bomb") or n:find("grenade")

        if not isExcluded then
            -- 1. Распознавание мебели, стульев и Daycare Box Thing (синий предмет со скриншота)
            if n:find("daycare") or n:find("box thing") or n:find("boxthing")
                or n:find("chair") or n:find("стул") or n:find("кресл") 
                or n:find("seat") or n:find("stool") or n:find("armchair") 
                or n:find("recliner") or n:find("bench") or n:find("sofa") or n:find("couch") then
                isChair = true
            -- 2. Если внутри есть объект класса Seat (сиденье)
            elseif toy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Seat", true) then
                isChair = true
            -- 3. Точная проверка синего стула (media_1792677268860.png): предмет полностью/преимущественно синий
            else
                local totalParts = 0
                local blueParts = 0
                for _, p in ipairs(toy:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                        totalParts = totalParts + 1
                        local c = p.Color
                        if c.B > 0.45 and c.R < 0.35 and c.G < 0.45 then
                            blueParts = blueParts + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
                if totalParts > 0 and (blueParts / totalParts) >= 0.7 then
                    isChair = true
                end
            end
        end

        if isChair then
            ChairSpawnAudioEngine.lastPlayTick = tick()
            local snd = getSound()
            if snd then
                pcall(function()
                    snd.TimePosition = 0
                    if SoundService.PlayLocalSound then
                        SoundService:PlayLocalSound(snd)
                    else
                        snd:Play()
                    end
                end)
            end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    local function hookFolder(folder)
        if not folder then return end
        if getgenv()._XenonChairConn then
            pcall(function() getgenv()._XenonChairConn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        getgenv()._XenonChairConn = folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.05)
                if not checkAndPlay(child) then
                    task.wait(0.15)
                    checkAndPlay(child)
                end
            end)
        end)
    end

    local invName = LocalPlayer.Name .. "SpawnedInToys"
    local curInv = workspace:FindFirstChild(invName)
    if curInv then
        hookFolder(curInv)
    end

    getgenv()._XenonChairWSConn = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child.Name == invName then
            hookFolder(child)
        end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    pcall(ChairSpawnAudioEngine.init)
end)

HalloweenEngine = {
    active = false,
    savedLighting = {},
    effectsFolder = nil,
