function HalloweenEngine.saveLighting()
    HalloweenEngine.savedLighting = {
        ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
        Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
        Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
        OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
        FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
        FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
        FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
        ExposureCompensation = Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
        GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
        ShadowSoftness = Lighting.ShadowSoftness,
    }
end

function HalloweenEngine.restoreLighting()
    local s = HalloweenEngine.savedLighting
    if s and s.ClockTime ~= nil then
        pcall(function()
            Lighting.ClockTime = s.ClockTime
            Lighting.Brightness = s.Brightness
            Lighting.Ambient = s.Ambient
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = s.OutdoorAmbient
            Lighting.FogColor = s.FogColor
            Lighting.FogStart = s.FogStart
            Lighting.FogEnd = s.FogEnd
            Lighting.ExposureCompensation = s.ExposureCompensation or 0
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = (s.GlobalShadows ~= nil) and s.GlobalShadows or true
            Lighting.ShadowSoftness = s.ShadowSoftness or 0.5
        end)
    end
end

function HalloweenEngine.applyShaders()
    if not SETTINGS.HalloweenShaders then return end

    -- Освещение: значительно светлее, теплая золотисто-багряная гамма, четкая видимость карты
    pcall(function()
        Lighting.ClockTime = 19.2
        Lighting.Brightness = 2.4
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(115, 80, 60)
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(95, 70, 85)
        Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(68, 38, 22)
        Lighting.FogStart = 65
        Lighting.FogEnd = 700
        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0.08
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
        Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.35
    end)

    local oldFolder = Lighting:FindFirstChild("XenonHalloweenEffects")
    if oldFolder then pcall(function() oldFolder:Destroy() end) end

    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "XenonHalloweenEffects"
    folder.Parent = Lighting
    HalloweenEngine.effectsFolder = folder

    -- 1. ColorCorrectionEffect (сочные тыквенные цвета, светлые тени)
    local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
    cc.Name = "HalloweenColorCorrection"
    cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 228, 200)
    cc.Contrast = 0.12
    cc.Saturation = 0.38
    cc.Brightness = 0.04
    cc.Parent = folder

    -- 2. BloomEffect (мягкое теплое свечение)
    local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
    bloom.Name = "HalloweenBloom"
    bloom.Intensity = 0.55
    bloom.Size = 22
    bloom.Threshold = 0.85
    bloom.Parent = folder

    -- 3. SunRaysEffect (лучи заката / луны)
    local rays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
    rays.Name = "HalloweenSunRays"
    rays.Intensity = 0.16
    rays.Spread = 0.65
    rays.Parent = folder

    -- 4. Atmosphere (осенняя дымка)
    local atmo = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
    atmo.Name = "HalloweenAtmosphere"
    atmo.Density = 0.28
    atmo.Offset = 0.15
    atmo.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 115, 40)
    atmo.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(80, 35, 45)
    atmo.Glare = 0.3
    atmo.Haze = 1.5
    atmo.Parent = folder

    -- 5. Sky (зловещее сумеречное небо)
    local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
    sky.Name = "HalloweenSky"
    sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://5837267789"
    sky.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://5837267593"
    sky.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://5837267980"
    sky.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://5837268153"
    sky.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://5837268341"
    sky.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://5837268524"
    sky.StarCount = 4000
    sky.SunAngularSize = 12
    sky.MoonAngularSize = 20
    sky.Parent = folder
end

function HalloweenEngine.removeShaders()
    if HalloweenEngine.effectsFolder then
        pcall(function() HalloweenEngine.effectsFolder:Destroy() end)
        HalloweenEngine.effectsFolder = nil
    end
    local ef = Lighting:FindFirstChild("XenonHalloweenEffects")
    if ef then pcall(function() ef:Destroy() end) end
    HalloweenEngine.restoreLighting()
end

-- ==================== [ ЗЛАЯ ЛУНА-ТЫКВА В НЕБЕ ] ====================
function HalloweenEngine.createPumpkinMoon()
    HalloweenEngine.removePumpkinMoon()
    if not SETTINGS.HalloweenMoon then return end

    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera
    local moonModel = Instance.new("Model")
    moonModel.Name = "XenonPumpkinMoon"
    moonModel.Parent = Workspace
    HalloweenEngine.moonModel = moonModel

    local moonBody = Instance.new("Part")
    moonBody.Name = "MoonBody"
    moonBody.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    moonBody.Size = Vector3.new(65, 65, 65)
    moonBody.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 18)
    moonBody.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    moonBody.Transparency = 0.02
    moonBody.Anchored = true
    moonBody.CanCollide = false
    moonBody.CastShadow = false
    moonBody.Parent = moonModel
    moonModel.PrimaryPart = moonBody

    local function makeEye(side)
        local eye = Instance.new("Part")
        eye.Name = "Eye_" .. side
        eye.Size = Vector3.new(12, 10, 2)
        eye.Color = Color3.fromRGB(22, 6, 2)
        eye.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        eye.Anchored = true
        eye.CanCollide = false
        eye.CastShadow = false
        eye.Parent = moonModel

        local pupil = Instance.new("Part")
        pupil.Name = "Pupil_" .. side
        pupil.Size = Vector3.new(7, 6, 3)
        pupil.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 100)
        pupil.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        pupil.Anchored = true
        pupil.CanCollide = false
        pupil.CastShadow = false
        pupil.Parent = moonModel
        return eye, pupil
    end

    local leftEye, leftPupil = makeEye("L")
    local rightEye, rightPupil = makeEye("R")

    local mouth = Instance.new("Part")
    mouth.Name = "MoonMouth"
    mouth.Size = Vector3.new(28, 9, 2)
    mouth.Color = Color3.fromRGB(22, 6, 2)
    mouth.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    mouth.Anchored = true
    mouth.CanCollide = false
    mouth.CastShadow = false
    mouth.Parent = moonModel

    local mouthGlow = Instance.new("Part")
    mouthGlow.Name = "MoonMouthGlow"
    mouthGlow.Size = Vector3.new(22, 5, 2.5)
    mouthGlow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60)
    mouthGlow.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    mouthGlow.Anchored = true
    mouthGlow.CanCollide = false
    mouthGlow.CastShadow = false
    mouthGlow.Parent = moonModel

    local stem = Instance.new("Part")
    stem.Name = "MoonStem"
    stem.Size = Vector3.new(8, 14, 8)
    stem.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 55, 20)
    stem.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
    stem.Anchored = true
    stem.CanCollide = false
    stem.CastShadow = false
    stem.Parent = moonModel

    local mLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
    mLight.Name = "MoonLight"
    mLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 30)
    mLight.Brightness = 2.8
    mLight.Range = 450
    mLight.Shadows = false
    mLight.Parent = moonBody

    local updateConn = nil
    updateConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not HalloweenEngine.active or not SETTINGS.HalloweenMoon or not moonModel.Parent then
            if updateConn then updateConn:Disconnect(); updateConn = nil end
            return
        end
        local currentCam = Workspace.CurrentCamera or cam
        if not currentCam then return end

        local camPos = currentCam.CFrame.Position
        local targetMoonPos = camPos + Vector3.new(-320, 360, -320)
        local lookCF = CFrame.lookAt(targetMoonPos, camPos)

        moonBody.CFrame = lookCF
        leftEye.CFrame = lookCF * CFrame.new(-12, 8, -31) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-18))
        leftPupil.CFrame = lookCF * CFrame.new(-12, 8, -31.5)
        rightEye.CFrame = lookCF * CFrame.new(12, 8, -31) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(18))
        rightPupil.CFrame = lookCF * CFrame.new(12, 8, -31.5)
        mouth.CFrame = lookCF * CFrame.new(0, -9, -31)
        mouthGlow.CFrame = lookCF * CFrame.new(0, -9, -31.5)
        stem.CFrame = lookCF * CFrame.new(0, 35, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(18), 0, math.rad(-14))
    end)
    table.insert(HalloweenEngine.connections, updateConn)
    table.insert(getgenv().XenonConnections, updateConn)
end

function HalloweenEngine.removePumpkinMoon()
    if HalloweenEngine.moonModel then
        pcall(function() HalloweenEngine.moonModel:Destroy() end)
        HalloweenEngine.moonModel = nil
    end
    local m = Workspace:FindFirstChild("XenonPumpkinMoon")
    if m then pcall(function() m:Destroy() end) end
end

-- ==================== [ СВЕТЯЩИЕСЯ ТЫКВЫ ПО КАРТЕ В УГЛАХ И КЛАСТЕРАХ ] ====================
function HalloweenEngine.attachCarvedFace(pModel, pBody, scale)
    local cf = pBody.CFrame
    local glowColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 65)

    -- Левый глаз (аккуратный треугольник)
    local eyeL = Instance.new("Part")
    eyeL.Name = "EyeL"
    eyeL.Size = Vector3.new(0.32 * scale, 0.36 * scale, 0.05 * scale)
    eyeL.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(-0.36 * scale, 0.22 * scale, 1.14 * scale) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(18))
    eyeL.Color = glowColor
    eyeL.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    eyeL.Anchored = true
    eyeL.CanCollide = false
    eyeL.Parent = pModel

    -- Правый глаз
    local eyeR = Instance.new("Part")
    eyeR.Name = "EyeR"
    eyeR.Size = Vector3.new(0.32 * scale, 0.36 * scale, 0.05 * scale)
    eyeR.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0.36 * scale, 0.22 * scale, 1.14 * scale) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-18))
    eyeR.Color = glowColor
    eyeR.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    eyeR.Anchored = true
    eyeR.CanCollide = false
    eyeR.Parent = pModel

    -- Нос
    local nose = Instance.new("Part")
    nose.Name = "Nose"
    nose.Size = Vector3.new(0.20 * scale, 0.22 * scale, 0.05 * scale)
    nose.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.04 * scale, 1.18 * scale)
    nose.Color = glowColor
    nose.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    nose.Anchored = true
    nose.CanCollide = false
    nose.Parent = pModel

    -- Резной оскаленный рот (центр и приподнятые уголки улыбки)
    local mouthC = Instance.new("Part")
    mouthC.Name = "MouthC"
    mouthC.Size = Vector3.new(0.52 * scale, 0.18 * scale, 0.05 * scale)
    mouthC.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, -0.22 * scale, 1.16 * scale)
    mouthC.Color = glowColor
    mouthC.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    mouthC.Anchored = true
    mouthC.CanCollide = false
    mouthC.Parent = pModel

    local mouthL = Instance.new("Part")
    mouthL.Name = "MouthL"
    mouthL.Size = Vector3.new(0.30 * scale, 0.15 * scale, 0.05 * scale)
    mouthL.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(-0.35 * scale, -0.16 * scale, 1.12 * scale) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(28))
    mouthL.Color = glowColor
    mouthL.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    mouthL.Anchored = true
    mouthL.CanCollide = false
    mouthL.Parent = pModel

    local mouthR = Instance.new("Part")
    mouthR.Name = "MouthR"
    mouthR.Size = Vector3.new(0.30 * scale, 0.15 * scale, 0.05 * scale)
    mouthR.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0.35 * scale, -0.16 * scale, 1.12 * scale) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-28))
    mouthR.Color = glowColor
    mouthR.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    mouthR.Anchored = true
    mouthR.CanCollide = false
    mouthR.Parent = pModel
end

function HalloweenEngine.createSinglePumpkin(pos, scale, yaw, isCarved, seed)
    local pModel = Instance.new("Model")
    pModel.Name = "GroundPumpkin"

    local pBody = Instance.new("Part")
    pBody.Name = "Body"
    pBody.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    pBody.Size = Vector3.new(2.4 * scale, 1.85 * scale, 2.4 * scale)
    pBody.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.9 * scale, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw), 0)
    pBody.Color = isCarved and Color3.fromRGB(242, 108, 16) or Color3.fromRGB(222, 95, 14)
    pBody.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    pBody.Anchored = true
    pBody.CanCollide = false
    pBody.Parent = pModel
    pModel.PrimaryPart = pBody

    local stem = Instance.new("Part")
    stem.Name = "Stem"
    stem.Size = Vector3.new(0.35 * scale, 0.65 * scale, 0.35 * scale)
    stem.CFrame = pBody.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.98 * scale, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(14), 0, math.rad(-10))
    stem.Color = Color3.fromRGB(48, 68, 26)
    stem.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
    stem.Anchored = true
    stem.CanCollide = false
    stem.Parent = pModel

    if isCarved then
        HalloweenEngine.attachCarvedFace(pModel, pBody, scale)

        local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
        light.Name = "CandleLight"
        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 25)
        light.Brightness = 1.9
        light.Range = 14 * scale
        light.Shadows = true
        light.Parent = pBody
        table.insert(HalloweenEngine.pumpkins, light)
    end

    return pModel
end

function HalloweenEngine.spawnPumpkinCluster(centerPos, clusterSize, baseSeed, folder, ignoreList)
    clusterSize = clusterSize or 3
    for i = 1, clusterSize do
        local offX = 0
        local offZ = 0
        local scale = 1.15
        local isCarved = true
        local yaw = (baseSeed * 73 + math.random(-25, 25)) % 360

        if i == 1 then
            scale = 1.15 + (math.random(0, 25) / 100)
            isCarved = true
        elseif i == 2 then
            local angle = math.rad((baseSeed * 137) % 360)
            local dist = 1.6 + (math.random(0, 15) / 10) * 0.4
            offX = math.cos(angle) * dist
            offZ = math.sin(angle) * dist
            scale = 0.75 + (math.random(0, 20) / 100)
            isCarved = (math.random(1, 2) == 1)
            yaw = math.random(0, 360)
        elseif i == 3 then
            local angle = math.rad((baseSeed * 223 + 90) % 360)
            local dist = 1.8 + (math.random(0, 15) / 10) * 0.4
            offX = math.cos(angle) * dist
            offZ = math.sin(angle) * dist
            scale = 0.52 + (math.random(0, 18) / 100)
            isCarved = false
            yaw = math.random(0, 360)
        elseif i == 4 then
            local angle = math.rad((baseSeed * 311 + 180) % 360)
            local dist = 1.4 + (math.random(0, 10) / 10) * 0.3
            offX = math.cos(angle) * dist
            offZ = math.sin(angle) * dist
            scale = 0.38 + (math.random(0, 12) / 100)
            isCarved = false
            yaw = math.random(0, 360)
        end

        local pGround, pNormal = HalloweenEngine.getGroundPosition(centerPos.X + offX, centerPos.Z + offZ, ignoreList)
        if pGround and pNormal and pNormal.Y > 0.45 then
            local pModel = HalloweenEngine.createSinglePumpkin(pGround - Vector3.new(0, 0.22 * scale, 0), scale, yaw, isCarved, baseSeed + i * 17)
            if pModel and folder and folder.Parent then
                pModel.Parent = folder
            end
        end
    end
end

function HalloweenEngine.generateGroundPumpkins()
    HalloweenEngine.clearGroundPumpkins()
    if not SETTINGS.HalloweenGroundPumpkins then return end

    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "XenonGroundPumpkins"
    folder.Parent = Workspace
    HalloweenEngine.pumpkinsFolder = folder

    local ignoreList = { folder }
    if HalloweenEngine.treesFolder then table.insert(ignoreList, HalloweenEngine.treesFolder) end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Character then table.insert(ignoreList, p.Character) end
    end

    local candidateSpots = {}
    local function addSpot(pos, desc, clusterSize)
        if pos then
            table.insert(candidateSpots, { pos = pos, desc = desc or "nook", size = clusterSize or 3 })
        end
    end

    -- 1. [ ПО КУТАХ УЧАСТКОВ ИГРОКОВ (PLOTS) ]
    local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if plotsFolder then
        for _, plot in ipairs(plotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
            pcall(function()
                local cf, size = plot:GetBoundingBox()
                if size and size.Magnitude > 15 then
                    local hx = math.min(size.X * 0.46, 50)
                    local hz = math.min(size.Z * 0.46, 50)
                    addSpot((cf * CFrame.new(-hx, 0, -hz)).Position, "plot_corner", math.random(2, 4))
                    addSpot((cf * CFrame.new(hx, 0, -hz)).Position, "plot_corner", math.random(2, 4))
                    addSpot((cf * CFrame.new(-hx, 0, hz)).Position, "plot_corner", math.random(2, 4))
                    addSpot((cf * CFrame.new(hx, 0, hz)).Position, "plot_corner", math.random(2, 4))
                    addSpot((cf * CFrame.new(-4, 0, -hz - 2)).Position, "plot_gate", 3)
                    addSpot((cf * CFrame.new(4, 0, -hz - 2)).Position, "plot_gate", 3)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    -- 2. [ ДИНАМИЧЕСКИЙ ПОИСК ПОСТРОЕК В WORKSPACE ]
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj ~= folder and obj.Name ~= "XenonHalloweenTrees" and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
            local lname = string.lower(obj.Name)
            if lname:find("barn") or lname:find("silo") or lname:find("house") or lname:find("shack")
            or lname:find("well") or lname:find("pit") or lname:find("mine") or lname:find("factory")
            or lname:find("tower") or lname:find("bridge") or lname:find("chimney") or lname:find("stair") then
                pcall(function()
                    local cf, size = obj:GetBoundingBox()
                    if size and size.Magnitude > 8 then
                        local hx = size.X * 0.45
                        local hz = size.Z * 0.45
                        addSpot((cf * CFrame.new(-hx, 0, -hz)).Position, "building_corner", math.random(2, 4))
                        addSpot((cf * CFrame.new(hx, 0, hz)).Position, "building_corner", math.random(2, 4))
                        addSpot((cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, -hz - 2)).Position, "building_entrance", math.random(3, 4))
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    -- 3. [ АТМОСФЕРНЫЕ УГОЛКИ КАРТЫ ПО ФОТОГРАФИИ ]
    -- А. Холм с красным амбаром и фермой (справа вверху)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(195, 30, -170), "barn_gates", 4)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(235, 32, -165), "silo_base", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(165, 30, -125), "farm_fence_corner1", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(165, 30, -210), "farm_fence_corner2", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(250, 30, -210), "farm_fence_corner3", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(125, 28, -100), "farm_cliff_edge1", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(115, 26, -150), "farm_cliff_edge2", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(140, 10, -75), "farm_ramp_bottom", 3)

    -- Б. Темная зона завода и пурпурной бездны (слева по центру)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-115, -2, 25), "dark_pit1", 4)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-130, -2, 55), "dark_pit2", 4)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-220, 20, -40), "factory_corner1", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-260, 20, -40), "factory_corner2", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-260, 20, -110), "factory_corner3", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-200, 20, -110), "factory_corner4", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-250, 42, -75), "chimney_base", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-165, 5, -10), "void_rails_entrance", 3)

    -- В. Большая скалистая гора и шахта (слева вверху)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-135, 45, -235), "mine_shed_door", 4)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-105, 20, -190), "mountain_path_step1", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-155, 65, -260), "mountain_path_step2", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-120, 85, -280), "mountain_terrace", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-180, 115, -305), "snow_mountain_peak", 4)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-85, 2, -135), "mountain_boulder1", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-70, 2, -170), "mountain_boulder2", 3)

    -- Г. Ступенчатые скалы и каньон (снизу)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-30, 12, 140), "canyon_step_corner1", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(20, 18, 165), "canyon_step_corner2", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(70, 16, 175), "canyon_step_corner3", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-10, 32, 185), "canyon_top_ledge1", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(50, 32, 195), "canyon_top_ledge2", 3)

    -- Д. Постройки на нижнем плато
    addSpot(Vector3.new(90, 5, 340), "pagoda_corner1", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(120, 5, 360), "pagoda_corner2", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(230, 2, 380), "blue_house_corner1", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(255, 2, 410), "blue_house_corner2", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(20, 2, -260), "north_tower_corner", 3)

    -- Е. Углы центральной площади
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-45, 0, -45), "center_plaza_corner_nw", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(45, 0, -45), "center_plaza_corner_ne", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-45, 0, 45), "center_plaza_corner_sw", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(45, 0, 45), "center_plaza_corner_se", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(0, 0, -65), "center_north_cross", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(0, 0, 65), "center_south_cross", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(-65, 0, 0), "center_west_cross", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(65, 0, 0), "center_east_cross", 3)

    -- Ж. Песчаные пляжи и уединенные бухты в углах острова
    addSpot(Vector3.new(30, -8, -345), "north_beach_cove", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(240, -8, -255), "northeast_beach_cove", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(315, -8, 20), "east_beach_nook", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(290, -8, 380), "southeast_beach_point", 3)
    addSpot(Vector3.new(140, -8, 440), "south_beach_cove", 3)

    -- 4. [ ДЕДУПЛИКАЦИЯ ТОЧЕК ]
    local uniqueSpots = {}
    for _, spot in ipairs(candidateSpots) do
        local isFarEnough = true
        for _, existing in ipairs(uniqueSpots) do
            if (spot.pos - existing.pos).Magnitude < 13 then
                isFarEnough = false
                break
            end
        end
        if isFarEnough then
            table.insert(uniqueSpots, spot)
        end
    end

    -- 5. [ СПАВН КЛАСТЕРОВ ТЫКВ В УГОЛКАХ ]
    local seed = 500
    task.spawn(function()
        for i, spot in ipairs(uniqueSpots) do
            if not HalloweenEngine.active then return end
            seed = seed + 1
            HalloweenEngine.spawnPumpkinCluster(spot.pos, spot.size, seed, folder, ignoreList)
            if i % 4 == 0 then
                task.wait()
            end
        end
    end)
end

function HalloweenEngine.clearGroundPumpkins()
    if HalloweenEngine.pumpkinsFolder then
        pcall(function() HalloweenEngine.pumpkinsFolder:Destroy() end)
        HalloweenEngine.pumpkinsFolder = nil
    end
    local f = Workspace:FindFirstChild("XenonGroundPumpkins")
    if f then pcall(function() f:Destroy() end) end
    local remaining = {}
    for _, l in ipairs(HalloweenEngine.pumpkins) do
        if l and l.Parent then table.insert(remaining, l) end
    end
    HalloweenEngine.pumpkins = remaining
end

-- ==================== [ ПРОВЕРКА ЗЕМЛИ (PIERCING RAYCAST) ] ====================
function HalloweenEngine.getGroundPosition(x, z, ignoreList)
    local currentIgnore = table.clone(ignoreList or {})
    for _ = 1, 8 do
        local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
        rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        rayParams.IgnoreWater = true
        rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = currentIgnore

        local rayResult = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 280, z), Vector3.new(0, -560, 0), rayParams)
        if not rayResult or not rayResult.Instance then
            rayResult = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 480, z), Vector3.new(0, -780, 0), rayParams)
        end

        if not rayResult or not rayResult.Instance then
            return nil
        end

        local hit = rayResult.Instance
        local hitName = string.lower(hit.Name)
        local parentName = hit.Parent and string.lower(hit.Parent.Name) or ""

        local isToy = hitName:find("spawnedintoys") or parentName:find("spawnedintoys")
        local isBarrier = hitName:find("barrier") or parentName:find("barrier") or hitName:find("border")
        local isTransparent = hit.Transparency >= 0.65

        if isToy or isBarrier or isTransparent then
            table.insert(currentIgnore, hit)
        else
            return rayResult.Position, rayResult.Normal
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- ==================== [ 2 ИДЕАЛЬНЫХ ТИПА ДЕРЕВЬЕВ (КЛЁН И ДЕРЕВО С ЛИАНАМИ) ] ====================

-- 1. Величавый огненный клён-дуб (светящийся фонарик-тыква на ветке)
function HalloweenEngine.createSpookyOak(pos, scale, seed)
    local tree = Instance.new("Model")
    tree.Name = "SpookyOak"

    local barkColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 36, 26)

    -- Корни в грунте
    for r = 1, 4 do
        local rAngle = math.rad(r * 90 + ((seed * 17) % 30))
        local root = Instance.new("Part")
        root.Name = "Root_" .. r
        root.Size = Vector3.new(1.8 * scale, 4.0 * scale, 3.2 * scale)
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(rAngle) * 2.0 * scale, 0.2 * scale, math.sin(rAngle) * 2.0 * scale))
            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-26), rAngle, 0)
        root.Color = barkColor
        root.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
        root.Anchored = true
        root.CanCollide = false
        root.Parent = tree
    end

    -- Ствол (заглублен в грунт на 3.5 студа)
    local trunk = Instance.new("Part")
    trunk.Name = "Trunk"
    trunk.Size = Vector3.new(2.8 * scale, 15 * scale, 2.8 * scale)
    trunk.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 5.0 * scale, 0))
    trunk.Color = barkColor
    trunk.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
    trunk.Anchored = true
    trunk.CanCollide = false
    trunk.Parent = tree
    tree.PrimaryPart = trunk

    local trunkTopPos = trunk.CFrame * Vector3.new(0, 6.5 * scale, 0)

    -- 4 ветви, поддерживающие крону
    for b = 1, 4 do
        local bAngle = math.rad(b * 90 + ((seed * 13) % 25))
        local branch = Instance.new("Part")
        branch.Name = "Branch_" .. b
        branch.Size = Vector3.new(1.2 * scale, 5.5 * scale, 1.2 * scale)
        branch.CFrame = CFrame.new(trunkTopPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, bAngle, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(40), 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 2.6 * scale, 0)
        branch.Color = barkColor
        branch.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
        branch.Anchored = true
        branch.CanCollide = false
        branch.Parent = tree
    end

    local leafPalette = {
        Color3.fromRGB(240, 110, 18), -- Огненно-оранжевый
        Color3.fromRGB(250, 160, 24), -- Янтарно-золотой
        Color3.fromRGB(225, 90, 16)   -- Тыквенный
    }

    -- Центральный купол кроны
    local crownCenter = Instance.new("Part")
    crownCenter.Name = "CrownCenter"
    crownCenter.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    crownCenter.Size = Vector3.new(11 * scale, 9.5 * scale, 11 * scale)
    crownCenter.CFrame = CFrame.new(trunkTopPos + Vector3.new(0, 3.8 * scale, 0))
    crownCenter.Color = leafPalette[1]
    crownCenter.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
    crownCenter.Anchored = true
    crownCenter.CanCollide = false
    crownCenter.Parent = tree

    -- 6 боковых сферических облаков листвы
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local angle = math.rad(i * 60 + ((seed * 11) % 20))
        local dist = 4.2 * scale
        local blob = Instance.new("Part")
        blob.Name = "LeafBlob_" .. i
        blob.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        local bSize = (7.2 + (i % 3) * 0.8) * scale
        blob.Size = Vector3.new(bSize, bSize * 0.88, bSize)
        blob.CFrame = CFrame.new(trunkTopPos + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, (1.8 + (i % 2) * 1.5) * scale, math.sin(angle) * dist))
        blob.Color = leafPalette[((seed + i) % #leafPalette) + 1]
        blob.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
        blob.Anchored = true
        blob.CanCollide = false
        blob.Parent = tree
    end

    -- Маленький светящийся фонарик-тыква на ветке
    local lantern = Instance.new("Part")
    lantern.Name = "OakLantern"
    lantern.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    lantern.Size = Vector3.new(1.8 * scale, 1.5 * scale, 1.8 * scale)
    lantern.CFrame = CFrame.new(trunkTopPos + Vector3.new(3.2 * scale, -0.5 * scale, 1.8 * scale))
    lantern.Color = Color3.fromRGB(244, 115, 18)
    lantern.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    lantern.Anchored = true
    lantern.CanCollide = false
    lantern.Parent = tree

    HalloweenEngine.attachCarvedFace(tree, lantern, scale * 0.8)

    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Name = "CandleLight"
    light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 30)
    light.Brightness = 1.9
    light.Range = 14 * scale
    light.Shadows = true
    light.Parent = lantern
    table.insert(HalloweenEngine.pumpkins, light)

    return tree
end

-- 2. Дерево с вьющимися лианами по стволу и свисающими лозами
function HalloweenEngine.createVineTree(pos, scale, seed)
    local tree = Instance.new("Model")
    tree.Name = "VineTree"

    local darkWood = Color3.fromRGB(44, 30, 22)
    local vineColor = Color3.fromRGB(58, 82, 36)

    -- Корни в грунте
    for r = 1, 4 do
        local rAngle = math.rad(r * 90 + ((seed * 19) % 25))
        local root = Instance.new("Part")
        root.Name = "Root_" .. r
        root.Size = Vector3.new(1.8 * scale, 4.0 * scale, 3.2 * scale)
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(rAngle) * 2.0 * scale, 0.2 * scale, math.sin(rAngle) * 2.0 * scale))
            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-26), rAngle, 0)
        root.Color = darkWood
        root.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
        root.Anchored = true
        root.CanCollide = false
        root.Parent = tree
    end

    -- Ствол
    local trunk = Instance.new("Part")
    trunk.Name = "Trunk"
    trunk.Size = Vector3.new(2.8 * scale, 15 * scale, 2.8 * scale)
    trunk.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 5.0 * scale, 0))
    trunk.Color = darkWood
    trunk.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
    trunk.Anchored = true
    trunk.CanCollide = false
    trunk.Parent = tree
    tree.PrimaryPart = trunk

    -- ЛИАНЫ, ОБВИВАЮЩИЕ СТВОЛ СНИЗУ ДО ВЕРХА
    for v = 1, 8 do
        local vAngle = math.rad(v * 65 + ((seed * 11) % 30))
        local yPos = (1.2 + v * 1.45) * scale
        local vineSeg = Instance.new("Part")
        vineSeg.Name = "TrunkVine_" .. v
        vineSeg.Size = Vector3.new(0.55 * scale, 1.8 * scale, 0.55 * scale)
        vineSeg.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(vAngle) * 1.55 * scale, yPos, math.sin(vAngle) * 1.55 * scale))
            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(22), vAngle, math.rad(-14))
        vineSeg.Color = vineColor
        vineSeg.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
        vineSeg.Anchored = true
        vineSeg.CanCollide = false
        vineSeg.Parent = tree
    end

    local trunkTopPos = trunk.CFrame * Vector3.new(0, 6.5 * scale, 0)

    -- 4 ветви
    for b = 1, 4 do
        local bAngle = math.rad(b * 90 + ((seed * 15) % 25))
        local branch = Instance.new("Part")
        branch.Name = "Branch_" .. b
        branch.Size = Vector3.new(1.2 * scale, 5.5 * scale, 1.2 * scale)
        branch.CFrame = CFrame.new(trunkTopPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, bAngle, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(42), 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 2.6 * scale, 0)
        branch.Color = darkWood
        branch.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
        branch.Anchored = true
        branch.CanCollide = false
        branch.Parent = tree
    end

    local vinePalette = {
        Color3.fromRGB(195, 45, 20), -- Багровый
        Color3.fromRGB(225, 85, 18), -- Осенний оранжевый
        Color3.fromRGB(170, 32, 18)  -- Темный рубин
    }

    -- Пышная сферическая крона
    local crownCenter = Instance.new("Part")
    crownCenter.Name = "CrownCenter"
    crownCenter.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    crownCenter.Size = Vector3.new(11.5 * scale, 9.5 * scale, 11.5 * scale)
    crownCenter.CFrame = CFrame.new(trunkTopPos + Vector3.new(0, 3.8 * scale, 0))
    crownCenter.Color = vinePalette[1]
    crownCenter.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
    crownCenter.Anchored = true
    crownCenter.CanCollide = false
    crownCenter.Parent = tree

    for i = 1, 6 do
        local angle = math.rad(i * 60 + ((seed * 7) % 20))
        local dist = 4.4 * scale
        local blob = Instance.new("Part")
        blob.Name = "VineBlob_" .. i
        blob.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        local bSize = (7.4 + (i % 3) * 0.8) * scale
        blob.Size = Vector3.new(bSize, bSize * 0.88, bSize)
        blob.CFrame = CFrame.new(trunkTopPos + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, (1.8 + (i % 2) * 1.5) * scale, math.sin(angle) * dist))
        blob.Color = vinePalette[((seed + i) % #vinePalette) + 1]
        blob.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
        blob.Anchored = true
        blob.CanCollide = false
        blob.Parent = tree
    end

    -- ТОНКИЕ свисающие лианы из кроны (красиво покачивающиеся на ветру)
    for h = 1, 10 do
        local hAngle = math.rad(h * 36 + ((seed * 9) % 20))
        local hDist = (4.0 + (h % 3) * 0.7) * scale
        local hLen = (5.5 + (h % 4) * 1.2) * scale
        local hangingVine = Instance.new("Part")
        hangingVine.Name = "HangingVine_" .. h
        hangingVine.Size = Vector3.new(0.35 * scale, hLen, 0.35 * scale)
        hangingVine.CFrame = CFrame.new(trunkTopPos + Vector3.new(math.cos(hAngle) * hDist, 2.0 * scale - (hLen * 0.5), math.sin(hAngle) * hDist))
        hangingVine.Color = vineColor
        hangingVine.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
        hangingVine.Transparency = 0.08
        hangingVine.Anchored = true
        hangingVine.CanCollide = false
        hangingVine.Parent = tree
    end

    return tree
end

function HalloweenEngine.createSpookyTree(pos, scale, seed)
    -- Ровно 2 красивых типа: 0 = Осенний клён-дуб с тыквой-фонарём, 1 = Дерево с лианами
    if (seed % 2) == 0 then
        return HalloweenEngine.createSpookyOak(pos, scale, seed)
    else
        return HalloweenEngine.createVineTree(pos, scale, seed)
    end
end

-- ==================== [ ГЕНЕРАЦИЯ ДЕРЕВЬЕВ ПО ВСЕЙ КАРТЕ (~50 ШТУК БЕЗ РЯДОВ) ] ====================
function HalloweenEngine.generateTrees()
    HalloweenEngine.clearTrees()
    if not SETTINGS.HalloweenTrees then return end

    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "XenonHalloweenTrees"
    folder.Parent = Workspace
    HalloweenEngine.treesFolder = folder

    local ignoreList = { folder }
    if HalloweenEngine.pumpkinsFolder then table.insert(ignoreList, HalloweenEngine.pumpkinsFolder) end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Character then table.insert(ignoreList, p.Character) end
    end

    local spawnPos = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local sp = Workspace:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation") or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
    if sp then spawnPos = sp.Position end

    -- 54 точки по всем 10 зонам карты и внешним островам
    local curatedAnchors = {
        -- 1. Холм фермы и красный амбар (8 деревьев)
        Vector2.new(115, -95), Vector2.new(145, -115), Vector2.new(180, -95), Vector2.new(215, -125),
        Vector2.new(245, -155), Vector2.new(195, -215), Vector2.new(160, -195), Vector2.new(130, -165),

        -- 2. Большая скалистая гора и шахта (8 деревьев)
        Vector2.new(-105, -145), Vector2.new(-135, -175), Vector2.new(-165, -195), Vector2.new(-195, -225),
        Vector2.new(-225, -255), Vector2.new(-145, -245), Vector2.new(-115, -215), Vector2.new(-175, -285),

        -- 3. Темная зона завода и бездны (7 деревьев)
        Vector2.new(-115, -35), Vector2.new(-145, -15), Vector2.new(-175, 15), Vector2.new(-205, 45),
        Vector2.new(-235, -15), Vector2.new(-195, -55), Vector2.new(-155, 65),

        -- 4. Ступенчатый каньон и скалы (6 деревьев)
        Vector2.new(-45, 125), Vector2.new(-15, 145), Vector2.new(25, 165), Vector2.new(65, 175),
        Vector2.new(-25, 185), Vector2.new(45, 195),

        -- 5. Нижнее плато с домами (7 деревьев)
        Vector2.new(65, 265), Vector2.new(115, 295), Vector2.new(165, 325), Vector2.new(215, 345),
        Vector2.new(145, 385), Vector2.new(195, 415), Vector2.new(85, 355),

        -- 6. Периметр центральной поляны (6 деревьев)
        Vector2.new(-48, -48), Vector2.new(48, -48), Vector2.new(-48, 48), Vector2.new(48, 48),
        Vector2.new(0, -68), Vector2.new(0, 68),

        -- 7. Северный пляж и берег (3 дерева)
        Vector2.new(-25, -315), Vector2.new(15, -335), Vector2.new(45, -305),

        -- 8. Восточный пляж (3 дерева)
        Vector2.new(285, -35), Vector2.new(315, 15), Vector2.new(275, 55),

        -- 9. Южный пляж (3 дерева)
        Vector2.new(125, 445), Vector2.new(165, 465), Vector2.new(195, 435),

        -- 10. Западный мыс и камни (3 дерева)
        Vector2.new(-215, 135), Vector2.new(-185, 165), Vector2.new(-165, 125)
    }

    local spawnedPositions = {}
    local treeSeed = 100

    task.spawn(function()
        for idx, anchor in ipairs(curatedAnchors) do
            if not HalloweenEngine.active then return end
            treeSeed = treeSeed + 1

            local rx = anchor.X + math.random(-8, 8)
            local rz = anchor.Y + math.random(-8, 8)

            local distFromSpawn = (Vector3.new(rx, 0, rz) - Vector3.new(spawnPos.X, 0, spawnPos.Z)).Magnitude
            if distFromSpawn >= 24 then
                local isFarFromOthers = true
                for _, prevPos in ipairs(spawnedPositions) do
                    if (Vector3.new(rx, 0, rz) - Vector3.new(prevPos.X, 0, prevPos.Z)).Magnitude < 15 then
                        isFarFromOthers = false
                        break
                    end
                end

                if isFarFromOthers then
                    local groundPos, normal = HalloweenEngine.getGroundPosition(rx, rz, ignoreList)
                    if groundPos and normal and normal.Y >= 0.50 then
                        pcall(function()
                            local scale = 0.95 + (math.random(0, 28) / 100)
                            local tree = HalloweenEngine.createSpookyTree(groundPos, scale, treeSeed)
                            if tree and folder and folder.Parent then
                                tree.Parent = folder
                                table.insert(spawnedPositions, groundPos)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end

            if idx % 4 == 0 then
                task.wait()
            end
        end
    end)
end

function HalloweenEngine.clearTrees()
    if HalloweenEngine.treesFolder then
        pcall(function() HalloweenEngine.treesFolder:Destroy() end)
        HalloweenEngine.treesFolder = nil
    end
    local f = Workspace:FindFirstChild("XenonHalloweenTrees")
    if f then pcall(function() f:Destroy() end) end
end

function HalloweenEngine.start()
    if HalloweenEngine.active then return end
    HalloweenEngine.active = true
    HalloweenEngine.saveLighting()

    if SETTINGS.HalloweenShaders then HalloweenEngine.applyShaders() end
    if SETTINGS.HalloweenLeaves then HalloweenEngine.startLeaves() end
    if SETTINGS.HalloweenTrees then HalloweenEngine.generateTrees() end
    if SETTINGS.HalloweenMoon then HalloweenEngine.createPumpkinMoon() end
    if SETTINGS.HalloweenGroundPumpkins then HalloweenEngine.generateGroundPumpkins() end
end

function HalloweenEngine.stop()
    HalloweenEngine.active = false
    HalloweenEngine.removeShaders()
    HalloweenEngine.stopLeaves()
    HalloweenEngine.clearTrees()
    HalloweenEngine.removePumpkinMoon()
    HalloweenEngine.clearGroundPumpkins()

    for _, conn in ipairs(HalloweenEngine.connections) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    HalloweenEngine.connections = {}
    HalloweenEngine.flickerConn = nil
    HalloweenEngine.pumpkins = {}
end

function HalloweenEngine.toggle(v)
    if v then
        HalloweenEngine.start()
    else
        HalloweenEngine.stop()
    end
end

-- ================================================================================
-- [ ANTI-KICK ESP (PICKAXE, SHURIKEN, KUNAI) & PCLD ESP WITH CONTOURING ]
-- ================================================================================
do
    local SOUNDS = {
        ToggleOn = "rbxasset://sounds/switch.wav",
        ToggleOff = "rbxasset://sounds/switch.wav",
        Slider = "rbxasset://sounds/button.wav",
        Hover = "rbxasset://sounds/clickfast.wav",
        Open = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav",
        Close = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav",
        Click = "rbxasset://sounds/button.wav"
    }

    local cachedSoundAssets = {}

    local function resolveSoundAsset(soundType)
        if cachedSoundAssets[soundType] then
            return cachedSoundAssets[soundType]
        end

        local map = {
            Open = { "Xenon/sounds/open.wav", "PulseHub/nova/open.wav", "open.wav" },
            Close = { "Xenon/sounds/close.wav", "PulseHub/nova/close.wav", "close.wav" },
            ToggleOn = { "Xenon/sounds/on.wav", "PulseHub/nova/on.wav", "on.wav" },
            ToggleOff = { "Xenon/sounds/off.wav", "PulseHub/nova/off.wav", "off.wav" },
            Click = { "Xenon/sounds/click.wav", "PulseHub/nova/click.wav", "click.wav" },
            Hover = { "Xenon/sounds/hover.wav", "PulseHub/nova/hover.wav", "hover.wav" },
            Slider = { "Xenon/sounds/tick.wav", "PulseHub/nova/tick.wav", "tick.wav" }
        }

        local getAsset = (getcustomasset or getsynasset)
        if getAsset and isfile then
            local candidates = map[soundType] or {}
            for _, path in ipairs(candidates) do
                local ok, exists = pcall(function() return isfile(path) end)
                if ok and exists then
                    local aOk, assetId = pcall(function() return getAsset(path) end)
                    if aOk and assetId and assetId ~= "" then
                        cachedSoundAssets[soundType] = assetId
                        return assetId
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local fallback = SOUNDS[soundType] or SOUNDS.Click or "rbxasset://sounds/button.wav"
        cachedSoundAssets[soundType] = fallback
        return fallback
    end

    playUiSound = function(soundType)
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                local soundPath = resolveSoundAsset(soundType)
                local s = Instance.new("Sound")
                s.Name = "XenonUiSound_" .. tostring(soundType)
                s.SoundId = soundPath
                s.Volume = (soundType == "Open" or soundType == "Close") and 1.8 or ((soundType == "Hover") and 0.25 or 0.95)
                s.Pitch = (soundType == "Open") and 1.15 or ((soundType == "Close") and 0.90 or ((soundType == "ToggleOff") and 0.88 or 1.05))

                local targetParent = game:GetService("SoundService")
                s.Parent = targetParent

                local played = false
                pcall(function()
                    if targetParent.PlayLocalSound then
                        targetParent:PlayLocalSound(s)
                        played = true
                    end
                end)
                if not played or not s.IsPlaying then
                    s.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera or Workspace
                    s:Play()
                end

                task.delay(1.5, function()
                    pcall(function() s:Destroy() end)
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- [ ПРЕМИАЛЬНАЯ ПАЛИТРА ЦВЕТОВ LIQUID GLASS С РАДУЖНЫМ СПЕКТРОМ И ПРЕСЕТАМИ ]
    createColorPickerCard = function(container, titleText, initColor, onChange)
        local curColor = initColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        local curH, curS, curV = curColor:ToHSV()
        if curS < 0.05 and curV > 0.9 then
            curH = 0
        end

        local card = Instance.new("Frame")
        card.Name = "LiquidColorPickerCard"
        card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 154)
        card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 26)
        card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0
        card.ZIndex = 510
        card.Parent = container

        local cCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        cCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
        cCorner.Parent = card

        local cardStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        cardStroke.Thickness = 1
        cardStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        cardStroke.Transparency = 0.82
        cardStroke.Parent = card

        -- Шапка карточки палитры (Название слева, превью цвета и Hex справа)
        local header = Instance.new("Frame")
        header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
        header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        header.ZIndex = 511
        header.Parent = card

        local tLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)
        tLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
        tLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tLabel.Text = titleText
        tLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255)
        tLabel.TextSize = 12
        tLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        tLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        tLabel.ZIndex = 511
        tLabel.Parent = header

        -- Превью капсула с цветом и Hex-кодом
        local previewPill = Instance.new("Frame")
        previewPill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 94, 0, 22)
        previewPill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -106, 0.5, -11)
        previewPill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 28, 38)
        previewPill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
        previewPill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        previewPill.ZIndex = 511
        previewPill.Parent = header

        local pillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        pillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        pillCorner.Parent = previewPill

        local pillStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        pillStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        pillStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        pillStroke.Transparency = 0.8
        pillStroke.Parent = previewPill

        local colorDot = Instance.new("Frame")
        colorDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
        colorDot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, -7)
        colorDot.BackgroundColor3 = curColor
        colorDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
        colorDot.ZIndex = 512
        colorDot.Parent = previewPill

        local dotCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        dotCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        dotCorner.Parent = colorDot

        local hexLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        hexLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0)
        hexLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 23, 0, 0)
        hexLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hexLabel.Text = "#" .. curColor:ToHex():upper()
        hexLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 230, 245)
        hexLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        hexLabel.TextSize = 10
        hexLabel.ZIndex = 512
        hexLabel.Parent = previewPill

        local updateHueKnob, updateBrightKnob
        local function applyColor(newC)
            curColor = newC
            colorDot.BackgroundColor3 = curColor
            hexLabel.Text = "#" .. curColor:ToHex():upper()
            if onChange then pcall(function() onChange(curColor) end) end
        end

        -- 1. Секция быстрых пресетов (Curated Chips)
        local presetRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        presetRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 20)
        presetRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 36)
        presetRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        presetRow.ZIndex = 511
        presetRow.Parent = card

        local pLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        pLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        pLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        pLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 7)
        pLayout.Parent = presetRow

        local PRESETS = {
            Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), -- White
            Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18),    -- Deep Black
            Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 75),   -- Neon Red
            Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 35),  -- Vivid Orange
            Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 45),  -- Bright Gold
            Color3.fromRGB(45, 225, 115),  -- Emerald Green
            Color3.fromRGB(0, 225, 255),   -- Cyan / Diamond
            Color3.fromRGB(60, 130, 255),  -- Royal Blue
            Color3.fromRGB(175, 85, 255),  -- Xenon Purple
            Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 215), -- Hot Pink
        }

        for _, pCol in ipairs(PRESETS) do
            local chip = Instance.new("TextButton")
            chip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
            chip.BackgroundColor3 = pCol
            chip.Text = ""
            chip.AutoButtonColor = false
            chip.ZIndex = 512
            chip.Parent = presetRow

            local chipCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            chipCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            chipCorner.Parent = chip

            local chipStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            chipStroke.Thickness = 1
            chipStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            chipStroke.Transparency = 0.75
            chipStroke.Parent = chip

            chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local h, s, v = pCol:ToHSV()
                curH, curS, curV = h, s, v
                applyColor(pCol)
                if updateHueKnob then updateHueKnob(curH) end
                if updateBrightKnob then updateBrightKnob() end
            end)
        end

        -- 2. Непрерывный радужный спектр (Rainbow Hue Bar)
        local hueContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
        hueContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
        hueContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 68)
        hueContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hueContainer.ZIndex = 511
        hueContainer.Parent = card

        local hueRail = Instance.new("Frame")
        hueRail.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
        hueRail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -6)
        hueRail.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        hueRail.BorderSizePixel = 0
        hueRail.ZIndex = 512
        hueRail.Parent = hueContainer

        local hueRailCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        hueRailCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        hueRailCorner.Parent = hueRail

        local hueGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        hueGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.16, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.33, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.67, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.83, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
        })
        hueGrad.Parent = hueRail

        local hueRailStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        hueRailStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        hueRailStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        hueRailStroke.Transparency = 0.75
        hueRailStroke.Parent = hueRail

        local hueKnob = Instance.new("Frame")
        hueKnob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
        hueKnob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        hueKnob.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp(curH, 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
        hueKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(curH, 1, 1)
        hueKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        hueKnob.ZIndex = 514
        hueKnob.Parent = hueRail

        local hKnobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        hKnobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        hKnobCorner.Parent = hueKnob

        local hKnobStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        hKnobStroke.Thickness = 2
        hKnobStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        hKnobStroke.Parent = hueKnob

        updateHueKnob = function(h)
            hueKnob.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp(h, 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
            hueKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
        end

        local hueBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        hueBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        hueBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hueBtn.Text = ""
        hueBtn.ZIndex = 515
        hueBtn.Parent = hueContainer

        local hueDragging = false
        local function updateHueFromMouse()
            local rPos = hueRail.AbsolutePosition
            local rSize = hueRail.AbsoluteSize
            if rSize.X <= 0 then return end
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local pct = math.clamp((mousePos.X - rPos.X) / rSize.X, 0, 1)
            curH = pct
            updateHueKnob(curH)
            if curS < 0.2 then curS = 1 end
            if curV < 0.2 then curV = 1 end
            local newC = Color3.fromHSV(curH, curS, curV)
            applyColor(newC)
            if updateBrightKnob then updateBrightKnob() end
        end

        hueBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            hueDragging = true
            updateHueFromMouse()
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                hueDragging = false
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if hueDragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                updateHueFromMouse()
            end
        end)

        -- 3. Полоса яркости и оттенка (Brightness / Value Bar)
        local brightContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
        brightContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
        brightContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 98)
        brightContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        brightContainer.ZIndex = 511
        brightContainer.Parent = card

        local brightRail = Instance.new("Frame")
        brightRail.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
        brightRail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -6)
        brightRail.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        brightRail.BorderSizePixel = 0
        brightRail.ZIndex = 512
        brightRail.Parent = brightContainer

        local brightCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        brightCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        brightCorner.Parent = brightRail

        local brightGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        brightGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromHSV(curH, 1, 1)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        })
        brightGrad.Parent = brightRail

        local brightStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        brightStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        brightStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        brightStroke.Transparency = 0.75
        brightStroke.Parent = brightRail

        local bPosInit = (curS < 0.99) and (0.5 + (1 - curS) * 0.5) or (curV * 0.5)
        local brightKnob = Instance.new("Frame")
        brightKnob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
        brightKnob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        brightKnob.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp(bPosInit, 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
        brightKnob.BackgroundColor3 = curColor
        brightKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        brightKnob.ZIndex = 514
        brightKnob.Parent = brightRail

        local bKnobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        bKnobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        bKnobCorner.Parent = brightKnob

        local bKnobStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        bKnobStroke.Thickness = 2
        bKnobStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        bKnobStroke.Parent = brightKnob

        updateBrightKnob = function()
            local baseHueCol = Color3.fromHSV(curH, 1, 1)
            brightGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, baseHueCol),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
            })
            local bPos = (curS < 0.99) and (0.5 + (1 - curS) * 0.5) or (curV * 0.5)
            brightKnob.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp(bPos, 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
            brightKnob.BackgroundColor3 = curColor
        end

        local brightBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        brightBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        brightBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        brightBtn.Text = ""
        brightBtn.ZIndex = 515
        brightBtn.Parent = brightContainer

        local brightDragging = false
        local function updateBrightFromMouse()
            local rPos = brightRail.AbsolutePosition
            local rSize = brightRail.AbsoluteSize
            if rSize.X <= 0 then return end
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local pct = math.clamp((mousePos.X - rPos.X) / rSize.X, 0, 1)
            brightKnob.Position = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 0.5, 0)
            if pct <= 0.5 then
                curV = math.clamp(pct * 2, 0, 1)
                curS = 1
            else
                curV = 1
                curS = math.clamp(1 - (pct - 0.5) * 2, 0, 1)
            end
            local newC = Color3.fromHSV(curH, curS, curV)
            brightKnob.BackgroundColor3 = newC
            applyColor(newC)
        end

        brightBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            brightDragging = true
            updateBrightFromMouse()
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                brightDragging = false
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if brightDragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                updateBrightFromMouse()
            end
        end)

        -- Подпись внизу карточки
        local hintLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        hintLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14)
        hintLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -18)
        hintLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hintLabel.Text = "Радужный спектр • Тон и яркость • Быстрые пресеты"
        hintLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 135, 155)
        hintLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        hintLabel.TextSize = 10
        hintLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        hintLabel.ZIndex = 511
        hintLabel.Parent = card

        return card
    end

    -- [ СОВРЕМЕННЫЙ СТЕКЛЯННЫЙ СВИТЧ-ПЕРЕКЛЮЧАТЕЛЬ ДЛЯ НАСТРОЕК ]
    createModalToggleRow = function(container, titleText, initialVal, onToggle)
        local curState = initialVal == true

        local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = curState and Color3.fromRGB(22, 28, 42) or Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 24)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.AutoButtonColor = false
        row.Text = ""
        row.ZIndex = 510
        row.Parent = container

        local rCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        rCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        rCorner.Parent = row

        local rStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        rStroke.Thickness = 1
        rStroke.Color = curState and Color3.fromRGB(0, 210, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        rStroke.Transparency = curState and 0.45 or 0.85
        rStroke.Parent = row

        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 1, 0)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = titleText
        lbl.TextColor3 = curState and Color3.fromRGB(250, 252, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)
        lbl.TextSize = 12
        lbl.Font = curState and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        lbl.ZIndex = 511
        lbl.Parent = row

        -- Переключатель (iOS / Glass Switch)
        local switchTrack = Instance.new("Frame")
        switchTrack.Name = "SwitchTrack"
        switchTrack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 20)
        switchTrack.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, -10)
        switchTrack.BackgroundColor3 = curState and Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 38, 48)
        switchTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
        switchTrack.ZIndex = 511
        switchTrack.Parent = row

        local sCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        sCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        sCorner.Parent = switchTrack

        local sStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        sStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        sStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        sStroke.Transparency = curState and 0.4 or 0.8
        sStroke.Parent = switchTrack

        local switchKnob = Instance.new("Frame")
        switchKnob.Name = "SwitchKnob"
        switchKnob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
        switchKnob.Position = curState and UDim2.new(1, -17, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -7)
        switchKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        switchKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        switchKnob.ZIndex = 512
        switchKnob.Parent = switchTrack

        local kCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        kCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        kCorner.Parent = switchKnob

        local function updateVisual(animate)
            local targetTrackColor = curState and Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 38, 48)
            local targetKnobPos = curState and UDim2.new(1, -17, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -7)
            local targetBg = curState and Color3.fromRGB(22, 28, 42) or Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 24)
            local targetStrokeCol = curState and Color3.fromRGB(0, 210, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            local targetStrokeTrans = curState and 0.45 or 0.85
            local targetTextColor = curState and Color3.fromRGB(250, 252, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)

            lbl.Font = curState and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium

            if animate then
                TweenService:Create(switchTrack, TweenInfo.new(0.20), { BackgroundColor3 = targetTrackColor }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(switchKnob, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = targetKnobPos }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.20), { BackgroundColor3 = targetBg }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(rStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.20), { Color = targetStrokeCol, Transparency = targetStrokeTrans }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.20), { TextColor3 = targetTextColor }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(sStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.20), { Transparency = curState and 0.4 or 0.8 }):Play()
            else
                switchTrack.BackgroundColor3 = targetTrackColor
                switchKnob.Position = targetKnobPos
                row.BackgroundColor3 = targetBg
                rStroke.Color = targetStrokeCol
                rStroke.Transparency = targetStrokeTrans
                lbl.TextColor3 = targetTextColor
                sStroke.Transparency = curState and 0.4 or 0.8
            end
        end

        row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.22 }):Play()
        end)
        row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 }):Play()
        end)

        row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            curState = not curState
            playUiSound(curState and "ToggleOn" or "ToggleOff")
            updateVisual(true)
            if onToggle then onToggle(curState) end
        end)

        return row
    end

    -- [ СОВРЕМЕННЫЙ СТЕКЛЯННЫЙ СЛАЙДЕР ДЛЯ НАСТРОЕК ]
    createModalSliderRow = function(container, titleText, initVal, minVal, maxVal, isPercent, onValChange)
        local curVal = math.clamp(initVal, minVal, maxVal)

        local row = Instance.new("Frame")
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 24)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.ZIndex = 510
        row.Parent = container

        local rCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        rCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        rCorner.Parent = row

        local rStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        rStroke.Thickness = 1
        rStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        rStroke.Transparency = 0.85
        rStroke.Parent = row

        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, 0, 18)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 5)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = titleText
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 243, 255)
        lbl.TextSize = 11
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        lbl.ZIndex = 511
        lbl.Parent = row

        local valLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 55, 0, 18)
        valLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -65, 0, 5)
        valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local function formatVal(v)
            if isPercent then
                return string.format("%d%%", math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5))
            elseif v % 1 == 0 then
                return string.format("%d", v)
            else
                return string.format("%.2f", v)
            end
        end
        valLbl.Text = formatVal(curVal)
        valLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
        valLbl.TextSize = 11
        valLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        valLbl.ZIndex = 511
        valLbl.Parent = row

        local rail = Instance.new("Frame")
        rail.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 6)
        rail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -14)
        rail.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 34, 46)
        rail.BorderSizePixel = 0
        rail.ZIndex = 511
        rail.Parent = row

        local railCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        railCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        railCorner.Parent = rail

        local pct = (maxVal > minVal) and math.clamp((curVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1) or 0
        local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 205, 255)
        fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fill.ZIndex = 512
        fill.Parent = rail

        local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        fillCorner.Parent = fill

        local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
        knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
        knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        knob.ZIndex = 513
        knob.Parent = fill

        local kCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        kCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        kCorner.Parent = knob

        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -20)
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        btn.Text = ""
        btn.ZIndex = 514
        btn.Parent = row

        local dragging = false
        local function updateSliderFromMouse()
            local rPos = rail.AbsolutePosition
            local rSize = rail.AbsoluteSize
            if rSize.X <= 0 then return end
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local newPct = math.clamp((mousePos.X - rPos.X) / rSize.X, 0, 1)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(newPct, 0, 1, 0)
            curVal = minVal + newPct * (maxVal - minVal)
            valLbl.Text = formatVal(curVal)
            if onValChange then onValChange(curVal) end
        end

        btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            dragging = true
            updateSliderFromMouse()
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if dragging and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                updateSliderFromMouse()
            end
        end)

        return row
    end

    -- Экспорт хелперов для использования во всех модальных окнах настроек
    _G.XenonModalToggle = createModalToggleRow
    _G.XenonModalSlider = createModalSliderRow
    _G.XenonColorPicker = createColorPickerCard

    local AntiKickEspEngine = {
        active = false,
        tracked = {},
        loopTask = nil,
        ancestryConns = {}
    }

    function AntiKickEspEngine.matchItem(inst)
        if not inst then return nil end
        local name = tostring(inst.Name)
        local nLower = name:lower()

        if nLower:find("pickaxe") or name:find("ToolPickaxe") then
            if SETTINGS.AntiKickEspPickaxe then
                return "PICKAXE", "⛏️ Кирка"
            end
        elseif nLower:find("shuriken") or name:find("NinjaShuriken") then
            if SETTINGS.AntiKickEspShuriken then
                return "SHURIKEN", "⭐ Сюрикен"
            end
        elseif nLower:find("kunai") or name:find("NinjaKunai") then
            if SETTINGS.AntiKickEspKunai then
                return "KUNAI", "🗡️ Кунай"
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    function AntiKickEspEngine.refresh()
        for item, data in pairs(AntiKickEspEngine.tracked) do
            if item and item.Parent then
                if data.hl and data.hl.Parent then
                    data.hl.FillColor = SETTINGS.AntiKickEspColor
                    data.hl.OutlineColor = SETTINGS.AntiKickEspOutlineColor
                    data.hl.FillTransparency = SETTINGS.AntiKickEspFillTransparency
                    data.hl.OutlineTransparency = SETTINGS.AntiKickEspOutlineTransparency
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function AntiKickEspEngine.clearItem(item)
        local data = AntiKickEspEngine.tracked[item]
        if data then
            if data.hl then pcall(function() data.hl:Destroy() end) end
            AntiKickEspEngine.tracked[item] = nil
        end
        if AntiKickEspEngine.ancestryConns[item] then
            pcall(function() AntiKickEspEngine.ancestryConns[item]:Disconnect() end)
            AntiKickEspEngine.ancestryConns[item] = nil
        end
    end

    function AntiKickEspEngine.clearAll()
        for item, _ in pairs(AntiKickEspEngine.tracked) do
            AntiKickEspEngine.clearItem(item)
        end
        AntiKickEspEngine.tracked = {}
        for item, conn in pairs(AntiKickEspEngine.ancestryConns) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        AntiKickEspEngine.ancestryConns = {}
    end

    function AntiKickEspEngine.attach(item)
        if AntiKickEspEngine.tracked[item] then return end

        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "XenonAntiKickHighlight"
        hl.Adornee = item
        hl.FillColor = SETTINGS.AntiKickEspColor
        hl.OutlineColor = SETTINGS.AntiKickEspOutlineColor
        hl.FillTransparency = SETTINGS.AntiKickEspFillTransparency
        hl.OutlineTransparency = SETTINGS.AntiKickEspOutlineTransparency
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = item

        AntiKickEspEngine.tracked[item] = {
            hl = hl
        }

        AntiKickEspEngine.ancestryConns[item] = item.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
            if not parent then
                AntiKickEspEngine.clearItem(item)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function isProtectedToy(toy)
        if not toy then return true end
        if toy == AntiKickEngine.activeToy or toy.Name == "AntiKick" then return true end
        if LocalPlayer.Character and toy:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character) then return true end
        local inv = workspace:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name .. "SpawnedInToys")
        if inv and (toy == AntiKickEngine.activeToy or toy.Name == "AntiKick") then return true end
        return false
    end

    function AntiKickEspEngine.scan()
        if not AntiKickEspEngine.active then return end

        local currentSet = {}

        for _, folder in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if folder.Name:match("SpawnedInToys") then
                local isLocal = (folder.Name == LocalPlayer.Name .. "SpawnedInToys")
                if not (SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEnemiesOnly and isLocal) then
                    for _, toy in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                        if not isProtectedToy(toy) then
                            local iType = AntiKickEspEngine.matchItem(toy)
                            if iType then
                                currentSet[toy] = true
                                if not AntiKickEspEngine.tracked[toy] then
                                    AntiKickEspEngine.attach(toy)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if not (SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEnemiesOnly and plr == LocalPlayer) then
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                    for _, toy in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
                        if not isProtectedToy(toy) then
                            local iType = AntiKickEspEngine.matchItem(toy)
                            if iType then
                                currentSet[toy] = true
                                if not AntiKickEspEngine.tracked[toy] then
                                    AntiKickEspEngine.attach(toy)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if not obj.Name:match("SpawnedInToys") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
                if not isProtectedToy(obj) then
                    local iType = AntiKickEspEngine.matchItem(obj)
                    if iType then
                        currentSet[obj] = true
                        if not AntiKickEspEngine.tracked[obj] then
                            AntiKickEspEngine.attach(obj)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for item, _ in pairs(AntiKickEspEngine.tracked) do
            if not currentSet[item] or not item.Parent then
                AntiKickEspEngine.clearItem(item)
            end
        end
    end

    function AntiKickEspEngine.start()
        AntiKickEspEngine.clearAll()
        AntiKickEspEngine.active = true
        SETTINGS.AntiKickESP = true

        AntiKickEspEngine.loopTask = task.spawn(function()
            while AntiKickEspEngine.active do
                pcall(AntiKickEspEngine.scan)
                task.wait(0.35)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(getgenv().XenonTasks, AntiKickEspEngine.loopTask)
    end

    function AntiKickEspEngine.stop()
        AntiKickEspEngine.active = false
        SETTINGS.AntiKickESP = false
        if AntiKickEspEngine.loopTask then
            pcall(function() task.cancel(AntiKickEspEngine.loopTask) end)
            AntiKickEspEngine.loopTask = nil
        end
        AntiKickEspEngine.clearAll()
    end

    function AntiKickEspEngine.toggle(v)
        if v then
            AntiKickEspEngine.start()
        else
            AntiKickEspEngine.stop()
        end
    end

    function AntiKickEspEngine.openSettings()
        openFeatureSettingsModal("Anti-Kick ESP Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
            local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
            desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            desc.Text = "Подсветка предметов кик-защиты (Кирка, Сюрикен, Кунай):"
            desc.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
            desc.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            desc.TextSize = 11
            desc.TextWrapped = true
            desc.ZIndex = 510
            desc.Parent = container

            createModalToggleRow(container, "⛏️ Подсветка Кирки (Pickaxe)", SETTINGS.AntiKickEspPickaxe, function(v)
                SETTINGS.AntiKickEspPickaxe = v
                AntiKickEspEngine.clearAll()
                AntiKickEspEngine.scan()
            end)

            createModalToggleRow(container, "⭐ Подсветка Сюрикена (Shuriken)", SETTINGS.AntiKickEspShuriken, function(v)
                SETTINGS.AntiKickEspShuriken = v
                AntiKickEspEngine.clearAll()
                AntiKickEspEngine.scan()
            end)

            createModalToggleRow(container, "🗡️ Подсветка Куная (Kunai)", SETTINGS.AntiKickEspKunai, function(v)
                SETTINGS.AntiKickEspKunai = v
                AntiKickEspEngine.clearAll()
                AntiKickEspEngine.scan()
            end)

            createModalToggleRow(container, "👥 Только вражеские предметы", SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEnemiesOnly, function(v)
                SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEnemiesOnly = v
                AntiKickEspEngine.clearAll()
                AntiKickEspEngine.scan()
            end)

            createModalSliderRow(container, "Прозрачность заливки (Fill)", SETTINGS.AntiKickEspFillTransparency, 0.0, 1.0, true, function(v)
                SETTINGS.AntiKickEspFillTransparency = v
                AntiKickEspEngine.refresh()
            end)

            createModalSliderRow(container, "Прозрачность обводки (Outline)", SETTINGS.AntiKickEspOutlineTransparency, 0.0, 1.0, true, function(v)
                SETTINGS.AntiKickEspOutlineTransparency = v
                AntiKickEspEngine.refresh()
            end)

            createColorPickerCard(container, "Цвет заливки (По умолчанию белый)", SETTINGS.AntiKickEspColor, function(newCol)
                SETTINGS.AntiKickEspColor = newCol
                AntiKickEspEngine.refresh()
            end)
