            createColorPickerCard(container, "Цвет контура (Чёрная обводка)", SETTINGS.AntiKickEspOutlineColor, function(newCol)
                SETTINGS.AntiKickEspOutlineColor = newCol
                AntiKickEspEngine.refresh()
            end)
        end)
    end

    local PcldEspEngine = {
        active = false,
        tracked = {},
        loopTask = nil,
        descendantConn = nil,
        ancestryConns = {}
    }

    function PcldEspEngine.matchPart(inst)
        if not inst or not inst:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
        local nLower = inst.Name:lower()
        if nLower == "playercharacterlocationdetector"
            or nLower == "partesp"
            or nLower:find("playercharacterlocationdetector")
            or nLower == "pcld" then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    function PcldEspEngine.refresh()
        for part, data in pairs(PcldEspEngine.tracked) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                if data.box and data.box.Parent then
                    data.box.Color3 = SETTINGS.PcldEspOutlineColor
                    data.box.LineThickness = SETTINGS.PcldEspThickness
                    data.box.Transparency = SETTINGS.PcldEspContour and SETTINGS.PcldEspOutlineTransparency or 1
                    data.box.SurfaceColor3 = SETTINGS.PcldEspColor
                    data.box.SurfaceTransparency = SETTINGS.PcldEspFillTransparency
                    data.box.Visible = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function PcldEspEngine.clearPart(part)
        local data = PcldEspEngine.tracked[part]
        if data then
            if data.box then pcall(function() data.box:Destroy() end) end
            PcldEspEngine.tracked[part] = nil
        end
        if PcldEspEngine.ancestryConns[part] then
            pcall(function() PcldEspEngine.ancestryConns[part]:Disconnect() end)
            PcldEspEngine.ancestryConns[part] = nil
        end
    end

    function PcldEspEngine.clearAll()
        for part, _ in pairs(PcldEspEngine.tracked) do
            PcldEspEngine.clearPart(part)
        end
        PcldEspEngine.tracked = {}
        for part, conn in pairs(PcldEspEngine.ancestryConns) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        PcldEspEngine.ancestryConns = {}
    end

    function PcldEspEngine.attach(part)
        if PcldEspEngine.tracked[part] then return end

        local sbox = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
        sbox.Name = "XenonPcldBox"
        sbox.Adornee = part
        sbox.Color3 = SETTINGS.PcldEspOutlineColor
        sbox.LineThickness = SETTINGS.PcldEspThickness
        sbox.Transparency = SETTINGS.PcldEspContour and SETTINGS.PcldEspOutlineTransparency or 1
        sbox.SurfaceColor3 = SETTINGS.PcldEspColor
        sbox.SurfaceTransparency = SETTINGS.PcldEspFillTransparency
        sbox.Visible = true
        safeParentGui(sbox)

        PcldEspEngine.tracked[part] = {
            box = sbox
        }

        PcldEspEngine.ancestryConns[part] = part.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
            if not parent then
                PcldEspEngine.clearPart(part)
            end
        end)
    end

    function PcldEspEngine.scan()
        if not PcldEspEngine.active then return end

        local currentSet = {}
        local seenModels = {}

        for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if PcldEspEngine.matchPart(inst) then
                local model = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                if not model or not seenModels[model] then
                    if model then seenModels[model] = true end
                    currentSet[inst] = true
                    if not PcldEspEngine.tracked[inst] then
                        PcldEspEngine.attach(inst)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for part, _ in pairs(PcldEspEngine.tracked) do
            if not currentSet[part] or not part.Parent then
                PcldEspEngine.clearPart(part)
            end
        end
    end

    function PcldEspEngine.start()
        PcldEspEngine.clearAll()
        PcldEspEngine.active = true
        SETTINGS.PcldESP = true

        if PcldEspEngine.descendantConn then
            pcall(function() PcldEspEngine.descendantConn:Disconnect() end)
            PcldEspEngine.descendantConn = nil
        end
        PcldEspEngine.descendantConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
            if PcldEspEngine.active and PcldEspEngine.matchPart(inst) then
                task.wait(0.05)
                if PcldEspEngine.active and inst.Parent then
                    PcldEspEngine.attach(inst)
                end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(getgenv().XenonConnections, PcldEspEngine.descendantConn)

        PcldEspEngine.loopTask = task.spawn(function()
            while PcldEspEngine.active do
                pcall(PcldEspEngine.scan)
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(getgenv().XenonTasks, PcldEspEngine.loopTask)
    end

    function PcldEspEngine.stop()
        PcldEspEngine.active = false
        SETTINGS.PcldESP = false
        if PcldEspEngine.descendantConn then
            pcall(function() PcldEspEngine.descendantConn:Disconnect() end)
            PcldEspEngine.descendantConn = nil
        end
        if PcldEspEngine.loopTask then
            pcall(function() task.cancel(PcldEspEngine.loopTask) end)
            PcldEspEngine.loopTask = nil
        end
        PcldEspEngine.clearAll()
    end

    function PcldEspEngine.toggle(v)
        if v then
            PcldEspEngine.start()
        else
            PcldEspEngine.stop()
        end
    end

    function PcldEspEngine.openSettings()
        openFeatureSettingsModal("PCLD ESP Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
            local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
            desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            desc.Text = "Подсветка и контуринг детекторов персонажа (PCLD):"
            desc.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
            desc.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            desc.TextSize = 11
            desc.TextWrapped = true
            desc.ZIndex = 510
            desc.Parent = container

            createModalToggleRow(container, "✨ Контуринг детекторов (Outline/Contour)", SETTINGS.PcldEspContour, function(v)
                SETTINGS.PcldEspContour = v
                PcldEspEngine.refresh()
            end)

            createModalSliderRow(container, "Толщина контуринга (Размер линий)", SETTINGS.PcldEspThickness, 0.003, 0.05, false, function(v)
                SETTINGS.PcldEspThickness = v
                PcldEspEngine.refresh()
            end)

            createModalSliderRow(container, "Прозрачность цвета заливки коробки", SETTINGS.PcldEspFillTransparency, 0.0, 1.0, true, function(v)
                SETTINGS.PcldEspFillTransparency = v
                PcldEspEngine.refresh()
            end)

            createModalSliderRow(container, "Прозрачность линий контуринга", SETTINGS.PcldEspOutlineTransparency, 0.0, 1.0, true, function(v)
                SETTINGS.PcldEspOutlineTransparency = v
                PcldEspEngine.refresh()
            end)

            createColorPickerCard(container, "Цвет контуринга (Contour / Outline Color)", SETTINGS.PcldEspOutlineColor, function(newCol)
                SETTINGS.PcldEspOutlineColor = newCol
                PcldEspEngine.refresh()
            end)

            createColorPickerCard(container, "Цвет заливки коробки (Fill Surface Color)", SETTINGS.PcldEspColor, function(newCol)
                SETTINGS.PcldEspColor = newCol
                PcldEspEngine.refresh()
            end)
        end)
    end

    SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEngine = AntiKickEspEngine
    SETTINGS.PcldEspEngine = PcldEspEngine
end

-- Функция добавления современной эстетичной текстуры на окна меню
local function applyModernTexture(frame)
    if not frame or not frame:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
    if frame:FindFirstChild("ModernTextureOverlay") then return end

    local tex = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    tex.Name = "ModernTextureOverlay"
    tex.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    tex.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    tex.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    tex.Image = "rbxassetid://2151741365"
    tex.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
    tex.TileSize = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
    tex.ImageTransparency = 0.92
    tex.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    corner.Parent = tex
end

-- Функция применения стиля Liquid Glass (Жидкое стекло) на окно Zenith GUI
local function applyLiquidGlassStyle(frame)
    if not frame or not frame:IsA("GuiObject") then return end

    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 26)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0

    local corner = frame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner")
    if not corner then
        corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
        corner.Parent = frame
    else
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
    end

    local glassGrad = frame:FindFirstChild("LiquidGlassGradient")
    if not glassGrad then
        glassGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        glassGrad.Name = "LiquidGlassGradient"
        glassGrad.Parent = frame
    end
    glassGrad.Rotation = 90
    glassGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(38, 42, 54)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 28)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(13, 14, 18))
    })
    glassGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.18),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 0.34),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.42)
    })

    local stroke = frame:FindFirstChild("LiquidGlassStroke") or (Window and Window._mainStroke) or frame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
    if not stroke then
        stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Name = "LiquidGlassStroke"
        stroke.Parent = frame
    end
    stroke.Name = "LiquidGlassStroke"
    stroke.Thickness = 1.2
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    local strokeGrad = stroke:FindFirstChild("LiquidGlassStrokeGrad")
    if not strokeGrad then
        strokeGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        strokeGrad.Name = "LiquidGlassStrokeGrad"
        strokeGrad.Parent = stroke
    end
    strokeGrad.Rotation = 90
    strokeGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, Color3.fromRGB(175, 185, 205)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(65, 70, 85))
    })
    strokeGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.28),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.68),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.85)
    })

    -- Верхний глянцевый блик стекла
    local gloss = frame:FindFirstChild("GlassSpecularGloss")
    if not gloss then
        gloss = Instance.new("Frame")
        gloss.Name = "GlassSpecularGloss"
        gloss.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
        gloss.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        gloss.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
        gloss.ZIndex = (frame.ZIndex or 1) + 1
        gloss.Parent = frame

        local glossCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        glossCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
        glossCorner.Parent = gloss

        local gGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        gGrad.Rotation = 90
        gGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.86),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.0)
        })
        gGrad.Parent = gloss
    end

    -- Мягкая внешняя тень глубины стекла
    local shadow = frame:FindFirstChild("GlassShadow")
    if not shadow then
        shadow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        shadow.Name = "GlassShadow"
        shadow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 4)
        shadow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 26, 1, 26)
        shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        shadow.Image = "rbxassetid://6015897843"
        shadow.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        shadow.ImageTransparency = 0.48
        shadow.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
        shadow.SliceCenter = Rect.new(49, 49, 450, 450)
        shadow.ZIndex = math.max(1, (frame.ZIndex or 1) - 1)
        shadow.Parent = frame
    end

    -- Cursor unlock Modal fix
    local modalFix = frame:FindFirstChild("ZenithModalCursorUnlock")
    if not modalFix then
        modalFix = Instance.new("TextButton")
        modalFix.Name = "ZenithModalCursorUnlock"
        modalFix.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        modalFix.Text = ""
        modalFix.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        modalFix.Modal = true
        modalFix.Parent = frame
    end
end

-- [ УПРАВЛЕНИЕ КУРСОРОМ, СТИЛЯМИ МЕНЮ И СИНХРОННЫМ ОТКРЫТИЕМ / ЗАКРЫТИЕМ ]
local currentToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift
local wasModalOpenBeforeClose = false

local function toggleBothMenus()
    if SETTINGS.ActiveMenuStyle == "Columns" then
        if SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui then
            SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui()
        end
    else
        local isWindowOpen = false
        if Window and Window.MainFrame then
            isWindowOpen = Window.MainFrame.Visible
        end

        if isWindowOpen then
            wasModalOpenBeforeClose = (currentModalFrame ~= nil and currentModalFrame.Parent ~= nil and currentModalFrame.Visible)
            if currentModalFrame then
                currentModalFrame.Visible = false
            end
            if Window.Hide then
                pcall(function() Window:Hide() end)
            else
                if Window.MainFrame then Window.MainFrame.Visible = false end
            end
            pcall(function()
                UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
                UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
            end)
            if playUiSound then playUiSound("Close") end
        else
            if Window.ScreenGui then Window.ScreenGui.Enabled = true end
            if Window.Show then
                pcall(function() Window:Show() end)
            else
                if Window.MainFrame then Window.MainFrame.Visible = true end
            end
            pcall(function()
                UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
                UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
            end)
            if playUiSound then playUiSound("Open") end
            if wasModalOpenBeforeClose and currentModalFrame and currentModalFrame.Parent then
                currentModalFrame.Visible = true
            end
        end
    end
end

-- [ ФУНКЦИЯ ПЕРЕКЛЮЧЕНИЯ СТИЛЕЙ МЕНЮ (COLUMNS <-> ZENITH WINDOW) ]
local function setMenuStyle(style)
    if style == "Window" then
        SETTINGS.ActiveMenuStyle = "Window"
        -- 1. Скрываем ClickGUI если он открыт
        if SETTINGS.IsClickGuiOpen and SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui then
            pcall(function() SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui() end)
        end
        -- 2. Открываем Zenith Window
        if Window then
            if Window.ScreenGui then Window.ScreenGui.Enabled = true end
            if Window.Show then
                pcall(function() Window:Show() end)
            elseif Window.MainFrame then
                Window.MainFrame.Visible = true
            end
        end
        -- 3. Активируем курсор мыши
        pcall(function()
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        end)
        if Window and Window.Notify then
            pcall(function()
                Window:Notify({
                    Title = "Zenith Window",
                    Content = "Переключено на оконное меню Zenith! Скрыть/Открыть: " .. (currentToggleKey and currentToggleKey.Name or "RightShift"),
                    Duration = 3
                })
            end)
        end
    elseif style == "Columns" then
        SETTINGS.ActiveMenuStyle = "Columns"
        -- 1. Скрываем Zenith Window если оно открыто
        if Window then
            if Window.Hide then
                pcall(function() Window:Hide() end)
            elseif Window.MainFrame then
                Window.MainFrame.Visible = false
            end
        end
        -- 2. Открываем ClickGUI если он закрыт
        if SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui and not SETTINGS.IsClickGuiOpen then
            pcall(function() SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui() end)
        end
        -- 3. Активируем курсор мыши
        pcall(function()
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        end)
        if Window and Window.Notify then
            pcall(function()
                Window:Notify({
                    Title = "ClickGUI",
                    Content = "Переключено на меню колонками ClickGUI! Скрыть/Открыть: " .. (currentToggleKey and currentToggleKey.Name or "RightShift"),
                    Duration = 3
                })
            end)
        end
    end
end
SETTINGS.SetMenuStyle = setMenuStyle

-- Полностью отключаем внутренний бинд ZenithLib, чтобы он не реагировал на клики мыши
pcall(function()

    ZenithLib.SetToggleKey = function(self, key) end
end)

local menuToggleConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
    if currentToggleKey and input.KeyCode == currentToggleKey then
        toggleBothMenus()
    end
end)
table.insert(getgenv().XenonConnections, menuToggleConn)

                UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default

        end
    end)
end

-- [ 1. ЭФФЕКТ СВЕЧЕНИЯ ОБВОДКИ ПРИ СТАРТЕ ] --
local function runStartupBorderGlow()
    if not Window or not Window.MainFrame or not Window._mainStroke then return end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        local stroke = Window._mainStroke
        local theme = computeCurrentTheme()

        local glowAura = Instance.new("Frame")
        glowAura.Name = "StartupGlowAura"
        glowAura.Size = UDim2.new(1, 14, 1, 14)
        glowAura.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        glowAura.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        glowAura.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        glowAura.BorderSizePixel = 0
        glowAura.ZIndex = Window.MainFrame.ZIndex - 1
        glowAura.Parent = Window.MainFrame

        local auraCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        auraCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
        auraCorner.Parent = glowAura

        local auraStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        auraStroke.Thickness = 4
        auraStroke.Color = theme.Accent
        auraStroke.Transparency = 0.2
        auraStroke.Parent = glowAura

        stroke.Thickness = 2.4
        stroke.Transparency = 0
        stroke.Color = theme.Accent

        local pulse1 = TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.40, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
            Thickness = 2.8,
            Color = theme.Accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.3)
        })
        pulse1:Play()
        task.wait(0.42)

        local pulse2 = TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
            Thickness = 2.0,
            Color = theme.Accent
        })
        pulse2:Play()
        task.wait(0.48)

        local fadeStroke = TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(1.0, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Thickness = 1.2,
            Transparency = 0,
            Color = theme.ElementBorder
        })
        local fadeAura = TweenService:Create(auraStroke, TweenInfo.new(1.0, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Thickness = 1,
            Transparency = 1
        })
        fadeStroke:Play()
        fadeAura:Play()

        fadeAura.Completed:Connect(function() pcall(function() glowAura:Destroy() end) end)
    end)
end

-- [ 2. АНИМАЦИЯ ОТКРЫТИЯ / ЗАКРЫТИЯ ОКНА ] --
local windowScale = Window.MainFrame:FindFirstChild("MenuWindowScale")
if not windowScale then
    windowScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    windowScale.Name = "MenuWindowScale"
    windowScale.Scale = 1
    windowScale.Parent = Window.MainFrame
end

local isMenuAnimating = false
local normalWindowPos = Window.MainFrame.Position

function Window:Show()
    if not self.MainFrame then return end
    isMenuAnimating = false
    self._visible = true
    if self.ScreenGui then self.ScreenGui.Enabled = true end
    self.MainFrame.Visible = true
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default

    if windowScale then windowScale.Scale = 0.85 end
    if not normalWindowPos then normalWindowPos = self.MainFrame.Position end
    self.MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
        normalWindowPos.X.Scale,
        normalWindowPos.X.Offset,
        normalWindowPos.Y.Scale,
        normalWindowPos.Y.Offset + 32
    )

    local tweenPos = TweenService:Create(
        self.MainFrame,
        TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Position = normalWindowPos }
    )
    local tweenScale = TweenService:Create(
        windowScale,
        TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Scale = 1.0 }
    )

    if self._mainStroke then
        self._mainStroke.Transparency = 0.1
        self._mainStroke.Thickness = 1.2
    end

    tweenPos:Play()
    tweenScale:Play()
end

function Window:Hide()
    if not self.MainFrame then return end
    isMenuAnimating = false
    self._visible = false
    if not normalWindowPos then normalWindowPos = self.MainFrame.Position end
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default

    local tweenPos = TweenService:Create(
        self.MainFrame,
        TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
        {
            Position = UDim2.new(
                normalWindowPos.X.Scale,
                normalWindowPos.X.Offset,
                normalWindowPos.Y.Scale,
                normalWindowPos.Y.Offset + 24
            )
        }
    )
    local tweenScale = TweenService:Create(
        windowScale,
        TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
        { Scale = 0.86 }
    )

    tweenPos:Play()
    tweenScale:Play()

    task.delay(0.24, function()
        if not self._visible and self.MainFrame then
            self.MainFrame.Visible = false
            self.MainFrame.Position = normalWindowPos
            if windowScale then windowScale.Scale = 1 end
        end
    end)
end

function Window:Toggle()
    if self._visible then self:Hide() else self:Show() end
end

if Window.CloseButton then
    local closeHitbox = Window.CloseButton:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextButton")
    if closeHitbox then
        closeHitbox.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Window:Hide() end)
    end
end

-- [ ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ ВСЕХ ЭЛЕМЕНТОВ UI ПРИ СМЕНЕ ТЕМЫ ] --
function updateAllGuiElements()
    local theme, effMode = computeCurrentTheme()
    pcall(function() ZenithLib:SetTheme(theme) end)

    if Window and Window.MainFrame then
        applyLiquidGlassStyle(Window.MainFrame)

        if Window.TitleBar then
            Window.TitleBar.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
            Window.TitleBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
        end
        if Window._titleBarGradient then
            Window._titleBarGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, theme.DarkerBackground:Lerp(theme.Accent, effMode == "Light" and 0.05 or 0.12)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, theme.DarkerBackground),
            })
        end
        if Window.TitleText then
            Window.TitleText.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        end
        local subTitle = Window.TitleBar and Window.TitleBar:FindFirstChild("SubTitle")
        if subTitle then
            subTitle.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        end

        if Window.TabNav then
            Window.TabNav.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 17, 22)
            Window.TabNav.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65
        end

        local zHint = Window.MainFrame and Window.MainFrame:FindFirstChild("ZenithBottomHint")
        if zHint then
            zHint.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        end

        -- Обновляем статические цвета всех табов в боковом меню
        if Window._tabScroll then
            for _, tabBtn in pairs(Window._tabScroll:GetChildren()) do
                if tabBtn:IsA("TextButton") then
                    local txt = tabBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
                    local ico = tabBtn:FindFirstChild("TabIcon")
                    local isCurrent = (txt and txt.Text == Window.CurrentTab)
                    local tabStroke = tabBtn:FindFirstChild("TabHoverStroke")
                    if isCurrent then
                        tabBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                        tabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.ActiveTab
                        if tabStroke then
                            tabStroke.Transparency = 0.4
                            tabStroke.Color = theme.Accent
                        end
                        if txt then txt.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText end
                        if ico then ico.ImageColor3 = theme.AccentText end
                    else
                        tabBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        if tabStroke then tabStroke.Transparency = 1 end
                        if txt then txt.TextColor3 = theme.SubText end
                        if ico then ico.ImageColor3 = theme.SubText end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- Глубокое обновление всех контролов ZenithLib внутри окна
        local function styleZenithDescendants(root)
            if not root then return end
            for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                pcall(function()
                    if obj:IsA("Frame") then
                        local name = obj.Name
                        if name:match("^Button_") or name:match("^Dropdown_") or name:match("^Slider_") or
                           name:match("^Keybind_") or name:match("^Paragraph_") or name:match("^ColorPicker_") or
                           name:match("^Toggle_") or name:match("^Textbox_") or name:match("^Input_") then
                            obj.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
                        elseif name == "KeyButton" or name == "PaletteButton" then
                            obj.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
                        elseif name == "Track" then
                            obj.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SliderRail
                        elseif name == "Fill" or name == "Knob" then
                            obj.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent
                        elseif name == "DD_Overlay" or name:match("^DropdownOverlay") then
                            obj.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DropdownHolder
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        local p = obj.Parent
                        local pName = p and p.Name or ""
                        if pName:match("^Section_") then
                            obj.TextColor3 = theme.Accent
                        elseif pName:match("^Button_") then
                            obj.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText
                        elseif obj.Name == "TitleText" then
                            obj.TextColor3 = theme.Text
                        elseif obj.Name == "SubTitle" then
                            obj.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
                        elseif obj.Name == "StatusText" then
                            -- обрабатывается карточкой
                        elseif obj.Name == "ValLabel" or obj.TextSize <= 12 then
                            obj.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
                        else
                            if pName:match("^Slider_") or pName:match("^Dropdown_") or pName:match("^Keybind_") or pName:match("^Paragraph_") or pName:match("^ColorPicker_") then
                                obj.TextColor3 = theme.Text
                            end
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("TextBox") then
                        obj.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
                        obj.TextColor3 = theme.Text
                        obj.PlaceholderColor3 = theme.SubText
                    elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                        if obj.Name == "BtnIcon" then
                            obj.ImageColor3 = theme.AccentText
                        elseif obj.Name ~= "Shadow" and obj.Name ~= "StartupGlowAura" and obj.Name ~= "ModernTextureOverlay" then
                            if not (obj.Parent and obj.Parent.Name:match("^Tab_")) then
                                obj.ImageColor3 = theme.SubText
                            end
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
                        local p = obj.Parent
                        local pName = p and p.Name or ""
                        if p == Window.MainFrame or obj.Name == "LiquidGlassStroke" then
                            -- Сохраняем стиль Liquid Glass
                        elseif pName:match("^Button_") then
                            obj.Color = theme.ElementBorder
                            obj.Transparency = 0.2
                        elseif pName:match("^Tab_") or pName:match("^CardToggle_") or pName == "StatusPill" or pName == "GearButton" then
                            -- управляются своими обработчиками
                        else
                            obj.Color = theme.ElementBorder
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        styleZenithDescendants(Window.MainFrame)
        if Window.ScreenGui then
            styleZenithDescendants(Window.ScreenGui:FindFirstChild("DD_Overlay"))
            styleZenithDescendants(Window.ScreenGui:FindFirstChild("Dropdown_Overlay"))
        end
    end

    for _, card in ipairs(REGISTERED_CARD_TOGGLES) do
        pcall(function() card:UpdateTheme() end)
    end
    if updateXenonHUDTheme then
        pcall(updateXenonHUDTheme)
    end
    if setupTabHoverAnimations then
        pcall(setupTabHoverAnimations)
    end
end

-- [ 3. УСИЛЕННАЯ АНИМАЦИЯ НАВЕДЕНИЯ НА ВКЛАДКИ (SCALE = 1.12) ] --
setupTabHoverAnimations = function()
    if not Window or not Window._tabScroll then return end
    
    for _, tabBtn in pairs(Window._tabScroll:GetChildren()) do
        if tabBtn:IsA("TextButton") and not tabBtn:GetAttribute("TabHoverAttached") then
            tabBtn:SetAttribute("TabHoverAttached", true)
            
            local tabScale = tabBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
            if not tabScale then
                tabScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
                tabScale.Scale = 1
                tabScale.Parent = tabBtn
            end

            local tabStroke = tabBtn:FindFirstChild("TabHoverStroke")
            if not tabStroke then
                tabStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                tabStroke.Name = "TabHoverStroke"
                tabStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
                tabStroke.Thickness = 1.4
                tabStroke.Transparency = 1
                tabStroke.Parent = tabBtn
            end

            local txt = tabBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
            local ico = tabBtn:FindFirstChild("TabIcon")

            tabBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                local theme, effMode = computeCurrentTheme()
                local isCurrent = (txt and txt.Text == Window.CurrentTab)

                -- Явное сочное увеличение вкладки
                TweenService:Create(tabScale, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    Scale = 1.12
                }):Play()

                tabBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                tabStroke.Transparency = 0.2
                tabStroke.Color = theme.Accent

                if isCurrent then
                    TweenService:Create(tabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                        BackgroundColor3 = theme.ActiveTab:Lerp(theme.Accent, 0.35)
                    }):Play()
                else
                    TweenService:Create(tabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                        BackgroundColor3 = effMode == "Light" and Color3.fromRGB(222, 226, 238) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 46)
                    }):Play()
                end

                if txt then TweenService:Create(txt, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { TextColor3 = theme.AccentText }):Play() end
                if ico then TweenService:Create(ico, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { ImageColor3 = theme.AccentText }):Play() end
            end)

            tabBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                local theme, effMode = computeCurrentTheme()
                local isCurrent = (txt and txt.Text == Window.CurrentTab)

                TweenService:Create(tabScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    Scale = 1.0
                }):Play()

                if isCurrent then
                    tabStroke.Transparency = 0.4
                    tabStroke.Color = theme.Accent
                    TweenService:Create(tabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                        BackgroundColor3 = theme.ActiveTab,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 0
                    }):Play()
                    if txt then TweenService:Create(txt, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { TextColor3 = theme.AccentText }):Play() end
                    if ico then TweenService:Create(ico, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { ImageColor3 = theme.AccentText }):Play() end
                else
                    tabStroke.Transparency = 1
                    TweenService:Create(tabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
                    if txt then TweenService:Create(txt, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { TextColor3 = theme.SubText }):Play() end
                    if ico then TweenService:Create(ico, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { ImageColor3 = theme.SubText }):Play() end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- [ 4. ВСПЛЫВАЮЩЕЕ ОКНО НАСТРОЕК ФУНКЦИЙ В СТИЛЕ LIQUID GLASS (ЖИДКОЕ СТЕКЛО) ] --
currentModalFrame = nil

openFeatureSettingsModal = function(titleText, contentBuilder)
    if playUiSound then playUiSound("Open") end
    if currentModalFrame then
        pcall(function() currentModalFrame:Destroy() end)
        currentModalFrame = nil
    end

    local theme, effMode = computeCurrentTheme()

    local modalScreenGui = nil
    pcall(function()
        if gethui then
            local hui = (gethui :: any)()
            if hui then

            end
        end
    end)
    if not modalScreenGui then
        pcall(function()
            local cg = (game:GetService("CoreGui") :: any)
            if cg then modalScreenGui = cg:FindFirstChild("XenonModal_Screen") end

        TweenService:Create(overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        local t = TweenService:Create(modalScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.88 })

    contentFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 54)
    contentFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    contentFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    contentFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    contentFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 85, 255)
    contentFrame.ZIndex = 4
    contentFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    contentFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    contentFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
    contentFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
    contentFrame.Parent = modal

    local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    list.Parent = contentFrame

    local listPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    listPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
    listPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12)
    listPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
    listPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
    listPad.Parent = contentFrame

    -- Построение содержимого модала с защитой pcall
    if contentBuilder then
        local success, buildErr = pcall(function()
            contentBuilder(contentFrame, theme, effMode)
        end)
        if not success then
            warn("[Xenon] Error in contentBuilder: " .. tostring(buildErr))
        end
    end

    -- Анимация плавного появления
    TweenService:Create(overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.22), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 }):Play()
    TweenService:Create(modalScale, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.0 }):Play()
end

function AntiGrabEngine.openSettings()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Anti-Grab Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")

        local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        desc.Text = "Параметры защиты от захватов:"

        local optsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        optsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
        optsLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        optsLayout.Parent = optsFrame

        local function makeModernToggleCard(title, subtitle, defaultVal, callback)
            local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
            card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
            card.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground

            tLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6)
            tLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

            local pill = Instance.new("Frame")
            pill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 20)
            pill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0.5, -10)
            pill.BackgroundColor3 = defaultVal and theme.Accent or theme.MainBackground
            pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
            pill.ZIndex = 512
            pill.Parent = card

            local pillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            pillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            pillCorner.Parent = pill

            local circle = Instance.new("Frame")
            circle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
            circle.Position = defaultVal and UDim2.new(1, -17, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -7)
            circle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            circle.BorderSizePixel = 0
            circle.ZIndex = 513
            circle.Parent = pill

            local circCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            circCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            circCorner.Parent = circle

            local state = defaultVal
            card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                state = not state
                local curTh = computeCurrentTheme()
                TweenService:Create(circle, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {
                    Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -17, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -7)
                }):Play()
                pill.BackgroundColor3 = state and curTh.Accent or curTh.MainBackground
                stroke.Color = state and curTh.Accent or curTh.ElementBorder
                stroke.Transparency = state and 0.2 or 0.6
                tLabel.TextColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or curTh.Text
                callback(state)
            end)
        end

        makeModernToggleCard("Вайтлист друзей (Roblox)", "Разрешить только друзьям брать вас в руки при Anti-Grab", SETTINGS.AntiGrabFriendWhitelist, function(v)
            SETTINGS.AntiGrabFriendWhitelist = v
        end)

        makeModernToggleCard("Авто-ходьба при захвате", "Позволяет двигаться и срывать захват на ходу", SETTINGS.AntiGrabWalk, function(v)
            SETTINGS.AntiGrabWalk = v
        end)

        -- Список игроков для ручного вайтлиста
        local sep = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        sep.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
        sep.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        sep.Text = "Вайтлист конкретных игроков:"
        sep.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        sep.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        sep.TextSize = 11
        sep.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        sep.ZIndex = 510
        sep.Parent = container

        local plrsScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
        plrsScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 160)
        plrsScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        plrsScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
        plrsScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = theme.Accent
        plrsScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        plrsScroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        plrsScroll.ZIndex = 510
        plrsScroll.Parent = container

        local plrsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        plrsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
        plrsLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        plrsLayout.Parent = plrsScroll

        local otherPlayers = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(otherPlayers, p) end
        end

        for _, plr in ipairs(otherPlayers) do
            local isWhitelisted = (SETTINGS.AntiGrabWhitelistedPlayers[plr.Name] == true)
            local isFriend = false
            pcall(function() isFriend = LocalPlayer:IsFriendsWith(plr.UserId) end)

            local pCard = Instance.new("TextButton")
            pCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 34)
            pCard.BackgroundColor3 = isWhitelisted and theme.Accent or theme.InputBackground
            pCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
            pCard.Text = ""
            pCard.AutoButtonColor = false
            pCard.ZIndex = 511
            pCard.Parent = plrsScroll

            local pCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            pCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
            pCorner.Parent = pCard

            local pStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            pStroke.Thickness = 1
            pStroke.Color = isWhitelisted and theme.Accent or theme.ElementBorder
            pStroke.Transparency = isWhitelisted and 0.2 or 0.6
            pStroke.Parent = pCard

            local pName = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            pName.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, 0)
            pName.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
            pName.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            pName.Text = plr.DisplayName .. (isFriend and " [ДРУГ]" or "")
            pName.TextColor3 = isWhitelisted and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or theme.Text
            pName.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            pName.TextSize = 11
            pName.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            pName.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            pName.ZIndex = 512
            pName.Parent = pCard

            local pillText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            pillText.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 20)
            pillText.Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0.5, -10)
            pillText.BackgroundColor3 = isWhitelisted and Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 55, 70)
            pillText.Text = isWhitelisted and "ВАЙТЛИСТ" or "ВЫКЛ"
            pillText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            pillText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            pillText.TextSize = 9
            pillText.BorderSizePixel = 0
            pillText.ZIndex = 512
            pillText.Parent = pCard

            local pCornerPill = Instance.new("UICorner")
            pCornerPill.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            pCornerPill.Parent = pillText

            pCard.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local newVal = not (SETTINGS.AntiGrabWhitelistedPlayers[plr.Name] == true)
                SETTINGS.AntiGrabWhitelistedPlayers[plr.Name] = newVal
                local curTh = computeCurrentTheme()
                pCard.BackgroundColor3 = newVal and curTh.Accent or curTh.InputBackground
                pName.TextColor3 = newVal and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or curTh.Text
                pStroke.Color = newVal and curTh.Accent or curTh.ElementBorder
                pStroke.Transparency = newVal and 0.2 or 0.6
                pillText.BackgroundColor3 = newVal and Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 55, 70)
                pillText.Text = newVal and "ВАЙТЛИСТ" or "ВЫКЛ"
            end)
        end
    end)
end

function AntiKickEngine.openSettings()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Anti Kick Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
        local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
        desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        desc.Text = "Выберите предмет, который входит в живот с подсветкой:"
        desc.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        desc.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        desc.TextSize = 12
        desc.TextWrapped = true
        desc.ZIndex = 510
        desc.Parent = container

        local optFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        optFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 110)
        optFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        optFrame.ZIndex = 510
        optFrame.Parent = container

        local options = {
            { Name = "Сюрикен (NinjaShuriken)", Key = "NinjaShuriken" },
            { Name = "Кунай (NinjaKunai)", Key = "NinjaKunai" }
        }

        local buttons = {}
        for idx, opt in ipairs(options) do
            local isSel = (SETTINGS.AntiKickToy == opt.Key)
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
            btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, (idx - 1) * 52)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and theme.Accent or theme.InputBackground
            btn.Text = (isSel and "✓  " or "   ") .. opt.Name
            btn.TextColor3 = isSel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or theme.Text
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            btn.TextSize = 13
            btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            btn.ZIndex = 511
            btn.Parent = optFrame

            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            corner.Parent = btn

            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            stroke.Thickness = 1
            stroke.Color = isSel and theme.Accent or theme.ElementBorder
            stroke.Transparency = 0.4
            stroke.Parent = btn

            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                SETTINGS.AntiKickToy = opt.Key
                for oOpt, oBtn in pairs(buttons) do
                    local sel = (oOpt.Key == opt.Key)
                    local curTh = computeCurrentTheme()
                    oBtn.BackgroundColor3 = sel and curTh.Accent or curTh.InputBackground
                    oBtn.TextColor3 = sel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or curTh.Text
                    oBtn.Text = (sel and "✓  " or "   ") .. oOpt.Name
                    local s = oBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if s then s.Color = sel and curTh.Accent or curTh.ElementBorder end
                end
                if SETTINGS.AntiKick then
                    AntiKickEngine.stop()
                    AntiKickEngine.start()
                end
            end)
            buttons[opt] = btn
        end
    end)
end

function AntiInputEngine.openSettings()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Anti Input Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)

        local buttons = {}

            local isSel = (SETTINGS.AntiInputItem == item.Id)
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and theme.Accent or theme.InputBackground
            btn.Text = (isSel and "✓ " or "") .. item.Name .. " (" .. item.Category .. ")"
            btn.TextColor3 = isSel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or theme.Text
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            btn.TextSize = 11
            btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            btn.LayoutOrder = idx
            btn.ZIndex = 511
            btn.Parent = gridFrame

            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
            corner.Parent = btn

            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            stroke.Thickness = 1
            stroke.Color = isSel and theme.Accent or theme.ElementBorder
            stroke.Transparency = 0.4
            stroke.Parent = btn

            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                SETTINGS.AntiInputItem = item.Id
                for otherItem, otherBtn in pairs(buttons) do
                    local sel = (otherItem.Id == item.Id)
                    local curTh = computeCurrentTheme()
                    otherBtn.BackgroundColor3 = sel and curTh.Accent or curTh.InputBackground
                    otherBtn.TextColor3 = sel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or curTh.Text
                    otherBtn.Text = (sel and "✓ " or "") .. otherItem.Name .. " (" .. otherItem.Category .. ")"
                    local s = otherBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if s then s.Color = sel and curTh.Accent or curTh.ElementBorder end
                end
                if SETTINGS.AntiInput then
                    AntiInputEngine.stop()
                    AntiInputEngine.start()
                end
            end)
            buttons[item] = btn
        end
    end)
end

            local swCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

                local curTh = computeCurrentTheme()
                local targetColor = state and curTh.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(44, 46, 58)

                TweenService:Create(tLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { TextColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or curTh.Text }):Play()

        end

            local pCard = Instance.new("TextButton")

            dName.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 18)
            dName.Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 4)
            dName.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            dName.Text = plr.DisplayName
            dName.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            dName.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            dName.TextSize = 12
            dName.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            dName.ZIndex = 512
            dName.Parent = pCard

            local uName = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            uName.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 14)
            uName.Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 22)
            uName.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            uName.Text = "@" .. plr.Name
            uName.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
            uName.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            uName.TextSize = 10
            uName.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            uName.ZIndex = 512
            uName.Parent = pCard

            local statusPill = Instance.new("Frame")
            statusPill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 22)
            statusPill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -82, 0.5, -11)
            statusPill.BackgroundColor3 = isProt and theme.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(36, 38, 50)
            statusPill.BorderSizePixel = 0
            statusPill.ZIndex = 512
            statusPill.Parent = pCard

            local pillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            pillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
            pillCorner.Parent = statusPill

            local pillText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            pillText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            pillText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            pillText.Text = isProt and "ЗАЩИТА" or "ВЫКЛ"
            pillText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            pillText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            pillText.TextSize = 10
            pillText.ZIndex = 513
            pillText.Parent = statusPill

            pCard.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local newProt = not (SETTINGS.TeamProtectedPlayers[plr.Name] == true)
                SETTINGS.TeamProtectedPlayers[plr.Name] = newProt
                local curTh = computeCurrentTheme()
                TweenService:Create(pCard, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundColor3 = newProt and (curTh.InputBackground:Lerp(curTh.Accent, 0.12)) or curTh.InputBackground }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(pStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Color = newProt and curTh.Accent or curTh.ElementBorder, Transparency = newProt and 0.2 or 0.6 }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(statusPill, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundColor3 = newProt and curTh.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(36, 38, 50) }):Play()
                pillText.Text = newProt and "ЗАЩИТА" or "ВЫКЛ"
                if not newProt and TeamProtectEngine.friendToys[plr.Name] then
                    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                    local destroyRE = RS:FindFirstChild("MenuToys") and RS.MenuToys:FindFirstChild("DestroyToy")
                    if destroyRE then pcall(function() destroyRE:FireServer(TeamProtectEngine.friendToys[plr.Name]) end) end
                    TeamProtectEngine.friendToys[plr.Name] = nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end


-- [ 5. МОДУЛЬНЫЕ КВАДРАТИКИ С ШЕСТЕРЕНКАМИ И УСИЛЕННЫМ HOVER (SCALE = 1.07) ] --
local function makeCardGrid(parentTabFrame, layoutOrder)
    local grid = Instance.new("Frame")
    grid.Name = "CardGrid"
    grid.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    grid.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    grid.BorderSizePixel = 0
    grid.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder or 1
    grid.Parent = parentTabFrame

    local layout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
    layout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -5, 0, 76)
    layout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8)
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Parent = grid

    layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
        grid.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
    end)

    return grid
end

local function makeCardToggle(parentGrid, config)
    local Name           = config.Name or "Feature"
    local Default        = config.Default or false
    local Callback       = config.Callback or function() end
    local HasSettings    = config.HasSettings or false
    local OnOpenSettings = config.OnOpenSettings or nil
    local isOn           = Default

    local theme, effMode = computeCurrentTheme()

    local card = Instance.new("Frame")
    card.Name = "CardToggle_" .. Name
    card.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and (theme.InputBackground:Lerp(theme.Accent, 0.12)) or theme.InputBackground
    card.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    card.BorderSizePixel = 0
    card.Active = true
    card.Parent = parentGrid

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    corner.Parent = card

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Name = "CardStroke"
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stroke.Thickness = 1.1
    stroke.Transparency = isOn and 0.15 or 0.6
    stroke.Color = isOn and theme.Accent or theme.ElementBorder
    stroke.Parent = card

    local cardScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    cardScale.Name = "CardScale"
    cardScale.Scale = 1
    cardScale.Parent = card

    -- [ STATUS PILL ]
    local pill = Instance.new("Frame")
    pill.Name = "StatusPill"
    pill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 68, 0, 20)
    pill.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    pill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
    pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pill.Parent = card

    local pillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    pillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    pillCorner.Parent = pill

    local pillStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    pillStroke.Name = "PillStroke"
    pillStroke.Thickness = 0.8
    pillStroke.Transparency = 0.6
    pillStroke.Color = isOn and theme.Accent or theme.ElementBorder
    pillStroke.Parent = pill

    local statusDot = Instance.new("Frame")
    statusDot.Name = "StatusDot"
    statusDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7)
    statusDot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -3)
    statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and Color3.fromRGB(50, 230, 130) or Color3.fromRGB(155, 158, 175)
    statusDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    statusDot.Parent = pill

    local dotCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    dotCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    dotCorner.Parent = statusDot

    local statusLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    statusLbl.Name = "StatusText"
    statusLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 1, 0)
    statusLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 0)
    statusLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    statusLbl.Text = isOn and "ACTIVE" or "OFF"
    statusLbl.TextColor3 = isOn and (effMode == "Light" and Color3.fromRGB(20, 130, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(65, 230, 140)) or theme.SubText
    statusLbl.TextSize = 10
    statusLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    statusLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    statusLbl.Parent = pill

    -- [ ШЕСТЕРЕНКА НАСТРОЕК (⚙️) ЕСЛИ ДОСТУПНА ]
    local gearBtn = nil
    local gearScale = nil
    if HasSettings then
        gearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        gearBtn.Name = "GearButton"
        gearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 22)
        gearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 9)
        gearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
        gearBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        gearBtn.Text = "•••"
        gearBtn.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        gearBtn.TextSize = 13
        gearBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        gearBtn.ZIndex = 25
        gearBtn.Parent = card

        local gCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        gCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        gCorner.Parent = gearBtn

        local gStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        gStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        gStroke.Transparency = 0.5
        gStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        gStroke.Parent = gearBtn

        gearScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        gearScale.Scale = 1
        gearScale.Parent = gearBtn

        gearBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            local cTheme = computeCurrentTheme()
            TweenService:Create(gearScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), { Scale = 1.18 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(gearBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { TextColor3 = cTheme.Accent, Rotation = 45 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(gStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Color = cTheme.Accent }):Play()
        end)
        gearBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            local cTheme = computeCurrentTheme()
            TweenService:Create(gearScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(gearBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { TextColor3 = cTheme.SubText, Rotation = 0 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(gStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Color = cTheme.ElementBorder }):Play()
        end)
        gearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if OnOpenSettings then
                OnOpenSettings()
            end
        end)
        gearBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
                if OnOpenSettings then
                    pcall(OnOpenSettings)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- [ МИНИ-СВИТЧ ]
    local switchTrack = Instance.new("Frame")
    switchTrack.Name = "SwitchTrack"
    switchTrack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 18)
    switchTrack.Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, 11)
    switchTrack.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and theme.Accent or (effMode == "Light" and Color3.fromRGB(210, 215, 226) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 52))
    switchTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
    switchTrack.Parent = card

    local switchCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    switchCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    switchCorner.Parent = switchTrack

    local switchKnob = Instance.new("Frame")
    switchKnob.Name = "SwitchKnob"
    switchKnob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
    switchKnob.Position = isOn and UDim2.new(1, -15, 0.5, -6) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -6)
    switchKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    switchKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    switchKnob.Parent = switchTrack

    local knobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    knobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    knobCorner.Parent = switchKnob

    -- [ НАЗВАНИЕ МОДУЛЯ ]
    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Name = "CardTitle"
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22)
    title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 1, -29)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Text = Name
    title.TextColor3 = isOn and theme.Text or theme.SubText
    title.TextSize = 13
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.Parent = card

    local function updateCardVisuals(animate)
        local curTheme, curEffMode = computeCurrentTheme()
        local bgTarget = isOn and (curTheme.InputBackground:Lerp(curTheme.Accent, 0.12)) or curTheme.InputBackground
        local strokeCol = isOn and curTheme.Accent or curTheme.ElementBorder
        local strokeTrans = isOn and 0.15 or 0.6
        local txtCol = isOn and curTheme.Text or curTheme.SubText
        local dotCol = isOn and (curEffMode == "Light" and Color3.fromRGB(20, 140, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 235, 130)) or curTheme.SubText
        local statusTxtCol = isOn and (curEffMode == "Light" and Color3.fromRGB(20, 130, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(65, 230, 140)) or curTheme.SubText
        local trackCol = isOn and curTheme.Accent or (curEffMode == "Light" and Color3.fromRGB(210, 215, 226) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 52))
        local knobPos = isOn and UDim2.new(1, -15, 0.5, -6) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -6)

        statusLbl.Text = isOn and "ACTIVE" or "OFF"

        if animate then
            TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = bgTarget }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Color = strokeCol, Transparency = strokeTrans }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(title, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { TextColor3 = txtCol }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(pill, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = curTheme.DarkerBackground }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(pillStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Color = strokeCol }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(statusDot, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = dotCol }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(statusLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { TextColor3 = statusTxtCol }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(switchTrack, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = trackCol }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(switchKnob, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = knobPos }):Play()
            if gearBtn then
                TweenService:Create(gearBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = curTheme.DarkerBackground }):Play()
            end
        else
            card.BackgroundColor3 = bgTarget
            stroke.Color = strokeCol
            stroke.Transparency = strokeTrans
            title.TextColor3 = txtCol
            pill.BackgroundColor3 = curTheme.DarkerBackground
            pillStroke.Color = strokeCol
            statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = dotCol
            statusLbl.TextColor3 = statusTxtCol
            switchTrack.BackgroundColor3 = trackCol
            switchKnob.Position = knobPos
            if gearBtn then
                gearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = curTheme.DarkerBackground
            end
        end
    end

    -- [ УСИЛЕННЫЙ HOVER ЭФФЕКТ КАРТОЧКИ (SCALE = 1.07) ]
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = "Hitbox"
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.ZIndex = 5
    btn.Active = true
    btn.Parent = card

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        local curTheme = computeCurrentTheme()
        -- Заметное, сочное увеличение карточки
        TweenService:Create(cardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.07 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Color = curTheme.Accent, Transparency = 0.1 }):Play()
    end)

    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(cardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.0 }):Play()
        updateCardVisuals(true)
    end)

    btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(cardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Scale = 0.95 }):Play()
    end)

    btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(cardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), { Scale = 1.07 }):Play()
    end)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        isOn = not isOn
        updateCardVisuals(true)
        Callback(isOn)
        if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
    end)

    -- Открытие настроек по клику колесика мыши (СКМ)
    btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
            if HasSettings and OnOpenSettings then
                pcall(OnOpenSettings)
            end
        end
    end)
    card.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
            if HasSettings and OnOpenSettings then
                pcall(OnOpenSettings)
            end
        end
    end)

    local cardObj = {
        Frame = card,
        Set = function(self, val)
            isOn = val == true
            updateCardVisuals(true)
            Callback(isOn)
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end,
        SetValue = function(self, val)
            isOn = val == true
            updateCardVisuals(true)
            Callback(isOn)
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end,
        SetState = function(self, val, skipCallback)
            isOn = val == true
            updateCardVisuals(true)
            if not skipCallback then Callback(isOn) end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end,
        Get = function(self) return isOn end,
        GetValue = function(self) return isOn end,
        UpdateTheme = function(self) updateCardVisuals(false) end
    }

    table.insert(REGISTERED_CARD_TOGGLES, cardObj)
    return cardObj
end

-- [ ФУНКЦИЯ НАСТРОЕК SILENT AIM И ДАЛЬНОСТИ ХВАТА (⚙️) ] --
local function openSilentAimSettings()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Silent Aim & Grab Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
        -- 1. Слайдер дальности хвата (Grab Distance)
        local grabRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        grabRow.Name = "GrabDistanceCard"
        grabRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 84)
        grabRow.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        grabRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        grabRow.Active = true
        grabRow.ZIndex = 4
        grabRow.Parent = container

        local grCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        grCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        grCorner.Parent = grabRow

        local grStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        grStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        grStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        grStroke.Parent = grabRow

        local grTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        grTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 20)
        grTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
        grTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        grTitle.Text = "Grab Distance (Дальность хвата)"
        grTitle.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        grTitle.TextSize = 12
        grTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        grTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        grTitle.ZIndex = 5
        grTitle.Parent = grabRow

        local currentDist = SETTINGS.TargetLimit or 33
        local grVal = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        grVal.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 20)
        grVal.Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 6)
        grVal.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        grVal.Text = tostring(currentDist) .. " studs"
        grVal.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText or theme.Accent
        grVal.TextSize = 11
        grVal.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        grVal.ZIndex = 5
        grVal.Parent = grabRow

        local grRail = Instance.new("Frame")
        grRail.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 6)
        grRail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 32)
        grRail.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SliderRail
        grRail.BorderSizePixel = 0
        grRail.Active = true
        grRail.ZIndex = 5
        grRail.Parent = grabRow

        local grrCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        grrCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        grrCorner.Parent = grRail

        local minDist = 10
        local maxDist = 150
        local grFrac = math.clamp((currentDist - minDist) / (maxDist - minDist), 0, 1)

        local grFill = Instance.new("Frame")
        grFill.Size = UDim2.new(grFrac, 0, 1, 0)
        grFill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent
        grFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        grFill.ZIndex = 6
        grFill.Parent = grRail

        local grfCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        grfCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        grfCorner.Parent = grFill

        local grBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        grBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
        grBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
        grBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        grBtn.Text = ""
        grBtn.Active = true
        grBtn.ZIndex = 7
        grBtn.Parent = grabRow

        local function setGrabDistance(dist)
            dist = math.clamp(math.floor(dist), minDist, maxDist)
            SETTINGS.TargetLimit = dist
            u25 = dist
            if ForceAdjust then pcall(function() ForceAdjust(dist) end) end
            if UI_ELEMENTS.GrabDistanceLimit then
                pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.GrabDistanceLimit:SetValue(dist) end)
            end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
            grVal.Text = tostring(dist) .. " studs"
            local f = math.clamp((dist - minDist) / (maxDist - minDist), 0, 1)
            grFill.Size = UDim2.new(f, 0, 1, 0)
        end

        local draggingGr = false
        grBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            draggingGr = true
            local ap = grRail.AbsolutePosition
            local as = grRail.AbsoluteSize
            local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local pct = math.clamp((mp.X - ap.X) / as.X, 0, 1)
            setGrabDistance(minDist + pct * (maxDist - minDist))
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then draggingGr = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if draggingGr and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local ap = grRail.AbsolutePosition
                local as = grRail.AbsoluteSize
                local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local pct = math.clamp((mp.X - ap.X) / as.X, 0, 1)
                setGrabDistance(minDist + pct * (maxDist - minDist))
            end
        end)

        -- Кнопки быстрой установки дистанции (Presets)
        local presetContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
        presetContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22)
        presetContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
        presetContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        presetContainer.ZIndex = 5
        presetContainer.Parent = grabRow

        local pLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        pLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        pLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
        pLayout.Parent = presetContainer

        local presets = { 20, 33, 50, 75, 100, 150 }
        for _, pVal in ipairs(presets) do
            local pBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            pBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 22)
            pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
            pBtn.Text = tostring(pVal)
            pBtn.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
            pBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            pBtn.TextSize = 10
            pBtn.ZIndex = 6
            pBtn.Parent = presetContainer

            local pCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            pCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            pCorner.Parent = pBtn

            pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                setGrabDistance(pVal)
            end)
        end

        -- 2. Silent Aim Toggle
        local mkToggle = _G.XenonModalToggle or createModalToggleRow
        mkToggle(container, "Silent Aim (Аимбот)", u24, function(v)
            u24 = v
            if UI_ELEMENTS.SilentAim then
                pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.SilentAim:Set(v) end)
            end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end)

        -- 3. Выбор целевого игрока (Target Player)
        local targetSection = Instance.new("Frame")
        targetSection.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
        targetSection.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        targetSection.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        targetSection.BorderSizePixel = 0
        targetSection.ZIndex = 510
        targetSection.Parent = container

        local tsCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        tsCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        tsCorner.Parent = targetSection

        local tsStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        tsStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        tsStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        tsStroke.Parent = targetSection

        local tsHeader = Instance.new("Frame")
        tsHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
        tsHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tsHeader.Parent = targetSection

        local tsTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tsTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0)
        tsTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
        tsTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tsTitle.Text = "Цель (Target):"
        tsTitle.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        tsTitle.TextSize = 12
        tsTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        tsTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        tsTitle.Parent = tsHeader

        local tsVal = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tsVal.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 1, 0)
        tsVal.Position = UDim2.new(0, 105, 0, 0)
        tsVal.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tsVal.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        tsVal.TextSize = 11
        tsVal.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText or theme.Accent
        tsVal.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        tsVal.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        tsVal.Text = (SETTINGS.TargetPlayer and SETTINGS.TargetPlayer ~= "") and SETTINGS.TargetPlayer or "[Авто]"
        tsVal.Parent = tsHeader

        local tsArrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tsArrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0)
        tsArrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 0)
        tsArrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tsArrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        tsArrow.TextSize = 10
        tsArrow.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        tsArrow.Text = "▼"
        tsArrow.Parent = tsHeader

        local tsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        tsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
        tsBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tsBtn.Text = ""
        tsBtn.ZIndex = 515
        tsBtn.Parent = tsHeader

        local tsDropdown = Instance.new("Frame")
        tsDropdown.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0)
        tsDropdown.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 34)
        tsDropdown.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        tsDropdown.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tsDropdown.Visible = false
        tsDropdown.Parent = targetSection

        local tsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        tsLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
        tsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
        tsLayout.Parent = tsDropdown

        local isTsOpen = false
        local function refreshModalTargets()
            for _, ch in ipairs(tsDropdown:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("TextButton") or ch:IsA("Frame") then ch:Destroy() end
            end

            -- Auto row
            local aRow = Instance.new("TextButton")
            aRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
            aRow.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
            aRow.Text = "  [ Авто / Все игроки ]"
            aRow.TextColor3 = theme.Accent
            aRow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            aRow.TextSize = 10
            aRow.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            aRow.Parent = tsDropdown
            Instance.new("UICorner", aRow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

            aRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                SETTINGS.SelectedTargets = {}
                SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = ""
                tsVal.Text = "[Авто]"
                refreshModalTargets()
                if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
            end)

            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer then
                    local pName = p.Name
                    local isSel = (SETTINGS.SelectedTargets and SETTINGS.SelectedTargets[pName] == true)
                    local pBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    pBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
                    pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and theme.Accent or theme.DarkerBackground
                    pBtn.BackgroundTransparency = isSel and 0.3 or 0.7
                    pBtn.Text = "  " .. (p.DisplayName ~= pName and (p.DisplayName .. " (@" .. pName .. ")") or pName) .. (isSel and "  ✓" or "")
                    pBtn.TextColor3 = isSel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or theme.Text
