                    pBtn.Font = isSel and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                    pBtn.TextSize = 10
                    pBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    pBtn.Parent = tsDropdown
                    Instance.new("UICorner", pBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

                    pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        if not SETTINGS.SelectedTargets then SETTINGS.SelectedTargets = {} end
                        if SETTINGS.SelectedTargets[pName] then
                            SETTINGS.SelectedTargets[pName] = nil
                        else
                            SETTINGS.SelectedTargets[pName] = true
                        end
                        local list = {}
                        for n, s in pairs(SETTINGS.SelectedTargets) do
                            if s then table.insert(list, n) end
                        end
                        if #list == 0 then
                            SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = ""
                            tsVal.Text = "[Авто]"
                        elseif #list == 1 then
                            SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = list[1]
                            tsVal.Text = list[1]
                        elseif #list == 2 then
                            SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = list[1] .. ", " .. list[2]
                            tsVal.Text = list[1] .. ", " .. list[2]
                        else
                            SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = table.concat(list, ", ")
                            tsVal.Text = "[" .. tostring(#list) .. " цели]"
                        end
                        refreshModalTargets()
                        if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        tsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            isTsOpen = not isTsOpen
            tsArrow.Text = isTsOpen and "▲" or "▼"
            if isTsOpen then
                refreshModalTargets()
                tsDropdown.Visible = true
            else
                tsDropdown.Visible = false
            end
        end)
    end)
end

-- [ ФУНКЦИЯ ДЛЯ ПОСТРОЕНИЯ НАСТРОЕК КАМЕРЫ / THIRD PERSON (⚙️) ] --
local function openCameraSettings()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Camera Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
        -- 1. Max Zoom Distance Slider
        local maxRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        maxRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52)
        maxRow.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        maxRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        maxRow.Active = true
        maxRow.ZIndex = 510
        maxRow.Parent = container

        local mxCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        mxCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        mxCorner.Parent = maxRow

        local mxStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        mxStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        mxStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        mxStroke.Parent = maxRow

        local mxTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        mxTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 20)
        mxTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
        mxTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        mxTitle.Text = "Max Zoom (Отдаление)"
        mxTitle.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        mxTitle.TextSize = 12
        mxTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        mxTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        mxTitle.Parent = maxRow

        local mxVal = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        mxVal.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 20)
        mxVal.Position = UDim2.new(1, -85, 0, 6)
        mxVal.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        mxVal.Text = tostring(playerSettings.MaxZoomDistance) .. " studs"
        mxVal.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText
        mxVal.TextSize = 11
        mxVal.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        mxVal.Parent = maxRow

        local mxRail = Instance.new("Frame")
        mxRail.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 5)
        mxRail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 34)
        mxRail.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SliderRail
        mxRail.BorderSizePixel = 0
        mxRail.Active = true
        mxRail.Parent = maxRow

        local mxrCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        mxrCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        mxrCorner.Parent = mxRail

        local mxFill = Instance.new("Frame")
        local mxFrac = math.clamp((playerSettings.MaxZoomDistance - 20) / (2000 - 20), 0, 1)
        mxFill.Size = UDim2.new(mxFrac, 0, 1, 0)
        mxFill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent
        mxFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        mxFill.Parent = mxRail

        local mxfCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        mxfCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        mxfCorner.Parent = mxFill

        local mxBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        mxBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        mxBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24)
        mxBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        mxBtn.Text = ""
        mxBtn.Active = true
        mxBtn.Parent = maxRow

        local draggingMx = false
        mxBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() draggingMx = true end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then draggingMx = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if draggingMx and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local ap = mxRail.AbsolutePosition
                local as = mxRail.AbsoluteSize
                local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local pct = math.clamp((mp.X - ap.X) / as.X, 0, 1)
                mxFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
                playerSettings.MaxZoomDistance = math.floor(20 + pct * (2000 - 20))
                mxVal.Text = tostring(playerSettings.MaxZoomDistance) .. " studs"
                if playerSettings.ThirdPerson then updateThirdPersonCamera() end
            end
        end)

        -- 2. Quick Set Distance Slider
        local qRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        qRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52)
        qRow.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        qRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        qRow.Active = true
        qRow.ZIndex = 510
        qRow.Parent = container

        local qCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        qCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        qCorner.Parent = qRow

        local qStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        qStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        qStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        qStroke.Parent = qRow

        local qTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        qTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 20)
        qTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
        qTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        qTitle.Text = "Jump to Distance"
        qTitle.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        qTitle.TextSize = 12
        qTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        qTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        qTitle.Parent = qRow

        local qVal = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        qVal.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 20)
        qVal.Position = UDim2.new(1, -85, 0, 6)
        qVal.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        qVal.Text = tostring(playerSettings.CustomZoom) .. " studs"
        qVal.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText
        qVal.TextSize = 11
        qVal.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        qVal.Parent = qRow

        local qRail = Instance.new("Frame")
        qRail.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 5)
        qRail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 34)
        qRail.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SliderRail
        qRail.BorderSizePixel = 0
        qRail.Active = true
        qRail.Parent = qRow

        local qrCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        qrCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        qrCorner.Parent = qRail

        local qFill = Instance.new("Frame")
        local qFrac = math.clamp((playerSettings.CustomZoom - 5) / (150 - 5), 0, 1)
        qFill.Size = UDim2.new(qFrac, 0, 1, 0)
        qFill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent
        qFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        qFill.Parent = qRail

        local qfCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        qfCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        qfCorner.Parent = qFill

        local qBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        qBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        qBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24)
        qBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        qBtn.Text = ""
        qBtn.Active = true
        qBtn.Parent = qRow

        local draggingQ = false
        qBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() draggingQ = true end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then draggingQ = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if draggingQ and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local ap = qRail.AbsolutePosition
                local as = qRail.AbsoluteSize
                local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local pct = math.clamp((mp.X - ap.X) / as.X, 0, 1)
                qFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
                playerSettings.CustomZoom = math.floor(5 + pct * (150 - 5))
                qVal.Text = tostring(playerSettings.CustomZoom) .. " studs"
                if playerSettings.ThirdPerson then
                    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
                    if lp then
                        lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = playerSettings.CustomZoom
                        task.delay(0.12, function()
                            if playerSettings.ThirdPerson then
                                lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = playerSettings.MinZoomDistance or 0.5
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        -- 3. Preset Distances Row
        local preRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        preRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
        preRow.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        preRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        preRow.Active = true
        preRow.ZIndex = 510
        preRow.Parent = container

        local prCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        prCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        prCorner.Parent = preRow

        local prStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        prStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        prStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        prStroke.Parent = preRow

        local prTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        prTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 1, 0)
        prTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
        prTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        prTitle.Text = "Quick Presets"
        prTitle.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        prTitle.TextSize = 12
        prTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        prTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        prTitle.Parent = preRow

        local distPresets = {15, 30, 60, 120}
        for idx, dist in ipairs(distPresets) do
            local pBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            pBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 22)
            pBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -190 + (idx * 48), 0.5, -11)
            pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
            pBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            pBtn.Text = tostring(dist)
            pBtn.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText
            pBtn.TextSize = 11
            pBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            pBtn.Parent = preRow

            local pc = Instance.new("UICorner")
            pc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
            pc.Parent = pBtn

            pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playerSettings.CustomZoom = dist
                qVal.Text = tostring(dist) .. " studs"
                local frac = math.clamp((dist - 5) / (150 - 5), 0, 1)
                qFill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
                if playerSettings.ThirdPerson then
                    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
                    if lp then
                        lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = dist
                        task.delay(0.12, function()
                            if playerSettings.ThirdPerson then
                                lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = playerSettings.MinZoomDistance or 0.5
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end

-- [ ФУНКЦИЯ НАСТРОЕК КЕЙБИНДА СБРОСА / RESET (⚙️) ] --
local function openResetKeybindSettings()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Reset Keybind Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
        local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
        desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        desc.Text = "Нажмите на кнопку ниже, затем нажмите любую клавишу на клавиатуре для назначения быстрого сброса персонажа:"
        desc.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        desc.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        desc.TextSize = 12
        desc.TextWrapped = true
        desc.ZIndex = 510
        desc.Parent = container

        local keyRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        keyRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52)
        keyRow.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        keyRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        keyRow.ZIndex = 510
        keyRow.Parent = container

        local krCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        krCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        krCorner.Parent = keyRow

        local krStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        krStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        krStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        krStroke.Parent = keyRow

        local keyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        keyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36)
        keyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8)
        keyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
        keyBtn.Text = "Клавиша сброса: [" .. (SETTINGS.ResetKey and SETTINGS.ResetKey.Name or "None") .. "]"
        keyBtn.TextColor3 = theme.Accent
        keyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        keyBtn.TextSize = 13
        keyBtn.ZIndex = 512
        keyBtn.Parent = keyRow

        local kbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        kbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        kbCorner.Parent = keyBtn

        keyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            keyBtn.Text = "Нажмите любую клавишу (Esc - отмена)..."
            keyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100)
            changeResetKeybind()
            task.spawn(function()
                while isListeningForResetKey do task.wait(0.1) end
                if keyBtn and keyBtn.Parent then
                    keyBtn.Text = "Клавиша сброса: [" .. (SETTINGS.ResetKey and SETTINGS.ResetKey.Name or "None") .. "]"
                    keyBtn.TextColor3 = theme.Accent
                end
            end)
        end)

        local defBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        defBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
        defBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        defBtn.Text = "Сбросить на значение по умолчанию [R]"
        defBtn.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        defBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        defBtn.TextSize = 11
        defBtn.ZIndex = 510
        defBtn.Parent = container

        local dbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        dbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        dbCorner.Parent = defBtn

        defBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            SETTINGS.ResetKey = Enum.KeyCode.R
            keyBtn.Text = "Клавиша сброса: [R]"
            keyBtn.TextColor3 = theme.Accent
            if resetKeyBtnZenith then
                local textLbl = resetKeyBtnZenith:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
                if textLbl then textLbl.Text = "Reset Key: [R]" end
            end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
            if Window and Window.Notify then
                Window:Notify({ Title = "Кейбинд сброшен", Content = "Клавиша Reset установлена на [R]", Duration = 2 })
            end
        end)
    end)
end

-- [ ФУНКЦИЯ ДЛЯ ПОСТРОЕНИЯ НАСТРОЕК АНИМАЦИЙ (FE) ] --
function ANIM_SYSTEM.openSettings()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Animations (FE)", function(container, theme, effMode)
        local descLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        descLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        descLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        descLbl.Text = "Выберите анимацию (реплицируется всем игрокам):"
        descLbl.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        descLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        descLbl.TextSize = 11
        descLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        descLbl.ZIndex = 510
        descLbl.LayoutOrder = 1
        descLbl.Parent = container

        -- Кнопка быстрой остановки анимации
        local stopBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        stopBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
        stopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(195, 55, 65)
        stopBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        stopBtn.Text = "⏹ Остановить анимацию"
        stopBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        stopBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        stopBtn.TextSize = 11
        stopBtn.ZIndex = 511
        stopBtn.LayoutOrder = 2
        stopBtn.Parent = container

        Instance.new("UICorner", stopBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

        local gridFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        gridFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.ceil(#ANIM_SYSTEM.Presets / 2) * 44)
        gridFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        gridFrame.ZIndex = 510
        gridFrame.LayoutOrder = 3
        gridFrame.Parent = container

        local gridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
        gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 0, 36)
        gridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0, 8)
        gridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        gridLayout.Parent = gridFrame

        local buttons = {}

        stopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            SETTINGS.PlayerAnimations = false
            if UI_ELEMENTS.Animations then UI_ELEMENTS.Animations:Set(false) end
            ANIM_SYSTEM.stop()
            for otherPreset, otherBtn in pairs(buttons) do
                local curTh = computeCurrentTheme()
                otherBtn.BackgroundColor3 = curTh.InputBackground
                otherBtn.TextColor3 = curTh.Text
                local s = otherBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if s then s.Color = curTh.ElementBorder end
            end
            Library:Notify({
                Title = "Анимация остановлена",
                Content = "Восстановлена стандартная поза персонажа",
                Duration = 2
            })
        end)

        for idx, preset in ipairs(ANIM_SYSTEM.Presets) do
            local isSel = (SETTINGS.PlayerAnimations and SETTINGS.CurrentAnimation == preset.Name)
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and theme.Accent or theme.InputBackground
            btn.Text = preset.Name
            btn.TextColor3 = isSel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or theme.Text
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            btn.TextSize = 11
            btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            btn.LayoutOrder = idx
            btn.ZIndex = 511
            btn.Parent = gridFrame

            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            corner.Parent = btn

            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            stroke.Thickness = 1
            stroke.Color = isSel and theme.Accent or theme.ElementBorder
            stroke.Transparency = 0.4
            stroke.Parent = btn

            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if SETTINGS.CurrentAnimation == preset.Name and SETTINGS.PlayerAnimations then
                    SETTINGS.PlayerAnimations = false
                    if UI_ELEMENTS.Animations then UI_ELEMENTS.Animations:Set(false) end
                    ANIM_SYSTEM.stop()
                    for otherPreset, otherBtn in pairs(buttons) do
                        local curTh = computeCurrentTheme()
                        otherBtn.BackgroundColor3 = curTh.InputBackground
                        otherBtn.TextColor3 = curTh.Text
                        local s = otherBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                        if s then s.Color = curTh.ElementBorder end
                    end
                    return
                end

                SETTINGS.CurrentAnimation = preset.Name
                SETTINGS.PlayerAnimations = true
                if UI_ELEMENTS.Animations then UI_ELEMENTS.Animations:Set(true) end

                for otherPreset, otherBtn in pairs(buttons) do
                    local sel = (otherPreset.Name == preset.Name)
                    local curTh = computeCurrentTheme()
                    otherBtn.BackgroundColor3 = sel and curTh.Accent or curTh.InputBackground
                    otherBtn.TextColor3 = sel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or curTh.Text
                    local s = otherBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if s then s.Color = sel and curTh.Accent or curTh.ElementBorder end
                end

                ANIM_SYSTEM.apply(preset.Name)
            end)
            buttons[preset] = btn
        end
    end)
end

-- [ ФУНКЦИЯ ДЛЯ ПОСТРОЕНИЯ ОТЧЕТА О ДРУЗЬЯХ НА СЕРВЕРЕ ] --
openServerFriendsReport = function()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Отчет о друзьях на сервере", function(container, theme, effMode)
        local function setTargetTo(targetName)
            SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = targetName
            if UI_ELEMENTS.ZenithTargetDropdown and UI_ELEMENTS.ZenithTargetDropdown.Set then
                pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.ZenithTargetDropdown:Set(targetName) end)
            end
            if UI_ELEMENTS.CombatTargetDropdown and UI_ELEMENTS.CombatTargetDropdown.Set then
                pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.CombatTargetDropdown:Set(targetName) end)
            end
            if rebuildTargetPlayerList then
                pcall(rebuildTargetPlayerList)
            end
            Library:Notify({
                Title = "Цель выбрана",
                Content = "Выбрана цель: " .. tostring(targetName),
                Duration = 2.5
            })
        end

        local function teleportToPlayer(targetName)
            local p = Players:FindFirstChild(targetName)
            if p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if myHrp then
                    myHrp.CFrame = p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                    Library:Notify({
                        Title = "Телепорт",
                        Content = "Телепортирован к " .. p.DisplayName,
                        Duration = 2.5
                    })
                end
            end
        end

        -- Панель действий вверху
        local topActions = Instance.new("Frame")
        topActions.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
        topActions.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        topActions.ZIndex = 510
        topActions.LayoutOrder = 1
        topActions.Parent = container

        local topLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        topLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        topLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
        topLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        topLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
        topLayout.Parent = topActions

        local refreshBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        refreshBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.31, 0, 1, 0)
        refreshBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        refreshBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        refreshBtn.Text = "🔄 Обновить"
        refreshBtn.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        refreshBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        refreshBtn.TextSize = 11
        refreshBtn.ZIndex = 511
        refreshBtn.Parent = topActions
        Instance.new("UICorner", refreshBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local rfStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", refreshBtn)
        rfStroke.Thickness = 1
        rfStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        rfStroke.Transparency = 0.4

        local copyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        copyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 1, 0)
        copyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent
        copyBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        copyBtn.Text = "📋 Скопировать"
        copyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        copyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        copyBtn.TextSize = 11
        copyBtn.ZIndex = 511
        copyBtn.Parent = topActions
        Instance.new("UICorner", copyBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

        local toastBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        toastBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.27, 0, 1, 0)
        toastBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        toastBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        toastBtn.Text = "🔔 Toast"
        toastBtn.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        toastBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        toastBtn.TextSize = 11
        toastBtn.ZIndex = 511
        toastBtn.Parent = topActions
        Instance.new("UICorner", toastBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local tstStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", toastBtn)
        tstStroke.Thickness = 1
        tstStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        tstStroke.Transparency = 0.4

        -- Карточка общей статистики
        local statsCard = Instance.new("Frame")
        statsCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52)
        statsCard.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        statsCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
        statsCard.ZIndex = 510
        statsCard.LayoutOrder = 2
        statsCard.Parent = container

        Instance.new("UICorner", statsCard).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local stStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", statsCard)
        stStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        stStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        stStroke.Transparency = 0.3

        local statsTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        statsTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 18)
        statsTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
        statsTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        statsTitle.Text = "📊 СТАТИСТИКА СЕРВЕРА"
        statsTitle.TextColor3 = theme.Accent
        statsTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        statsTitle.TextSize = 11
        statsTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        statsTitle.ZIndex = 511
        statsTitle.Parent = statsCard

        local statsDesc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        statsDesc.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20)
        statsDesc.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
        statsDesc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        statsDesc.Text = "Загрузка игроков и связей..."
        statsDesc.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        statsDesc.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        statsDesc.TextSize = 11
        statsDesc.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        statsDesc.ZIndex = 511
        statsDesc.Parent = statsCard

        -- Контейнер для динамического списка
        local reportContentFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        reportContentFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
        reportContentFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        reportContentFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        reportContentFrame.ZIndex = 510
        reportContentFrame.LayoutOrder = 3
        reportContentFrame.Parent = container

        local repLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        repLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        repLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
        repLayout.Parent = reportContentFrame

        local currentFriendPairs = {}
        local currentSoloPlayers = {}

        local function scanAndRender()
            for _, child in ipairs(reportContentFrame:GetChildren()) do
                if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then
                    child:Destroy()
                end
            end

            statsDesc.Text = "Сканирование игроков..."
            local plrs = Players:GetPlayers()
            local friendPairs = {}
            local hasFriendMap = {}

            for i = 1, #plrs do
                for j = i + 1, #plrs do
                    local p1, p2 = plrs[i], plrs[j]
                    if p1 and p2 and p1.Parent and p2.Parent then
                        local areFriends = false
                        pcall(function() areFriends = p1:IsFriendsWith(p2.UserId) end)
                        if areFriends then
                            table.insert(friendPairs, {
                                p1 = p1,
                                p2 = p2,
                                p1Name = p1.DisplayName,
                                p1User = p1.Name,
                                p2Name = p2.DisplayName,
                                p2User = p2.Name
                            })
                            hasFriendMap[p1.UserId] = true
                            hasFriendMap[p2.UserId] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local soloPlayers = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(plrs) do
                if not hasFriendMap[p.UserId] and p ~= LocalPlayer then
                    table.insert(soloPlayers, p)
                end
            end

            currentFriendPairs = friendPairs
            currentSoloPlayers = soloPlayers

            statsDesc.Text = string.format("Игроков: %d  •  Связей: %d  •  Одиночек: %d", #plrs, #friendPairs, #soloPlayers)

            -- 1. Секция: Пары друзей
            local friendsHeader = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            friendsHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
            friendsHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            friendsHeader.Text = string.format("🤝 ПАРЫ ДРУЗЕЙ (%d)", #friendPairs)
            friendsHeader.TextColor3 = #friendPairs > 0 and Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 130) or theme.SubText
            friendsHeader.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            friendsHeader.TextSize = 11
            friendsHeader.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            friendsHeader.ZIndex = 511
            friendsHeader.LayoutOrder = 1
            friendsHeader.Parent = reportContentFrame

            if #friendPairs > 0 then
                for idx, pair in ipairs(friendPairs) do
                    local pairCard = Instance.new("Frame")
                    pairCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 68)
                    pairCard.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
                    pairCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    pairCard.ZIndex = 511
                    pairCard.LayoutOrder = 10 + idx
                    pairCard.Parent = reportContentFrame

                    Instance.new("UICorner", pairCard).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
                    local pcStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", pairCard)
                    pcStroke.Thickness = 0.8
                    pcStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
                    pcStroke.Transparency = 0.4

                    local pairInfo = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    pairInfo.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 22)
                    pairInfo.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
                    pairInfo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    pairInfo.Text = string.format("🤝 %s (@%s)  ↔  %s (@%s)", pair.p1Name, pair.p1User, pair.p2Name, pair.p2User)
                    pairInfo.TextColor3 = theme.Text
                    pairInfo.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    pairInfo.TextSize = 11
                    pairInfo.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    pairInfo.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                    pairInfo.ZIndex = 512
                    pairInfo.Parent = pairCard

                    -- Кнопки действий
                    local btnBar = Instance.new("Frame")
                    btnBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26)
                    btnBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 32)
                    btnBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    btnBar.ZIndex = 512
                    btnBar.Parent = pairCard

                    local btnLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
                    btnLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
                    btnLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
                    btnLayout.Parent = btnBar

                    local t1Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    t1Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.23, 0, 1, 0)
                    t1Btn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
                    t1Btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    t1Btn.Text = "🎯 " .. pair.p1Name:sub(1, 8)
                    t1Btn.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText
                    t1Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    t1Btn.TextSize = 10
                    t1Btn.ZIndex = 513
                    t1Btn.Parent = btnBar
                    Instance.new("UICorner", t1Btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
                    t1Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setTargetTo(pair.p1User) end)

                    local tp1Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    tp1Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.23, 0, 1, 0)
                    tp1Btn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
                    tp1Btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    tp1Btn.Text = "⚡ TP 1"
                    tp1Btn.TextColor3 = theme.Text
                    tp1Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    tp1Btn.TextSize = 10
                    tp1Btn.ZIndex = 513
                    tp1Btn.Parent = btnBar
                    Instance.new("UICorner", tp1Btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
                    tp1Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() teleportToPlayer(pair.p1User) end)

                    local t2Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    t2Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.23, 0, 1, 0)
                    t2Btn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
                    t2Btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    t2Btn.Text = "🎯 " .. pair.p2Name:sub(1, 8)
                    t2Btn.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText
                    t2Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    t2Btn.TextSize = 10
                    t2Btn.ZIndex = 513
                    t2Btn.Parent = btnBar
                    Instance.new("UICorner", t2Btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
                    t2Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setTargetTo(pair.p2User) end)

                    local tp2Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    tp2Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.23, 0, 1, 0)
                    tp2Btn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
                    tp2Btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    tp2Btn.Text = "⚡ TP 2"
                    tp2Btn.TextColor3 = theme.Text
                    tp2Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    tp2Btn.TextSize = 10
                    tp2Btn.ZIndex = 513
                    tp2Btn.Parent = btnBar
                    Instance.new("UICorner", tp2Btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
                    tp2Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() teleportToPlayer(pair.p2User) end)
                end
            else
                local noFriendsCard = Instance.new("Frame")
                noFriendsCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
                noFriendsCard.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
                noFriendsCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
                noFriendsCard.ZIndex = 511
                noFriendsCard.LayoutOrder = 10
                noFriendsCard.Parent = reportContentFrame
                Instance.new("UICorner", noFriendsCard).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

                local noFriendsLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                noFriendsLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
                noFriendsLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
                noFriendsLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                noFriendsLbl.Text = "• На сервере нет взаимных пар друзей.\nВсе игроки на текущем сервере играют соло."
                noFriendsLbl.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
                noFriendsLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                noFriendsLbl.TextSize = 11
                noFriendsLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                noFriendsLbl.ZIndex = 512
                noFriendsLbl.Parent = noFriendsCard
            end

            -- 2. Секция: Одиночки
            local soloHeader = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            soloHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
            soloHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            soloHeader.Text = string.format("👤 ОДИНОЧНЫЕ ИГРОКИ (%d)", #soloPlayers)
            soloHeader.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
            soloHeader.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            soloHeader.TextSize = 11
            soloHeader.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            soloHeader.ZIndex = 511
            soloHeader.LayoutOrder = 100
            soloHeader.Parent = reportContentFrame

            if #soloPlayers > 0 then
                for idx, solo in ipairs(soloPlayers) do
                    local sRow = Instance.new("Frame")
                    sRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
                    sRow.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
                    sRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    sRow.ZIndex = 511
                    sRow.LayoutOrder = 101 + idx
                    sRow.Parent = reportContentFrame

                    Instance.new("UICorner", sRow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

                    local sLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    sLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 1, 0)
                    sLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
                    sLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    sLbl.Text = string.format("%s (@%s)", solo.DisplayName, solo.Name)
                    sLbl.TextColor3 = theme.Text
                    sLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                    sLbl.TextSize = 11
                    sLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    sLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                    sLbl.ZIndex = 512
                    sLbl.Parent = sRow

                    local sTargetBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    sTargetBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 24)
                    sTargetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0.5, -12)
                    sTargetBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
                    sTargetBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    sTargetBtn.Text = "🎯 Таргет"
                    sTargetBtn.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText
                    sTargetBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    sTargetBtn.TextSize = 10
                    sTargetBtn.ZIndex = 512
                    sTargetBtn.Parent = sRow
                    Instance.new("UICorner", sTargetBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
                    sTargetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setTargetTo(solo.Name) end)

                    local sTpBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    sTpBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 24)
                    sTpBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0.5, -12)
                    sTpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.DarkerBackground
                    sTpBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    sTpBtn.Text = "⚡ TP"
                    sTpBtn.TextColor3 = theme.Text
                    sTpBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    sTpBtn.TextSize = 10
                    sTpBtn.ZIndex = 512
                    sTpBtn.Parent = sRow
                    Instance.new("UICorner", sTpBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
                    sTpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() teleportToPlayer(solo.Name) end)
                end
            end
        end

        refreshBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            scanAndRender()
            Library:Notify({
                Title = "Отчет обновлен",
                Content = "Данные о друзьях на сервере успешно обновлены",
                Duration = 2
            })
        end)

        toastBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if showBottomLeftFriendNotice then
                showBottomLeftFriendNotice()
            end
        end)

        copyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local lines = {}
            table.insert(lines, "================================================")
            table.insert(lines, "🤝 [ОТЧЕТ О ДРУЗЬЯХ НА СЕРВЕРЕ]")
            table.insert(lines, string.format("Сервер: PlaceId %s | JobId %s", tostring(game.PlaceId), tostring(game.JobId)))
            table.insert(lines, string.format("Всего игроков: %d", #Players:GetPlayers()))
            table.insert(lines, string.format("Пар друзей обнаружено: %d", #currentFriendPairs))
            table.insert(lines, string.format("Одиночных игроков: %d", #currentSoloPlayers))
            table.insert(lines, "------------------------------------------------")
            table.insert(lines, "🤝 [СВЯЗИ ДРУЗЕЙ]:")
            if #currentFriendPairs > 0 then
                for idx, pair in ipairs(currentFriendPairs) do
                    table.insert(lines, string.format("  %d. %s (@%s) <---> %s (@%s)", idx, pair.p1Name, pair.p1User, pair.p2Name, pair.p2User))
                end
            else
                table.insert(lines, "  (Нет взаимных друзей на сервере)")
            end
            table.insert(lines, "------------------------------------------------")
            table.insert(lines, "👤 [ОДИНОЧНЫЕ ИГРОКИ]:")
            if #currentSoloPlayers > 0 then
                for idx, solo in ipairs(currentSoloPlayers) do
                    table.insert(lines, string.format("  • %s (@%s)", solo.DisplayName, solo.Name))
                end
            else
                table.insert(lines, "  (Все игроки имеют друзей)")
            end
            table.insert(lines, "================================================")

            local fullText = table.concat(lines, "\n")
            local copied = false
            if setclipboard then
                pcall(function() setclipboard(fullText); copied = true end)
            elseif toclipboard then
                pcall(function() toclipboard(fullText); copied = true end)
            end

            if copied then
                Library:Notify({
                    Title = "Отчет скопирован",
                    Content = "Отчет о друзьях успешно скопирован в буфер обмена!",
                    Duration = 3
                })
            else
                Library:Notify({
                    Title = "Буфер обмена",
                    Content = "setclipboard недоступен в вашем эксплойте",
                    Duration = 3
                })
            end
        end)

        scanAndRender()
    end)
end

-- [ ФУНКЦИЯ ДЛЯ ПОСТРОЕНИЯ НАСТРОЕК TARGET ESP И ТРЕКЕРОВ (⚙️) ] --
openTargetVisualSettings = function()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Target ESP & Tracker Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
        local mkToggle = _G.XenonModalToggle or createModalToggleRow
        mkToggle(container, "Target ESP (Подсветка цели)", SETTINGS.TargetESP_Enabled, function(v)
            SETTINGS.TargetESP_Enabled = v
            if UI_ELEMENTS.TargetESP then
                pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.TargetESP:Set(v) end)
            end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end)

        mkToggle(container, "Green Chams (Зеленая подсветка)", SETTINGS.TargetESP_Chams, function(v)
            SETTINGS.TargetESP_Chams = v
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end)

        mkToggle(container, "Tracers (Трекеры к игроку)", SETTINGS.TargetESP_Tracers, function(v)
            SETTINGS.TargetESP_Tracers = v
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end)

        -- 4. Target Selection Header & Player List
        local targetHeader = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        targetHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
        targetHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        targetHeader.Text = "🎯 Выбор цели (Игроки на сервере):"
        targetHeader.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
        targetHeader.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        targetHeader.TextSize = 12
        targetHeader.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        targetHeader.Parent = container

        local playerListContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
        playerListContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
        playerListContainer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        playerListContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        playerListContainer.Parent = container

        local pListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        pListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
        pListLayout.Parent = playerListContainer

        local function refreshPlayerRows()
            for _, ch in ipairs(playerListContainer:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("Frame") or ch:IsA("TextButton") then ch:Destroy() end
            end

            local curTarget = (SETTINGS.TargetESP_Player and SETTINGS.TargetESP_Player ~= "" and SETTINGS.TargetESP_Player)
                or (SETTINGS.TargetPlayer and SETTINGS.TargetPlayer ~= "" and SETTINGS.TargetPlayer ~= "All Players" and SETTINGS.TargetPlayer)

            local otherPlayers = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(otherPlayers, p) end
            end

            if #otherPlayers == 0 then
                local emptyLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                emptyLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
                emptyLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                emptyLbl.Text = "Нет других игроков на сервере"
                emptyLbl.TextColor3 = theme.SubText
                emptyLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                emptyLbl.TextSize = 12
                emptyLbl.Parent = playerListContainer
                return
            end

            for _, p in ipairs(otherPlayers) do
                local isSel = (curTarget == p.Name)
                local pRow = Instance.new("Frame")
                pRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
                pRow.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and theme.Accent or theme.InputBackground
                pRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
                pRow.Parent = playerListContainer

                local prCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                prCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
                prCorner.Parent = pRow

                local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -75, 1, 0)
                nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
                nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                nameLbl.Text = (p.DisplayName or p.Name) .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")"
                nameLbl.TextColor3 = isSel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or theme.Text
                nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                nameLbl.TextSize = 12
                nameLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                nameLbl.Parent = pRow

                local selBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                selBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 24)
                selBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0.5, -12)
                selBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and theme.DarkerBackground or theme.Accent
                selBtn.Text = isSel and "ВЫБРАН" or "ВЫБРАТЬ"
                selBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                selBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                selBtn.TextSize = 10
                selBtn.Parent = pRow

                local sbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                sbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
                sbCorner.Parent = selBtn

                local function selectThis()
                    if SETTINGS.TargetESP_Player == p.Name then
                        SETTINGS.TargetESP_Player = ""
                        SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = ""
                        SETTINGS.SelectedTargets = {}
                    else
                        SETTINGS.TargetESP_Player = p.Name
                        SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = p.Name
                        SETTINGS.SelectedTargets = { [p.Name] = true }
                    end
                    if UI_ELEMENTS.ZenithTargetDropdown and UI_ELEMENTS.ZenithTargetDropdown.Set then
                        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.ZenithTargetDropdown:Set(SETTINGS.TargetPlayer) end)
                    end
                    if rebuildTargetPlayerList then pcall(rebuildTargetPlayerList) end
                    refreshPlayerRows()
                end

                selBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(selectThis)
                local clickArea = Instance.new("TextButton")
                clickArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -75, 1, 0)
                clickArea.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                clickArea.Text = ""
                clickArea.Parent = pRow
                clickArea.MouseButton1Click:Connect(selectThis)
            end
        end

        refreshPlayerRows()
    end)
end

-- [ ФУНКЦИЯ ДЛЯ ПОСТРОЕНИЯ НАСТРОЕК ХЭЛЛОУИНА (⚙️) ] --
openHalloweenSettings = function()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Halloween Settings & Shaders", function(container, theme, effMode)
        local mkToggle = _G.XenonModalToggle or createModalToggleRow
        mkToggle(container, "🎃 Halloween Mode (Хэллоуин)", SETTINGS.HalloweenMode, function(v)
            SETTINGS.HalloweenMode = v
            if UI_ELEMENTS.HalloweenMode then
                pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.HalloweenMode:Set(v) end)
            end
            if HalloweenEngine then HalloweenEngine.toggle(v) end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end)

        mkToggle(container, "Halloween Atmosphere & Fog", SETTINGS.HalloweenShaders, function(v)
            SETTINGS.HalloweenShaders = v
            if HalloweenEngine then HalloweenEngine.applyAtmosphere(v) end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end)

        mkToggle(container, "Bloody Red Moon (Красная луна)", SETTINGS.HalloweenMoon, function(v)
            SETTINGS.HalloweenMoon = v
            if HalloweenEngine then HalloweenEngine.applyMoon(v) end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end)

        mkToggle(container, "Falling Orange Leaves (Листопад)", SETTINGS.HalloweenLeaves, function(v)
            SETTINGS.HalloweenLeaves = v
            if HalloweenEngine then HalloweenEngine.applyLeaves(v) end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end)

        mkToggle(container, "Spooky Orange Trees (Оранжевые кроны)", SETTINGS.HalloweenTrees, function(v)
            SETTINGS.HalloweenTrees = v
            if HalloweenEngine then HalloweenEngine.applyTrees(v) end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end)

        mkToggle(container, "Ground Pumpkins (Тыквы на карте)", SETTINGS.HalloweenGroundPumpkins, function(v)
            SETTINGS.HalloweenGroundPumpkins = v
            if HalloweenEngine and HalloweenEngine.active then
                if v then HalloweenEngine.generateGroundPumpkins() else HalloweenEngine.clearGroundPumpkins() end
            end
            if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
        end)

        -- 7. Кнопка перезагрузки окружения
        local regenBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        regenBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
        regenBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent
        regenBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        regenBtn.Text = "🔄 Перегенерировать все (Деревья + Тыквы + Луна)"
        regenBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        regenBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        regenBtn.TextSize = 12
        regenBtn.Parent = container

        local rgbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        rgbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        rgbCorner.Parent = regenBtn

        regenBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if HalloweenEngine and HalloweenEngine.active then
                if SETTINGS.HalloweenTrees then HalloweenEngine.generateTrees() end
                if SETTINGS.HalloweenMoon then HalloweenEngine.createPumpkinMoon() end
                if SETTINGS.HalloweenGroundPumpkins then HalloweenEngine.generateGroundPumpkins() end
                Library:Notify({
                    Title = "Хэллоуин",
                    Content = "Окружение карты успешно обновлено!",
                    Duration = 2.5
                })
            else
                Library:Notify({
                    Title = "Хэллоуин",
                    Content = "Сначала включите Halloween Mode!",
                    Duration = 2.5
                })
            end
        end)
    end)
end

-- [ ФУНКЦИЯ ДЛЯ ПОСТРОЕНИЯ НАСТРОЕК ТРЕЙЛА ] --
local function openTrailSettings()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Trail Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
        local mkToggle = _G.XenonModalToggle or createModalToggleRow
        local setRainbowState = function(state)
            trailSettings.Rainbow = state
            if not trailSettings.Rainbow and activeTrail and activeTrail.Parent then
                activeTrail.Color = ColorSequence.new(trailSettings.Color)
            end
            updateTrailVisuals()
        end

        mkToggle(container, "🌈 Rainbow Mode (Радужный перелив)", trailSettings.Rainbow, function(v)
            setRainbowState(v)
        end)

        -- 2. Trail Lifetime / Length Slider
        local lifeRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        lifeRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52)
        lifeRow.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        lifeRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        lifeRow.ZIndex = 510
        lifeRow.Parent = container

        local lfCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        lfCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        lfCorner.Parent = lifeRow

        local lfStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        lfStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        lfStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        lfStroke.Parent = lifeRow

        local lfTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lfTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 20)
        lfTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
        lfTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lfTitle.Text = "Trail Lifetime (Length)"
        lfTitle.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        lfTitle.TextSize = 12
        lfTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lfTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        lfTitle.Parent = lifeRow

        local lfVal = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lfVal.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 20)
        lfVal.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 6)
        lfVal.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lfVal.Text = string.format("%.1fs", trailSettings.Lifetime)
        lfVal.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText
        lfVal.TextSize = 11
        lfVal.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lfVal.Parent = lifeRow

        local lfRail = Instance.new("Frame")
        lfRail.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 5)
        lfRail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 34)
        lfRail.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SliderRail
        lfRail.BorderSizePixel = 0
        lfRail.Parent = lifeRow

        local lfrCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        lfrCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        lfrCorner.Parent = lfRail

        local lfFill = Instance.new("Frame")
        local lfFrac = math.clamp((trailSettings.Lifetime - 0.1) / (3.0 - 0.1), 0, 1)
        lfFill.Size = UDim2.new(lfFrac, 0, 1, 0)
        lfFill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent
        lfFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        lfFill.Parent = lfRail

        local lffCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        lffCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        lffCorner.Parent = lfFill

        local lfBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        lfBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        lfBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24)
        lfBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lfBtn.Text = ""
        lfBtn.Parent = lifeRow

        local draggingLf = false
        lfBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() draggingLf = true end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then draggingLf = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if draggingLf and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local ap = lfRail.AbsolutePosition
                local as = lfRail.AbsoluteSize
                local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local pct = math.clamp((mp.X - ap.X) / as.X, 0, 1)
                lfFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
                trailSettings.Lifetime = math.floor((0.1 + pct * 2.9) * 10) / 10
                lfVal.Text = string.format("%.1fs", trailSettings.Lifetime)
                updateTrailVisuals()
            end
        end)

        -- 3. Trail Width Slider
        local widthRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        widthRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52)
        widthRow.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        widthRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        widthRow.ZIndex = 510
        widthRow.Parent = container

        local wCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        wCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        wCorner.Parent = widthRow

        local wStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        wStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        wStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        wStroke.Parent = widthRow

        local wTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        wTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 20)
        wTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
        wTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        wTitle.Text = "Trail Width"
        wTitle.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        wTitle.TextSize = 12
        wTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        wTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        wTitle.Parent = widthRow

        local wVal = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        wVal.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 20)
        wVal.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 6)
        wVal.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        wVal.Text = string.format("%.1f", trailSettings.Width)
        wVal.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText
        wVal.TextSize = 11
        wVal.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        wVal.Parent = widthRow

        local wRail = Instance.new("Frame")
        wRail.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 5)
        wRail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 34)
        wRail.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SliderRail
        wRail.BorderSizePixel = 0
        wRail.Parent = widthRow

        local wrCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        wrCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        wrCorner.Parent = wRail

        local wFill = Instance.new("Frame")
        local wFrac = math.clamp((trailSettings.Width - 0.2) / (4.0 - 0.2), 0, 1)
        wFill.Size = UDim2.new(wFrac, 0, 1, 0)
        wFill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent
        wFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        wFill.Parent = wRail

        local wfCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        wfCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        wfCorner.Parent = wFill

        local wBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        wBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        wBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24)
        wBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        wBtn.Text = ""
        wBtn.Parent = widthRow

        local draggingW = false
        wBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() draggingW = true end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then draggingW = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if draggingW and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local ap = wRail.AbsolutePosition
                local as = wRail.AbsoluteSize
                local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local pct = math.clamp((mp.X - ap.X) / as.X, 0, 1)
                wFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
                trailSettings.Width = math.floor((0.2 + pct * 3.8) * 10) / 10
                wVal.Text = string.format("%.1f", trailSettings.Width)
                updateTrailVisuals()
            end
        end)

        local mkColor = _G.XenonColorPicker or createColorPickerCard
        mkColor(container, "Цвет трейла (Custom Color)", trailSettings.Color, function(newC)
            trailSettings.Color = newC
            setRainbowState(false)
            if activeTrail and activeTrail.Parent then
                activeTrail.Color = ColorSequence.new(newC)
            end
            updateTrailVisuals()
        end)
    end)
end

-- [ 6. НАСТРОЙКИ ВИЗУАЛЬНОГО АКСЕССУАРА / МЕЧА (⚙️) ] --
openAccessorySettings = function()
    openFeatureSettingsModal("Accessory Settings", function(container, theme, effMode)
        local isWings = (accessorySettings.Type == "Wings")
        if isWings then
            accessorySettings.Slot = "Back"
        end

        -- 1. Слот: На спине / В руке
        local slotCard = Instance.new("Frame")
        slotCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 72)
        slotCard.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        slotCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
        slotCard.ZIndex = 510
        slotCard.Parent = container

        local scCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        scCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        scCorner.Parent = slotCard

        local scStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        scStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        scStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        scStroke.Parent = slotCard

        local slotTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        slotTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24)
        slotTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4)
        slotTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        slotTitle.Text = "Equip Position (Позиция)"
        slotTitle.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        slotTitle.TextSize = 12
        slotTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        slotTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        slotTitle.Parent = slotCard

        local backBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        backBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 32)
        backBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 32)
        backBtn.BackgroundColor3 = (accessorySettings.Slot == "Back") and theme.Accent or theme.DarkerBackground
        backBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        backBtn.Text = "🎒 On Back (На спине)"
        backBtn.TextColor3 = (accessorySettings.Slot == "Back") and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or theme.SubText
        backBtn.TextSize = 11
        backBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        backBtn.Parent = slotCard
        Instance.new("UICorner", backBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

        local handBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        handBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 32)
        handBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0, 32)
        handBtn.BackgroundColor3 = (accessorySettings.Slot == "Hand" and not isWings) and theme.Accent or theme.DarkerBackground
        handBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        handBtn.Text = isWings and "⛔ Back Only" or "✋ In Hand (В руке)"
        handBtn.TextColor3 = (accessorySettings.Slot == "Hand" and not isWings) and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or theme.SubText
        handBtn.TextSize = 11
        handBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        handBtn.Parent = slotCard
        Instance.new("UICorner", handBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

        local function updateSlotBtns()
            local curWings = (accessorySettings.Type == "Wings")
            if curWings then
                accessorySettings.Slot = "Back"
            end
            backBtn.BackgroundColor3 = (accessorySettings.Slot == "Back") and theme.Accent or theme.DarkerBackground
            backBtn.TextColor3 = (accessorySettings.Slot == "Back") and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or theme.SubText
            handBtn.BackgroundColor3 = (accessorySettings.Slot == "Hand" and not curWings) and theme.Accent or theme.DarkerBackground
            handBtn.Text = curWings and "⛔ Back Only" or "✋ In Hand (В руке)"
            handBtn.TextColor3 = (accessorySettings.Slot == "Hand" and not curWings) and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or theme.SubText
            if accessorySettings.Enabled then
                applyAccessory()
            end
        end

        backBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            accessorySettings.Slot = "Back"
            updateSlotBtns()
        end)
        handBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if accessorySettings.Type ~= "Wings" then
                accessorySettings.Slot = "Hand"
                updateSlotBtns()
            end
        end)

        -- 2. Выбор модели аксессуара
        local modelCard = Instance.new("Frame")
        modelCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 118)
        modelCard.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        modelCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
        modelCard.ZIndex = 510
        modelCard.Parent = container

        local mcCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        mcCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        mcCorner.Parent = modelCard

        local mcStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        mcStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        mcStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder
        mcStroke.Parent = modelCard

        local mcTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        mcTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24)
        mcTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4)
        mcTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        mcTitle.Text = "Accessory Model (Визуальный аксессуар)"
        mcTitle.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        mcTitle.TextSize = 12
        mcTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        mcTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        mcTitle.Parent = modelCard

        local function getMinScaleForType(wType)
            if wType == "Wings" then
                return 2.0
            elseif wType == "Greatsword" or wType == "Demon Scythe" then
                return 1.5
            else
                return 1.2 -- Katana & Dual Katanas
            end
        end

        local maxScale = 6.0
        local curMinScale = getMinScaleForType(accessorySettings.Type)
        if accessorySettings.Scale < curMinScale then
            accessorySettings.Scale = curMinScale
        end

        local weaponTypes = {
            {"Katana", "🗡️ Katana"},
            {"Dual Katanas", "⚔️ Dual Katanas"},
            {"Greatsword", "🗡️ Greatsword"},
            {"Demon Scythe", "⛏️ Demon Scythe"},
            {"Wings", "🪽 Wings"}
        }

        local rgbCard = nil
        local typeBtns = {}
        local scVal = nil
        local scFill = nil

        for idx, item in ipairs(weaponTypes) do
            local key, label = item[1], item[2]
            local isSecondRow = (idx > 3)
            local colIdx = isSecondRow and (idx - 4) or (idx - 1)
            local posX = isSecondRow and (10 + colIdx * 175) or (10 + colIdx * 115)
            local posY = isSecondRow and 72 or 32
            local btnW = isSecondRow and 165 or 105

            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, btnW, 0, 30)
            btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, posX, 0, posY)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = (accessorySettings.Type == key) and theme.Accent or theme.DarkerBackground
            btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            btn.Text = label
            btn.TextColor3 = (accessorySettings.Type == key) and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or theme.SubText
            btn.TextSize = 10
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            btn.Parent = modelCard
            Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

            typeBtns[key] = btn
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                accessorySettings.Type = key
                if key == "Wings" then
                    accessorySettings.Slot = "Back"
                    accessorySettings.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 115, 185)
                end
                local newMin = getMinScaleForType(key)
                if accessorySettings.Scale < newMin then
                    accessorySettings.Scale = newMin
                end
                if scVal then
                    scVal.Text = string.format("%.1fx", accessorySettings.Scale)
                end
                if scFill then
                    local frac = math.clamp((accessorySettings.Scale - newMin) / (maxScale - newMin), 0, 1)
                    scFill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 1, 0)
                end
                for k, b in pairs(typeBtns) do
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = (accessorySettings.Type == k) and theme.Accent or theme.DarkerBackground
                    b.TextColor3 = (accessorySettings.Type == k) and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or theme.SubText
                end
                updateSlotBtns()
                if rgbCard then
                    rgbCard.Visible = (accessorySettings.Type == "Wings")
                end
                if accessorySettings.Enabled then
                    applyAccessory()
                end
            end)
        end

        -- 3. Scale Slider Row (динамический минимум в зависимости от оружия)
        local scaleRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        scaleRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52)
        scaleRow.BackgroundColor3 = theme.InputBackground
        scaleRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        scaleRow.ZIndex = 510
        scaleRow.Parent = container
        Instance.new("UICorner", scaleRow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local srStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", scaleRow)
        srStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        srStroke.Color = theme.ElementBorder

        local scLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        scLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, -10, 0, 22)
        scLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
        scLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        scLbl.Text = "Accessory Size (Размер)"
        scLbl.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        scLbl.TextSize = 12
        scLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        scLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        scLbl.Parent = scaleRow

        scVal = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        scVal.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 22)
        scVal.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 6)
        scVal.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        scVal.Text = string.format("%.1fx", accessorySettings.Scale)
        scVal.TextColor3 = theme.AccentText
        scVal.TextSize = 11
        scVal.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        scVal.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        scVal.Parent = scaleRow

        local scRail = Instance.new("Frame")
        scRail.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 5)
        scRail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 34)
        scRail.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SliderRail
        scRail.BorderSizePixel = 0
        scRail.Parent = scaleRow
        Instance.new("UICorner", scRail).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        scFill = Instance.new("Frame")
        local scFrac = math.clamp((accessorySettings.Scale - curMinScale) / (maxScale - curMinScale), 0, 1)
        scFill.Size = UDim2.new(scFrac, 0, 1, 0)
        scFill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent
        scFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        scFill.Parent = scRail
        Instance.new("UICorner", scFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local scBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        scBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        scBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24)
        scBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        scBtn.Text = ""
        scBtn.Parent = scaleRow

        local draggingSc = false
        scBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() draggingSc = true end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then draggingSc = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if draggingSc and inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local ap = scRail.AbsolutePosition
                local as = scRail.AbsoluteSize
                local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local pct = math.clamp((mp.X - ap.X) / as.X, 0, 1)
                scFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
                local mScale = getMinScaleForType(accessorySettings.Type)
                accessorySettings.Scale = math.floor((mScale + pct * (maxScale - mScale)) * 10) / 10
                scVal.Text = string.format("%.1fx", accessorySettings.Scale)
                if accessorySettings.Enabled then
                    applyAccessory()
                end
            end
        end)

        -- 3.1 Toggle Particles Card

-- [ 7. ИСПРАВЛЕННЫЙ РЕКОННЕКТ (С ЗАЩИТОЙ ОТ ОШИБКИ 773) ] --
local function reconnectToServer()
    local ts = game:GetService("TeleportService")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    local currentPlaceId = game.PlaceId
    local currentJobId = game.JobId

    Window:Notify({ 
        Title = "Reconnecting", 
        Content = "Rejoining server...", 
        Duration = 3.5 
    })

    -- Перехват ошибки 773 и автоматический безопасный реконект
    local failedConn
    failedConn = ts.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, result, err)
        if player == lp then
            if failedConn then
                failedConn:Disconnect()
                failedConn = nil
            end
            pcall(function()
                ts:Teleport(currentPlaceId, lp)
            end)
        end
    end)

    if currentJobId and currentJobId ~= "" then
        local ok = pcall(function()
            ts:TeleportToPlaceInstance(currentPlaceId, currentJobId, lp)
        end)
        if not ok then
            if failedConn then
                failedConn:Disconnect()
                failedConn = nil
            end
            pcall(function() ts:Teleport(currentPlaceId, lp) end)
        end
    else
        if failedConn then
            failedConn:Disconnect()
            failedConn = nil
        end
        pcall(function() ts:Teleport(currentPlaceId, lp) end)
    end
end

-- Flight Engine (Плавный полёт)
local flightActive = false
local flightSpeed = 45
local flightBodyVelocity = nil
local flightBodyGyro = nil
local flightConn = nil

local function toggleFlight(enable)
    flightActive = enable
    SETTINGS.Flight = enable
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not enable then
        if flightBodyVelocity then pcall(function() flightBodyVelocity:Destroy() end); flightBodyVelocity = nil end
        if flightBodyGyro then pcall(function() flightBodyGyro:Destroy() end); flightBodyGyro = nil end
        if flightConn then flightConn:Disconnect(); flightConn = nil end
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
        return
    end

    if not hrp or not hum then return end
    hum.PlatformStand = true

    flightBodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    flightBodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    flightBodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    flightBodyVelocity.Parent = hrp

    flightBodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    flightBodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    flightBodyGyro.P = 10000
    flightBodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
    flightBodyGyro.Parent = hrp

    if flightConn then flightConn:Disconnect() end
    flightConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flightActive or not hrp or not hrp.Parent then
            if flightConn then flightConn:Disconnect(); flightConn = nil end
            return
        end
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local moveDir = Vector3.zero
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir = moveDir + cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir = moveDir - cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir = moveDir - cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir = moveDir + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            flightBodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDir.Unit * flightSpeed
        else
            flightBodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        flightBodyGyro.CFrame = cam.CFrame
    end)
end

UI_ELEMENTS.Flight = makeCardToggle(movGrid, {
    Name = "Flight",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        toggleFlight(v)
        if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then SETTINGS.SyncClickGui() end
    end
})

            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
                pcall(openResetKeybindSettings)
            end
        end)
        for _, child in ipairs(btnInstance:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
                child.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
                    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
                        pcall(openResetKeybindSettings)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end
