-- [ 6. SERVER (ЛАГИ, КРАШ СЕРВЕРА, ПАКЕТЫ И СНЯТИЕ БАРЬЕРОВ) ]
do
    local serverFrame = Window.TabFrames["Server"]
    if serverFrame then
        local function getAllPlayers()
            local players = {}
            for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                    table.insert(players, plr)
                end
            end
            return players
        end

        local function spamOwnership(hrp)
            local ge = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents")
            if not ge then return end
            local setOwner = ge:FindFirstChild("SetNetworkOwner")
            if setOwner and hrp then pcall(function() setOwner:FireServer(hrp, hrp.CFrame) end) end
        end

        local function teleportToPlayer(myHrp, targetHrp)
            if not myHrp or not targetHrp then return end
            pcall(function()
                myHrp.CFrame = targetHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 5, 5)
                myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
        end

        local function destroyLineOnPlayer(hrp)
            local ge = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents")
            if not ge then return end
            local createLine = ge:FindFirstChild("CreateGrabLine")
            local destroyLine = ge:FindFirstChild("DestroyGrabLine")
            if not createLine or not destroyLine then return end
            pcall(function()
                createLine:FireServer(hrp, CFrame.new(0, 1e9, 0))
                task.wait()
                destroyLine:FireServer(hrp)
            end)
        end

        local selectedHeight = "Spawn"

        local function destroyServerAction()
            task.spawn(function()
                local height = (selectedHeight == "Heaven") and 1e9 or 35
                task.wait(0.2)

                local players = getAllPlayers()
                if #players == 0 then
                    return
                end

                local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not myHrp then return end

                local playerData = {}
                for _, plr in ipairs(players) do
                    local char = plr.Character
                    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp then table.insert(playerData, {player = plr, hrp = hrp}) end
                end

                for _, data in ipairs(playerData) do
                    teleportToPlayer(myHrp, data.hrp)
                    task.wait(0.2)
                    spamOwnership(data.hrp)
                    task.wait()
                end

                local radius = 40
                local angleStep = (math.pi * 2) / #playerData
                for idx, data in ipairs(playerData) do
                    local angle = (idx - 1) * angleStep
                    local x = math.cos(angle) * radius
                    local z = math.sin(angle) * radius

                    pcall(function()
                        data.hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, height, z)
                        data.hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end)

                    local bp = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
                    bp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
                    bp.P = 40000000
                    bp.Position = Vector3.new(x, height, z)
                    bp.Parent = data.hrp
                    task.delay(2, function() pcall(function() bp:Destroy() end) end)
                    task.wait()
                end

                for i = 1, 8 do
                    for _, data in ipairs(playerData) do destroyLineOnPlayer(data.hrp) end
                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
            end)
        end

        local monsterLagEnabled = false
        local packetLagActive = false
        local packetLagTask = nil
        local packetLagSize = 1

        local function getPacketSize()
            return packetLagSize * 1000000
        end

        local function sendSinglePacketLag()
            local ge = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents")
            local extendGrabLine = ge and ge:FindFirstChild("ExtendGrabLine")
            if not extendGrabLine then return end
            local size = getPacketSize()
            pcall(function()
                extendGrabLine:FireServer(string.rep("A", size))
            end)
            if Window and Window.Notify then
                Window:Notify({
                    Title = "Packet Lag",
                    Content = "Packet sent! Size: " .. packetLagSize .. " MB",
                    Duration = 3
                })
            end
        end

        -- Барьеры домов
        local brkHs = false
        local fbexpConn = nil

        local function fbexp()
            if fbexpConn then fbexpConn:Disconnect(); fbexpConn = nil end
            fbexpConn = Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if brkHs then
                    if fbexpConn then fbexpConn:Disconnect(); fbexpConn = nil end
                    return
                end
                if child.Name == "Part" and (child.Position - Vector3.new(263.4, -4.79, 466.8)).Magnitude <= 2 then
                    brkHs = true
                    if Window and Window.Notify then
                        Window:Notify({ Title = "Done!", Content = "Destroyed Houses Barrier", Duration = 3 })
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        for _, plot in pairs(Workspace.Plots:GetChildren()) do
                            local barrier = plot:FindFirstChild("Barrier")
                            if barrier then
                                for _, part in pairs(barrier:GetChildren()) do
                                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide == true then
                                        part.CanCollide = false
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    if fbexpConn then fbexpConn:Disconnect(); fbexpConn = nil end
                end
            end)
        end

        local function breakhouseAction()
            brkHs = false
            fbexp()
            local startTime = tick()
            repeat
                pcall(function()
                    ReplicatedStorage.MenuToys.SpawnToyRemoteFunction:InvokeServer(
                        "BallSnowball",
                        CFrame.new(263.5, -4.5, 486.9),
                        Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    )
                end)
                local wStart = tick()
                repeat task.wait() until not LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("CanSpawnToy") or LocalPlayer.CanSpawnToy.Value or tick() - wStart > 2
            until brkHs or tick() - startTime >= 10
            if fbexpConn then fbexpConn:Disconnect(); fbexpConn = nil end
        end

        -- [ ЭЛЕМЕНТЫ ВКЛАДКИ SERVER ]
        TABS.Server:MakeSection({ Name = "Lag Modules", LayoutOrder = 1 })
        local serverGrid = makeCardGrid(serverFrame, 2)

        local function getSafeLagTarget()
            local sp = Workspace:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation") or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawn") or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Terrain")
            if not sp then
                sp = Workspace:FindFirstChild("ZenithLagPart")
                if not sp then
                    local p = Instance.new("Part")
                    p.Name = "ZenithLagPart"
                    p.Anchored = true
                    p.CanCollide = false
                    p.Transparency = 1
                    p.Position = Vector3.new(0, 100, 0)
                    p.Parent = Workspace
                    sp = p
                end
            end
            return sp
        end

        UI_ELEMENTS.XocuLag = makeCardToggle(serverGrid, {
            Name = "XOCU Lag",
            Default = false,
            Callback = function(v)
                monsterLagEnabled = v
                if v then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local ge = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents")
                        local createLine = ge and ge:FindFirstChild("CreateGrabLine")
                        while monsterLagEnabled and createLine do
                            local lagTarget = getSafeLagTarget()
                            if lagTarget then
                                local randomX = math.random(-9e9, 9e9)
                                local randomZ = math.random(-9e9, 9e9)
                                createLine:FireServer(lagTarget, CFrame.new(randomX, 0, randomZ))
                            end
                            task.wait()
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        })

        UI_ELEMENTS.PacketLagLoop = makeCardToggle(serverGrid, {
            Name = "Packet Lag (Loop)",
            Default = false,
            Callback = function(v)
                packetLagActive = v
                if v then
                    packetLagTask = task.spawn(function()
                        local ge = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GrabEvents")
                        local extendGrabLine = ge and ge:FindFirstChild("ExtendGrabLine")
                        if not extendGrabLine then
                            packetLagActive = false
                            return
                        end
                        local size = getPacketSize()
                        while packetLagActive do
                            task.wait(0.5)
                            pcall(function()
                                extendGrabLine:FireServer(string.rep("A", size))
                            end)
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    if packetLagTask then
                        task.cancel(packetLagTask)
                        packetLagTask = nil
                    end
                end
            end
        })

        TABS.Server:MakeSection({ Name = "Lag Configuration", LayoutOrder = 3 })

        UI_ELEMENTS.PacketSizeMB = TABS.Server:MakeSlider({
            Name = "Packet Size (MB)",
            Icon = "file-text",
            Min = 1,
            Max = 20,
            Default = 1,
            Callback = function(v)
                packetLagSize = v
            end
        })

        TABS.Server:MakeButton({
            Name = "Send Packet Lag (Once)",
            Icon = "send",
            Callback = sendSinglePacketLag
        })

        TABS.Server:MakeSection({ Name = "Server Control & Crash", LayoutOrder = 4 })

        TABS.Server:MakeDropdown({
            Name = "Destroy Height",
            Icon = "arrow-up",
            Options = {"Spawn", "Heaven"},
            Default = "Spawn",
            Callback = function(v)
                selectedHeight = v
            end
        })

        TABS.Server:MakeButton({
            Name = "Destroy Server",
            Icon = "alert-triangle",
            Callback = destroyServerAction
        })

        TABS.Server:MakeButton({
            Name = "Stop Lag",
            Icon = "octagon",
            Callback = function()
                packetLagActive = false
                if packetLagTask then
                    task.cancel(packetLagTask)
                    packetLagTask = nil
                end
            end
        })

        TABS.Server:MakeSection({ Name = "Barriers", LayoutOrder = 5 })

        TABS.Server:MakeButton({
            Name = "Destroy Houses Barrier",
            Icon = "shield-off",
            Callback = breakhouseAction
        })
    end
end

local isListeningForMenuKey = false
local menuKeyConn = nil
local keybindBtnFrame = nil

keybindBtnFrame = TABS.UISettings:MakeButton({
    Name = "Toggle Menu Key: [" .. currentToggleKey.Name .. "]",
    Icon = "keyboard",
    Callback = function()
        if isListeningForMenuKey then return end
        isListeningForMenuKey = true

        local textLbl = keybindBtnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
        if textLbl then
            textLbl.Text = "Toggle Menu Key: [ Press any key on keyboard... ]"
        end
        Window:Notify({ Title = "Change Keybind", Content = "Press any keyboard key (or Esc to cancel)...", Duration = 3 })

        if menuKeyConn then menuKeyConn:Disconnect(); menuKeyConn = nil end
        menuKeyConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
            if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
            if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end

            isListeningForMenuKey = false
            if menuKeyConn then menuKeyConn:Disconnect(); menuKeyConn = nil end

            if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                if textLbl then
                    textLbl.Text = "Toggle Menu Key: [" .. currentToggleKey.Name .. "]"
                end
                Window:Notify({ Title = "Keybind", Content = "Cancelled", Duration = 1.5 })
                return
            end

            currentToggleKey = inp.KeyCode
            pcall(function()
                Window._toggleKey = nil
                ZenithLib._toggleKey = nil
            end)

            if textLbl then
                textLbl.Text = "Toggle Menu Key: [" .. currentToggleKey.Name .. "]"
            end
            Window:Notify({ Title = "Keybind Changed", Content = "Menu toggle key set to: " .. inp.KeyCode.Name, Duration = 2.5 })
        end)
    end
})

-- ====================== ФУНКЦИИ КАСТОМНОГО КОНФИГА ======================
local function colorToTable(color) return {color.R, color.G, color.B} end
local function tableToColor(tbl)
    if not tbl then return Color3.new(1,1,1) end
    return Color3.new(tbl[1], tbl[2], tbl[3])
end

    return {
        MasterESP = Sense.teamSettings.enemy.enabled,
        Boxes = Sense.teamSettings.enemy.box,
        Chams = Sense.teamSettings.enemy.chams,

        AntiKickEspColor = colorToTable(SETTINGS.AntiKickEspColor),
        AntiKickEspOutlineColor = colorToTable(SETTINGS.AntiKickEspOutlineColor),
        PcldESP = SETTINGS.PcldESP,
        PcldEspColor = colorToTable(SETTINGS.PcldEspColor),
        PcldEspOutlineColor = colorToTable(SETTINGS.PcldEspOutlineColor),
        PcldEspContour = SETTINGS.PcldEspContour,
        RainbowCrosshair = SETTINGS.Crosshair_Enabled,
        Aura = auraSettings.Enabled,

        TrailRainbow = trailSettings.Rainbow,

local function applyConfig(config)
    if not config then return end
    
    if config.MasterESP ~= nil then pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.MasterESP:Set(config.MasterESP) end) end
    if config.Boxes ~= nil then pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.Boxes:Set(config.Boxes) end) end
    if config.Chams ~= nil then pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.Chams:Set(config.Chams) end) end
    if config.AntiKickESP ~= nil then
        pcall(function()
            if UI_ELEMENTS.AntiKickESP then UI_ELEMENTS.AntiKickESP:Set(config.AntiKickESP) end
        end)
    end
    if config.AntiKickEspColor ~= nil then
        SETTINGS.AntiKickEspColor = tableToColor(config.AntiKickEspColor)
        pcall(function() if SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEngine then SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEngine.refresh() end end)
    end
    if config.AntiKickEspOutlineColor ~= nil then
        SETTINGS.AntiKickEspOutlineColor = tableToColor(config.AntiKickEspOutlineColor)
        pcall(function() if SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEngine then SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEngine.refresh() end end)
    end
    if config.PcldESP ~= nil then
        pcall(function()
            if UI_ELEMENTS.PcldESP then UI_ELEMENTS.PcldESP:Set(config.PcldESP) end
        end)
    end
    if config.PcldEspColor ~= nil then
        SETTINGS.PcldEspColor = tableToColor(config.PcldEspColor)
        pcall(function() if SETTINGS.PcldEspEngine then SETTINGS.PcldEspEngine.refresh() end end)
    end
    if config.PcldEspOutlineColor ~= nil then
        SETTINGS.PcldEspOutlineColor = tableToColor(config.PcldEspOutlineColor)
        pcall(function() if SETTINGS.PcldEspEngine then SETTINGS.PcldEspEngine.refresh() end end)
    end
    if config.RainbowCrosshair ~= nil then pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.RainbowCrosshair:Set(config.RainbowCrosshair) end) end
    if config.PlayerTrail ~= nil then
        pcall(function()
            if UI_ELEMENTS.PlayerTrail then UI_ELEMENTS.PlayerTrail:Set(config.PlayerTrail) end
        end)
    end
    if config.TrailRainbow ~= nil then
        trailSettings.Rainbow = config.TrailRainbow
    end
    if config.TrailColor ~= nil then

    end
    if config.TrailLifetime ~= nil then

    end
    if config.TrailWidth ~= nil then

    end
    updateTrailVisuals()

    if config.Aura ~= nil then
        auraSettings.Enabled = config.Aura
        pcall(function()
            if UI_ELEMENTS.Aura then UI_ELEMENTS.Aura:Set(config.Aura) end
        end)
        if config.Aura then applyAura() else removeAura() end
    end
    if config.ServerFriends ~= nil then

        pcall(function()
            if UI_ELEMENTS.ServerFriends then UI_ELEMENTS.ServerFriends:Set(config.ServerFriends) end
        end)
        toggleServerFriendsTracker(config.ServerFriends)
    end

    if config.VisualAccessory ~= nil then
        accessorySettings.Enabled = config.VisualAccessory
        pcall(function()
            if UI_ELEMENTS.Accessory then UI_ELEMENTS.Accessory:Set(config.VisualAccessory) end
        end)
    end
    if config.AccessorySlot ~= nil then accessorySettings.Slot = config.AccessorySlot end
    if config.AccessoryParticles ~= nil then accessorySettings.Particles = config.AccessoryParticles end
    if config.AccessoryType ~= nil then
        if config.AccessoryType == "Cyber Katana" then
            accessorySettings.Type = "Katana"
        else
            accessorySettings.Type = config.AccessoryType
        end
    end
    if config.AccessoryColor ~= nil then accessorySettings.Color = tableToColor(config.AccessoryColor) end
    if config.AccessoryScale ~= nil then accessorySettings.Scale = config.AccessoryScale end
    if accessorySettings.Type == "Wings" then accessorySettings.Slot = "Back" end
    if accessorySettings.Enabled then
        pcall(applyAccessory)
    else
        removeAccessory()
    end

    if config.ThirdPerson ~= nil then
        pcall(function()
            if UI_ELEMENTS.ThirdPerson then UI_ELEMENTS.ThirdPerson:Set(config.ThirdPerson) end
        end)
    end
    if config.ThirdPersonMaxDistance ~= nil or config.ThirdPersonDistance ~= nil then
        local dist = config.ThirdPersonMaxDistance or config.ThirdPersonDistance
        playerSettings.MaxZoomDistance = dist
        if playerSettings.ThirdPerson then
            updateThirdPersonCamera()
        end
    end
    if config.ThirdPersonCustomZoom ~= nil then
        playerSettings.CustomZoom = config.ThirdPersonCustomZoom
    end

    if config.SilentAim ~= nil then pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.SilentAim:Set(config.SilentAim) end) end
    if config.TargetESP ~= nil then
        SETTINGS.TargetESP_Enabled = config.TargetESP
        pcall(function() if UI_ELEMENTS.TargetESP then UI_ELEMENTS.TargetESP:Set(config.TargetESP) end end)
    end
    if config.TargetESP_Chams ~= nil then SETTINGS.TargetESP_Chams = config.TargetESP_Chams end
    if config.TargetESP_Tracers ~= nil then SETTINGS.TargetESP_Tracers = config.TargetESP_Tracers end
    if config.HalloweenShaders ~= nil then SETTINGS.HalloweenShaders = config.HalloweenShaders end
    if config.HalloweenLeaves ~= nil then SETTINGS.HalloweenLeaves = config.HalloweenLeaves end
    if config.HalloweenTrees ~= nil then SETTINGS.HalloweenTrees = config.HalloweenTrees end
    if config.HalloweenPumpkins ~= nil then SETTINGS.HalloweenPumpkins = config.HalloweenPumpkins end
    if config.HalloweenGroundPumpkins ~= nil then SETTINGS.HalloweenGroundPumpkins = config.HalloweenGroundPumpkins end
    if config.HalloweenMoon ~= nil then SETTINGS.HalloweenMoon = config.HalloweenMoon end
    if config.HalloweenMode ~= nil then
        SETTINGS.HalloweenMode = config.HalloweenMode
        pcall(function() if UI_ELEMENTS.HalloweenMode then UI_ELEMENTS.HalloweenMode:Set(config.HalloweenMode) end end)
        if HalloweenEngine then HalloweenEngine.toggle(config.HalloweenMode) end
    end
    if config.NoClip ~= nil then pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.NoClip:Set(config.NoClip) end) end
    if config.Freeze ~= nil then pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.Freeze:Set(config.Freeze) end) end
    if config.NightMode ~= nil then pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.NightMode:Set(config.NightMode) end) end
    if config.StretchRes ~= nil then pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.StretchRes:Set(config.StretchRes) end) end
    if config.GrabDistanceLimit ~= nil then
        SETTINGS.TargetLimit = config.GrabDistanceLimit
        ForceAdjust(config.GrabDistanceLimit)
        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.GrabDistanceLimit:Set(config.GrabDistanceLimit) end)
    end
    if config.LoopKill ~= nil then pcall(function() if UI_ELEMENTS.ZenithLoopKill then UI_ELEMENTS.ZenithLoopKill:Set(config.LoopKill) end end) end
    if config.RagdollKick ~= nil then pcall(function() if UI_ELEMENTS.ZenithRagdollKick then UI_ELEMENTS.ZenithRagdollKick:Set(config.RagdollKick) end end) end
    if config.AirJump ~= nil then pcall(function() if UI_ELEMENTS.AirJump then UI_ELEMENTS.AirJump:Set(config.AirJump) end end) end
    if config.Speed ~= nil then pcall(function() if UI_ELEMENTS.Speed then UI_ELEMENTS.Speed:Set(config.Speed) end end) end
    if config.EnableWeather ~= nil then
        weatherRunning = config.EnableWeather
        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.EnableWeather:Set(config.EnableWeather) end)
    end
    if config.EffectMode ~= nil then
        weatherMode = config.EffectMode
        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.EffectMode:SetValue(config.EffectMode) end)
    end
    if config.CometColor ~= nil then
        cometColor = tableToColor(config.CometColor)
        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.CometColor:SetValue(cometColor) end)
    end
    if config.SmokeColor ~= nil then
        smokeColor = tableToColor(config.SmokeColor)
        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.SmokeColor:SetValue(smokeColor) end)
    end
    if config.LightningColor ~= nil then
        lightningColor = tableToColor(config.LightningColor)
        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.LightningColor:SetValue(lightningColor) end)
    end
    if config.CometsPerSecond ~= nil then
        cometsPerSecond = config.CometsPerSecond
        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.CometsPerSecond:Set(config.CometsPerSecond) end)
    end
    if config.LightningsPerSecond ~= nil then
        lightningsPerSecond = config.LightningsPerSecond
        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.LightningsPerSecond:Set(config.LightningsPerSecond) end)
    end

    if config.CustomMainBg ~= nil then
        customThemeColors.MainBackground = tableToColor(config.CustomMainBg)
        customThemeColors.DarkerBackground = customThemeColors.MainBackground:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.35)
        customThemeColors.ActiveTab = customThemeColors.MainBackground:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15)
    end
    if config.CustomInputBg ~= nil then
        customThemeColors.InputBackground = tableToColor(config.CustomInputBg)
        customThemeColors.DropdownHolder = customThemeColors.InputBackground:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.25)
        customThemeColors.SliderRail = customThemeColors.InputBackground:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.15)
    end
    if config.CustomText ~= nil then customThemeColors.Text = tableToColor(config.CustomText) end
    if config.CustomSubText ~= nil then customThemeColors.SubText = tableToColor(config.CustomSubText) end
    if config.CustomBorder ~= nil then
        customThemeColors.ElementBorder = tableToColor(config.CustomBorder)
        customThemeColors.InElementBorder = customThemeColors.ElementBorder
        customThemeColors.TitleBarLine = customThemeColors.ElementBorder
    end

    if config.UI_ThemeMode ~= nil then
        currentThemeMode = config.UI_ThemeMode
        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.ThemeMode:SetValue(config.UI_ThemeMode) end)
    end
    if config.UI_AccentColor ~= nil then
        currentAccent = tableToColor(config.UI_AccentColor)
        pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.AccentColor:SetValue(currentAccent) end)
    end

    updateAllGuiElements()
end

-- ====================== СОЗДАНИЕ ЭЛЕМЕНТОВ КОНФИГА ======================
do
TABS.Config:MakeSection({ Name = "Save & Load Config" })

local ConfigNameValue = "config1"
TABS.Config:MakeTextbox({
    Name = "New Config Name",
    Default = "config1",
    TextDisappear = false,
    Callback = function(v) ConfigNameValue = v end
})

local SelectedConfig = ""
local initialList = {}

local hasFileSystem = (writefile and readfile and isfile)
if hasFileSystem then
    pcall(function()
        if isfile("Cardinal_ConfigList.json") then
            initialList = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile("Cardinal_ConfigList.json"))
        end
    end)
end

if #initialList == 0 then initialList = {"config1"} end
SelectedConfig = initialList[1] or "config1"

UI_ELEMENTS.ConfigDropdown = TABS.Config:MakeDropdown({
    Name = "Select Saved Config",
    Icon = "folder",
    Options = initialList,
    Default = SelectedConfig,
    Callback = function(v) SelectedConfig = v end
})

TABS.Config:MakeButton({
    Name = "Save Config",
    Icon = "save",
    Callback = function()
        if not hasFileSystem then
            Window:Notify({ Title = "Error", Content = "Your exploit does not support File System!", Duration = 3 })
            return
        end
        if ConfigNameValue == "" then
            Window:Notify({ Title = "Config", Content = "Please enter a config name!", Duration = 3 })
            return
        end
        
        local data = getCurrentConfig()
        local success, encoded = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, data)
        if success then
            local filename = "Cardinal_Config_" .. ConfigNameValue .. ".json"
            pcall(writefile, filename, encoded)
            
            local list = {}
            pcall(function()
                if isfile("Cardinal_ConfigList.json") then
                    list = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile("Cardinal_ConfigList.json"))
                end
            end)
            
            if not table.find(list, ConfigNameValue) then
                table.insert(list, ConfigNameValue)
                pcall(writefile, "Cardinal_ConfigList.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(list))
            end
            
            pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.ConfigDropdown:Refresh(list, true) end)
            Window:Notify({ Title = "Saved", Content = "Saved config: " .. ConfigNameValue, Duration = 3 })
        else
            Window:Notify({ Title = "Error", Content = "Failed to encode config!", Duration = 3 })
        end
    end
})

TABS.Config:MakeButton({
    Name = "Load Selected Config",
    Icon = "download",
    Callback = function()
        if not hasFileSystem then
            Window:Notify({ Title = "Error", Content = "Your exploit does not support File System!", Duration = 3 })
            return
        end
        if SelectedConfig == "" then
            Window:Notify({ Title = "Config", Content = "Please select a config!", Duration = 3 })
            return
        end
        
        local filename = "Cardinal_Config_" .. SelectedConfig .. ".json"
        if isfile(filename) then
            local success, content = pcall(readfile, filename)
            if success and content then
                local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(HttpService:JSONDecode(content))
                if decodeSuccess and data then
                    applyConfig(data)
                    Window:Notify({ Title = "Loaded", Content = "Loaded config: " .. SelectedConfig, Duration = 3 })
                else
                    Window:Notify({ Title = "Error", Content = "Failed to parse config file!", Duration = 3 })
                end
            else
                Window:Notify({ Title = "Error", Content = "Failed to read config file!", Duration = 3 })
            end
        else
            Window:Notify({ Title = "Error", Content = "Config file does not exist!", Duration = 3 })
        end
    end
})

TABS.Config:MakeButton({
    Name = "Delete Selected Config",
    Icon = "trash",
    Callback = function()
        if not hasFileSystem then return end
        if SelectedConfig == "" then
            Window:Notify({ Title = "Config", Content = "Please select a config to delete!", Duration = 3 })
            return
        end
        
        local filename = "Cardinal_Config_" .. SelectedConfig .. ".json"
        if isfile(filename) then
            pcall(delfile or function() end, filename)
            
            local list = {}
            pcall(function()
                if isfile("Cardinal_ConfigList.json") then
                    list = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile("Cardinal_ConfigList.json"))
                end
            end)
            
            local idx = table.find(list, SelectedConfig)
            if idx then
                table.remove(list, idx)
                pcall(writefile, "Cardinal_ConfigList.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(list))
            end
            
            if #list == 0 then list = {"config1"} end
            pcall(function() UI_ELEMENTS.ConfigDropdown:Refresh(list, true) end)
            SelectedConfig = list[1] or "config1"
            Window:Notify({ Title = "Deleted", Content = "Deleted config successfully!", Duration = 3 })
        end
    end
})
end

-- ====================== [ NEW DROPDOWN CLICKGUI (XENON MINECRAFT STYLE) ] ======================
local function initClickGui()
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")

    -- 1. Fullscreen BlurEffect (с плавным твином)
    local clickGuiBlur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("XenonClickGuiBlur")
    if not clickGuiBlur then
        clickGuiBlur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
        clickGuiBlur.Name = "XenonClickGuiBlur"
        clickGuiBlur.Size = 0
        clickGuiBlur.Enabled = false
        pcall(function() clickGuiBlur.Parent = Lighting end)
    end

    -- 2. Sound Effects System (Uses global playUiSound with custom & built-in fallback)

    -- 3. ScreenGui
    local clickScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    clickScreenGui.Name = "XenonClickGui_Screen"
    clickScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    clickScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 999
    clickScreenGui.Enabled = false

    safeParentGui(clickScreenGui)

    -- Главный контейнер
    local mainContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
    mainContainer.Name = "MainContainer"
    mainContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    mainContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    mainContainer.Parent = clickScreenGui

    -- [ UNLOCK & SHOW MOUSE CURSOR WHEN GUI IS VISIBLE ]
    local modalCursorFix = Instance.new("TextButton")
    modalCursorFix.Name = "XenonModalCursorUnlock"
    modalCursorFix.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    modalCursorFix.Text = ""
    modalCursorFix.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    modalCursorFix.Modal = true
    modalCursorFix.Parent = mainContainer

    -- ==================== [ TOP BAR / HUD ИЗ MINECRAFT CLIENT XENON ] ====================

    -- 1. Top Left Watermark Pills (ОТДЕЛЬНЫЙ GUI, ВСЕГДА НА ЭКРАНЕ, ПЕРЕТАСКИВАЕМЫЙ, УВЕЛИЧЕННЫЙ)
    local hudScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    hudScreenGui.Name = "XenonWatermarkHUD_Screen"
    hudScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    hudScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 99999
    hudScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

    safeParentGui(hudScreenGui)

    -- 2. Загрузка логотипа Xenon для нижнего правого водяного знака
    local bottomLogoAsset = nil
    pcall(function()
        if writefile and (getcustomasset or getsynasset) then
            local getAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
            local fileName = "xenon_logo_bottom.png"
            if not isfile or not isfile(fileName) then
                local b64 = ""
                local raw = nil
                pcall(function()
                    if crypt and crypt.base64decode then raw = crypt.base64decode(b64)
                    elseif crypt and crypt.base64 and crypt.base64.decode then raw = crypt.base64.decode(b64)
                    elseif base64_decode then raw = base64_decode(b64) end
                end)
                if not raw then
                    local b64chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
                    local chars = {}
                    for idx = 1, #b64chars do chars[b64chars:sub(idx, idx)] = idx - 1 end
                    chars["="] = 0
                    local out = {}
                    local buf, bits = 0, 0
                    for idx = 1, #b64 do
                        local c = b64:sub(idx, idx)
                        local v = chars[c]
                        if v then
                            buf = buf * 64 + v
                            bits = bits + 6
                            if bits >= 8 then
                                bits = bits - 8
                                table.insert(out, string.char(math.floor(buf / (2^bits)) % 256))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    raw = table.concat(out)
                end
                if raw and #raw > 0 then
                    writefile(fileName, raw)
                end
            end
            bottomLogoAsset = getAsset(fileName)
        end
    end)

    -- 3. Нижний правый водяной знак (Xenon Project Widget с логотипом, неон-свечением и живым статусом)
    local brCard = Instance.new("Frame")
    brCard.Name = "BottomLeftWatermark"
    brCard.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
    brCard.Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 1, -20)
    brCard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 235, 0, 52)
    brCard.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 17, 24)
    brCard.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
    brCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
    brCard.Active = true
    brCard.Parent = hudScreenGui

    local brCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    brCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
    brCorner.Parent = brCard

    local brStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    brStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 160, 255)
    brStroke.Transparency = 0.76
    brStroke.Thickness = 1.15
    brStroke.Parent = brCard

    local brGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    brGrad.Rotation = 25
    brGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(120, 150, 255))
    })
    brGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, 0.05),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, 0.35)
    })
    brGrad.Parent = brCard

    -- Hover эффект для карточки
    brCard.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(brStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Transparency = 0.38
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(brCard, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
        }):Play()
    end)
    brCard.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(brStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Transparency = 0.76
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(brCard, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
        }):Play()
    end)

    -- Перетаскивание карточки водяного знака мышкой (ЛКМ)
    local isBrDragging = false
    local brDragStart, brFrameStart

    brCard.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            isBrDragging = true
            brDragStart = input.Position
            brFrameStart = brCard.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    isBrDragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if isBrDragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local delta = input.Position - brDragStart
            brCard.Position = UDim2.new(
                brFrameStart.X.Scale,
                brFrameStart.X.Offset + delta.X,
                brFrameStart.Y.Scale,
                brFrameStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    -- Контейнер логотипа (слева)
    local brLogoBox = Instance.new("Frame")
    brLogoBox.Name = "LogoBox"
    brLogoBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38)
    brLogoBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -19)
    brLogoBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    brLogoBox.Parent = brCard

    -- Мягкое неоновое свечение позади логотипа
    local brAuraGlow = Instance.new("Frame")
    brAuraGlow.Name = "AuraGlow"
    brAuraGlow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    brAuraGlow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 34)
    brAuraGlow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    brAuraGlow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 210, 255)
    brAuraGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.72
    brAuraGlow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    brAuraGlow.Parent = brLogoBox
    Instance.new("UICorner", brAuraGlow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local brAuraGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    brAuraGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 235, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, Color3.fromRGB(130, 80, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 255))
    })
    brAuraGrad.Parent = brAuraGlow

    -- Плавная анимация пульсации ауры
    local brAuraTween = TweenService:Create(brAuraGlow, TweenInfo.new(1.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), {
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.88,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38)
    })
    brAuraTween:Play()

    -- Изображение логотипа
    local brLogoImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    brLogoImg.Name = "LogoImage"
    brLogoImg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    brLogoImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    brLogoImg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    brLogoImg.ZIndex = 2
    if bottomLogoAsset then
        brLogoImg.Image = bottomLogoAsset
    end
    brLogoImg.Parent = brLogoBox

    -- Текстовый контейнер (справа от логотипа)
    local brInfo = Instance.new("Frame")
    brInfo.Name = "Info"
    brInfo.Size = UDim2.new(1, -54, 1, 0)
    brInfo.Position = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 0)
    brInfo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    brInfo.Parent = brCard

    -- Верхняя строка: "Xenon Project" + неон-бейдж "PRIVATE"
    local brTopRow = Instance.new("Frame")
    brTopRow.Name = "TopRow"
    brTopRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    brTopRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 7)
    brTopRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    brTopRow.Parent = brInfo

    local brTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    brTitle.Name = "Title"
    brTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    brTitle.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    brTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    brTitle.Text = "Xenon Project"
    brTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255)
    brTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    brTitle.TextSize = 13
    brTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    brTitle.Parent = brTopRow

    local brBadge = Instance.new("Frame")
    brBadge.Name = "Badge"
    brBadge.Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 16)
    brBadge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 96, 0.5, -8)
    brBadge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255)
    brBadge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
    brBadge.BorderSizePixel = 0
    brBadge.Parent = brTopRow

    local brBadgeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    brBadgeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    brBadgeCorner.Parent = brBadge

    local brBadgeStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    brBadgeStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
    brBadgeStroke.Transparency = 0.55
    brBadgeStroke.Thickness = 1
    brBadgeStroke.Parent = brBadge

    local brBadgeText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    brBadgeText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    brBadgeText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    brBadgeText.Text = "PRIVATE"
    brBadgeText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255)
    brBadgeText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    brBadgeText.TextSize = 9
    brBadgeText.Parent = brBadge

    -- Нижняя строка: зеленый статус-индикатор + живые показатели
    local brBottomRow = Instance.new("Frame")
    brBottomRow.Name = "BottomRow"
    brBottomRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
    brBottomRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 28)
    brBottomRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    local function getServerPing()
        local sp = 0
        pcall(function()
            if StatsService.Network and StatsService.Network:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem") then
                local sLag = StatsService.Network.ServerStatsItem:FindFirstChild("Server Lag")
                if sLag then
                    local v = sLag:GetValue()
                    if v > 0 then sp = math.floor(v < 10 and (v * 1000) or v) end
                end
            end
        end)
        if sp <= 0 then
            pcall(function()
                local sItem = StatsService.Network and StatsService.Network:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem")
                local hb = sItem and (sItem:FindFirstChild("Heartbeat Time PB") or sItem:FindFirstChild("Server Frame Time"))
                if hb then sp = math.floor(hb:GetValue()) end
            end)
        end
        if sp <= 0 then
            pcall(function()
                local sItem = StatsService.Network and StatsService.Network:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem")
                local tr = sItem and sItem:FindFirstChild("Server Tick Rate")
                if tr then
                    local r = tr:GetValue()
                    if r > 0 then sp = math.floor(1000 / r) end
                end
            end)
        end
        if sp <= 0 then
            local p = 0
            pcall(function()
                local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
                if lp and lp.GetNetworkPing then p = math.floor(lp:GetNetworkPing() * 1000) end
            end)
            sp = math.max(16, math.floor(p * 0.95 + 16))
        end
        return math.max(sp, 1)
    end

        wmFpsCount = wmFpsCount + 1
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - wmLastTime >= 0.35 then
            wmCurrentFps = math.floor(wmFpsCount / (now - wmLastTime) + 0.5)
            wmFpsCount = 0
            wmLastTime = now

            local sPing = getServerPing()
            p1Label.Text = string.format("Xenon • FTAP • %d FPS • %dms", wmCurrentFps, sPing)
            if brLiveStatus and brLiveStatus.Parent then
                local userStr = (LocalPlayer and (LocalPlayer.DisplayName or LocalPlayer.Name)) or "Client"
                brLiveStatus.Text = "Client Active • " .. userStr
            end
        end
    end)

    local function fetchHttp(endpoint)
        local url = "http://127.0.0.1:28888/" .. endpoint
        local ok, body = pcall(function()
            return game:HttpGet(url)
        end)
        if ok and body and body ~= "" then return body end

        local req = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
        if req then
            local ok2, res = pcall(function()
                return req({ Url = url, Method = "GET" })
            end)
            if ok2 and res and (res.StatusCode == 200 or res.Status == 200) and res.Body then
                return res.Body
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- ДВОЙНОЙ КАНАЛ СВЯЗИ (ЧЕРЕЗ РАБОЧУЮ ПАПКУ И ЧЕРЕЗ СЕТЬ)
    local function getMediaData()
        if isfile and isfile("media.json") then
            local ok, raw = pcall(function() return readfile("media.json") end)
            if ok and raw and raw ~= "" then
                local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
                if ok2 and data and type(data) == "table" then
                    return data
                end
            end
        end

        local raw = fetchHttp("media")
        if raw and raw ~= "" then
            local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
            if ok and data and type(data) == "table" then
                return data
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function sendMediaAction(action)
        if writefile then
            pcall(function() writefile("media_action.txt", action) end)
        end
        task.spawn(function()

        end)
    end

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not hudScreenGui or not hudScreenGui.Parent or not mediaCard.Visible then return end

        pulseClock = pulseClock + dt

        for i, bar in ipairs(pulseBars) do
            local targetH = 3
            if livePlaying then
                local w1 = math.sin(pulseClock * 7 + i * 0.45)
                local w2 = math.cos(pulseClock * 11 + i * 0.75)
                local w3 = math.sin(pulseClock * 4 + i * 0.2)
                local wave = (w1 * 0.4 + w2 * 0.35 + w3 * 0.25 + 1) * 0.5
                targetH = math.clamp(math.floor(wave * 16 + 3), 3, 18)
                bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165 + math.floor(w1 * 30), 85 + math.floor(w2 * 20), 255)
            else
                local calm = (math.sin(pulseClock * 2 + i * 0.15) + 1) * 0.5
                targetH = math.clamp(math.floor(calm * 4 + 3), 3, 7)
                bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 115, 135)
            end
            bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, targetH)
        end
    end)

    ncMessage.Parent = notifyCapsule

    local notifyTweenToken = 0
    notifyCapsule.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -75)
    notifyCapsule.Visible = false

    local function showTopNotification(text, isPositive)
        notifyTweenToken = notifyTweenToken + 1
        local currentToken = notifyTweenToken

        ncMessage.Text = text
        if isPositive then
            ncIconCircle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
            ncIconText.Text = "✓"
        else
            ncIconCircle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(231, 76, 60)
            ncIconText.Text = "✕"
        end

        notifyCapsule.Visible = true
        local slideDown = TweenService:Create(notifyCapsule, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
        })
        slideDown:Play()

        -- Ровно через 2 секунды уведомление уходит вверх и полностью скрывается
        task.delay(2.0, function()
            if notifyTweenToken == currentToken and notifyCapsule and notifyCapsule.Parent then
                local slideUp = TweenService:Create(notifyCapsule, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -75)
                })
                slideUp:Play()
                slideUp.Completed:Connect(function()
                    if notifyTweenToken == currentToken then
                        notifyCapsule.Visible = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    local hoverToken = 0
    local function setHoverDescription(desc)
        hoverToken = hoverToken + 1
        local token = hoverToken
        if desc and desc ~= "" then
            hoverDescLabel.Text = desc
            TweenService:Create(hoverDescLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                TextTransparency = 0
            }):Play()
        else
            task.delay(0.1, function()
                if hoverToken == token and hoverDescLabel and hoverDescLabel.Parent then
                    TweenService:Create(hoverDescLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                        TextTransparency = 1
                    }):Play()
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    -- Функция перетаскивания с эффектом размыливания мыльного стекла при движении
        -- Функция перетаскивания (Drag)
    local function makeDraggable(dragHandle, targetFrame)
        local dragging = false
        local dragInput, dragStart, startPos
        dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = targetFrame.Position
                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
                end)
            end
        end)
        dragHandle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then dragInput = input end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input == dragInput and dragging then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                targetFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale,
                    startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale,
                    startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end)
    end

            dropdownList.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            dropdownList.BackgroundTransparency = 1

            dlLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
            dlLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)

            local dlPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")

            dlPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
            dlPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
            dlPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)

            local function updateTargetLabel()
                local selectedList = {}
                if SETTINGS.SelectedTargets then
                    for pName, isSel in pairs(SETTINGS.SelectedTargets) do
                        if isSel and pName ~= "All Players" and pName ~= "" and pName ~= "[Авто]" and pName ~= "[Авто/Курсор]" then
                            table.insert(selectedList, pName)
                        end
                    end
                end

                if #selectedList == 0 then
                    SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = ""
                    tcLabel.Text = "Target: [Авто]"
                    tcLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(195, 150, 255)
                elseif #selectedList == 1 then
                    SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = selectedList[1]
                    tcLabel.Text = "Target: " .. selectedList[1]
                    tcLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
                elseif #selectedList == 2 then
                    SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = selectedList[1] .. ", " .. selectedList[2]
                    tcLabel.Text = "Target: " .. selectedList[1] .. ", " .. selectedList[2]
                    tcLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
                else
                    SETTINGS.TargetPlayer = table.concat(selectedList, ", ")
                    tcLabel.Text = "Target: [" .. tostring(#selectedList) .. " цели]"
                    tcLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
                end
            end
            updateTargetLabel()

            local function refreshPlayerList()
                -- Очищаем старые элементы списка
                for _, child in ipairs(dropdownList:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("Frame") then
                        child:Destroy()
                    end
                end

                -- Опция 1: [ Авто / Все игроки ]
                local autoRow = Instance.new("TextButton")
                autoRow.Name = "Row_Auto"
                autoRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
                autoRow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                autoRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
                autoRow.Text = ""
                autoRow.AutoButtonColor = false
                autoRow.Parent = dropdownList

                local autoCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                autoCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
                autoCorner.Parent = autoRow

                if SETTINGS.SelectedTargets then
                    for pName, isSel in pairs(SETTINGS.SelectedTargets) do
                        if isSel and pName ~= "All Players" and pName ~= "" and pName ~= "[Авто]" then

                    end
                end
                autoRow.BackgroundTransparency = isAutoActive and 0.82 or 0.96

                local autoLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                autoLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0)

                autoLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                autoLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                autoLbl.TextSize = 10

                autoLbl.TextColor3 = isAutoActive and Color3.fromRGB(195, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 185)
                autoLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                autoLbl.Parent = autoRow

                local autoCheck = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                autoCheck.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, 0)
                autoCheck.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
                autoCheck.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                autoCheck.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                autoCheck.TextSize = 10
                autoCheck.Text = isAutoActive and "✓" or ""
                autoCheck.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(195, 150, 255)
                autoCheck.Parent = autoRow

                autoRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

                    SETTINGS.SelectedTargets = {}

                    updateTargetLabel()

                    showTopNotification("Авто-выбор цели", true)

                -- Список игроков на сервере
                local serverPlrs = {}

                    emptyLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1

                    emptyLbl.TextSize = 10
                    emptyLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 145, 165)
                    emptyLbl.Text = "Нет других игроков"

                end

                for _, p in ipairs(serverPlrs) do

                    pRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)

                    pRow.BackgroundTransparency = isSelected and 0.75 or 0.96
                    pRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    pRow.Text = ""
                    pRow.AutoButtonColor = false
                    pRow.Parent = dropdownList

                    local pCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
                    pCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
                    pCorner.Parent = pRow

                    pLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0)
                    pLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)

                    pLbl.TextColor3 = isSelected and Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(175, 180, 200)
                    pLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    pLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                    pLbl.Parent = pRow

                    local pCheck = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    pCheck.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, 0)
                    pCheck.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
                    pCheck.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    pCheck.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    pCheck.TextSize = 10
                    pCheck.Text = isSelected and "✓" or ""
                    pCheck.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
                    pCheck.Parent = pRow

                    pRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        playUiSound("Click")
                        if not SETTINGS.SelectedTargets then SETTINGS.SelectedTargets = {} end
                        if SETTINGS.SelectedTargets[pName] then
                            SETTINGS.SelectedTargets[pName] = nil
                        else
                            SETTINGS.SelectedTargets[pName] = true
                        end
                        updateTargetLabel()
                        refreshPlayerList()
                        showTopNotification(SETTINGS.TargetPlayer ~= "" and ("Цель: " .. SETTINGS.TargetPlayer) or "Авто-выбор цели", true)
                    end)
                end
            end

            -- Клик по заголовку для открытия / закрытия списка
            tcBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playUiSound("Click")
                isOpen = not isOpen

                if isOpen then
                    refreshPlayerList()
                    dropdownList.Visible = true
                    TweenService:Create(tcStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                        Transparency = 0.50
                    }):Play()
                else
                    dropdownList.Visible = false
                    TweenService:Create(tcStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                        Transparency = 0.82
                    }):Play()
                end
            end)

            tcBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                setHoverDescription("Выбор цели для Сайлент Аима (клик для открытия списка)")
            end)
            tcBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                setHoverDescription(nil)
            end)
        end

        -- Генерация элементов (функций) внутри колонки
        for itemIdx, itemData in ipairs(colData.Items) do
            local rowBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            rowBtn.Name = "Row_" .. itemData.Name
            rowBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
            rowBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            rowBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            rowBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            rowBtn.Text = ""
            rowBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
            rowBtn.LayoutOrder = itemIdx
            rowBtn.Parent = itemsList

            local rowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            rowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
            rowCorner.Parent = rowBtn

            -- Название функции слева
            local titleLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            titleLbl.Name = "Title"
            titleLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0)
            titleLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
            titleLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            titleLbl.Text = itemData.GetText and itemData.GetText() or itemData.Name
            titleLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 195)
            titleLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            titleLbl.TextSize = 12
            titleLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            titleLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            titleLbl.Parent = rowBtn

            -- Иконка галочки справа (✓) точь-в-точь как в Minecraft клиенте!
            local checkmarkLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            checkmarkLbl.Name = "Checkmark"
            checkmarkLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, 0)
            checkmarkLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
            checkmarkLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            checkmarkLbl.Text = "✓"
            checkmarkLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            checkmarkLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            checkmarkLbl.TextSize = 12
            checkmarkLbl.Visible = false
            checkmarkLbl.Parent = rowBtn

            -- Надежное получение и установка состояния модуля
            local function getFeatureState(elemKey)
                if not elemKey then return false end
                local ui = UI_ELEMENTS[elemKey]
                if ui and type(ui) == "table" then
                    if ui.Get then return ui:Get() == true end
                    if ui.GetValue then return ui:GetValue() == true end
                end
                if SETTINGS[elemKey] ~= nil then
                    return SETTINGS[elemKey] == true
                end
                return false
            end

            local function setFeatureState(elemKey, newState)
                if not elemKey then return end
                SETTINGS[elemKey] = newState
                local ui = UI_ELEMENTS[elemKey]
                if ui and type(ui) == "table" then
                    if ui.Set then
                        pcall(function() ui:Set(newState) end)
                    elseif ui.SetValue then
                        pcall(function() ui:SetValue(newState) end)
                    end
                end
            end

            -- Кнопка шестеренки прямо на строке для открытия настроек функции
            if itemData.HasSettings and itemData.OpenSettings then
                local gearBtnRow = Instance.new("TextButton")
                gearBtnRow.Name = "GearSettingsBtn"
                gearBtnRow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0)
                gearBtnRow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0)
                gearBtnRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                gearBtnRow.Text = "⚙"
                gearBtnRow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(145, 150, 170)
                gearBtnRow.TextSize = 11
                gearBtnRow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                gearBtnRow.ZIndex = rowBtn.ZIndex + 1
                gearBtnRow.Parent = rowBtn

                gearBtnRow.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    gearBtnRow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(195, 150, 255)
                end)
                gearBtnRow.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    gearBtnRow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(145, 150, 170)
                end)
                gearBtnRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    playUiSound("Click")
                    pcall(itemData.OpenSettings)
                end)
            end

            -- Функция синхронизации визуального состояния
            local function syncItemState()
                if itemData.GetText then
                    titleLbl.Text = itemData.GetText()
                end

                if itemData.Type == "Toggle" then
                    local isActive = getFeatureState(itemData.ElementKey)
                    if isActive then
                        titleLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        titleLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                        checkmarkLbl.Visible = true
                    else
                        titleLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 195)
                        titleLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                        checkmarkLbl.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    titleLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(195, 200, 215)
                    checkmarkLbl.Visible = false
                end
            end

            table.insert(syncCallbacks, syncItemState)
            syncItemState()

            -- Эффект при наведении (Hover)
            rowBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                playUiSound("Hover")
                local desc = itemData.Desc or itemData.Name
                if itemData.HasSettings then
                    desc = desc .. " [ПКМ или ⚙: Настройки]"
                end
                setHoverDescription(desc)
                TweenService:Create(rowBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.93
                }):Play()
            end)

            rowBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                setHoverDescription(nil)
                TweenService:Create(rowBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1
                }):Play()
            end)

            -- Клик ЛКМ (Toggle / Action)
            rowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if itemData.Type == "Toggle" then
                    local curState = getFeatureState(itemData.ElementKey)
                    local newState = not curState
                    playUiSound(newState and "ToggleOn" or "ToggleOff")
                    setFeatureState(itemData.ElementKey, newState)
                    showTopNotification(itemData.Name .. (newState and " включен" or " выключен"), newState)
                    syncItemState()
                    if SETTINGS.SyncClickGui then pcall(SETTINGS.SyncClickGui) end
                else
                    playUiSound("Click")
                    if itemData.Callback then
                        pcall(itemData.Callback)
                    end
                    syncItemState()
                end
            end)

            -- Клик ПКМ (Открытие настроек функции)
            rowBtn.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function()
                if itemData.HasSettings and itemData.OpenSettings then
                    playUiSound("Click")
                    pcall(itemData.OpenSettings)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    -- ==================== [ ЛОГИКА ОТКРЫТИЯ / ЗАКРЫТИЯ CLICKGUI ] ====================
    local isAnimating = false

    local function showClickGui()
        if isAnimating then return end
        isAnimating = true
        SETTINGS.IsClickGuiOpen = true
        safeParentGui(clickScreenGui)
        clickScreenGui.Enabled = true
        mainContainer.Visible = true

        playUiSound("Open")

        for _, syncFn in ipairs(syncCallbacks) do
            pcall(syncFn)
        end

        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default

        -- Полноэкранный плавный блюр 3D мира при открытии меню
        -- [ БЛЮР МИРА ВЫКЛЮЧЕН: блюрит ТОЛЬКО сам GUI (эффект жидкого стекла), мир остаётся чётким ]
        clickGuiBlur.Enabled = false
        clickGuiBlur.Size = 0

        -- Плавное появление колонок с легким подъемом
        mainContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -18)
        local cTween = TweenService:Create(mainContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        })
        cTween:Play()

        showTopNotification("Menu включен", true)

        cTween.Completed:Connect(function()
            isAnimating = false
        end)
    end

    local function hideClickGui()
        if isAnimating then return end
        isAnimating = true
        SETTINGS.IsClickGuiOpen = false

        playUiSound("Close")
        showTopNotification("Menu выключен", false)

        -- Плавное закрытие блюра

        local cTween = TweenService:Create(mainContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -22)
        })
        cTween:Play()

        cTween.Completed:Connect(function()
            clickGuiBlur.Enabled = false
            mainContainer.Visible = false
            clickScreenGui.Enabled = false
            isAnimating = false
        end)
    end

    -- Синхронизация всех чекбоксов
    local function syncAllItems()
        for _, syncFn in ipairs(syncCallbacks) do
            pcall(syncFn)
        end
    end

    SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui = function()
        if SETTINGS.IsClickGuiOpen then
            hideClickGui()
        else
            showClickGui()
        end
    end

    SETTINGS.SyncClickGui = syncAllItems

    -- Клавиша открытия/закрытия меню управляется централизованно через toggleBothMenus()

    -- Первоначальная синхронизация
    task.delay(0.5, function()
        syncAllItems()
    end)
end
initClickGui()
