-- ====================== ОБНОВЛЕНИЯ (основной цикл) ======================
pcall(function() if Sense and Sense.Load then Sense.Load() end end)
local angle, counter, pulse = 0, 0, 0
local mainRenderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if SETTINGS.IsClickGuiOpen or (Window and Window.MainFrame and Window.MainFrame.Visible) then
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
    end
    if SETTINGS.NightMode then
        Lighting.ClockTime = 0
        Lighting.Brightness = 0
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.new(0,0,0)
    end
    if SETTINGS.StretchedRes then Camera.FieldOfView = 110 end
    if SETTINGS.Crosshair_Enabled then
        counter = (counter + dt * 0.5) % 1
        angle = angle + dt * SETTINGS.SPIN_SPEED
        pulse = pulse + dt * 5
        local pF = (math.sin(pulse) + 1) / 2
        local gap = SETTINGS.BASE_GAP
        local length = SETTINGS.BASE_LENGTH + (10 * pF)
        local centerPos = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
        local clr = Color3.fromHSV(counter, 1, 1)
        local rad = math.rad(angle)
        local cos, sin = math.cos(rad), math.sin(rad)
        
        local function updateLine(main, out, dx, dy)
            local rx, ry = (dx * cos) - (dy * sin), (dx * sin) + (dy * cos)
            local x1, y1 = rx * gap, ry * gap
            local x2, y2 = rx * (gap + length), ry * (gap + length)
            out.From, out.To = centerPos + Vector2.new(x1, y1), centerPos + Vector2.new(x2, y2)
            out.Visible, main.Visible = true, true
            main.From, main.To, main.Color = out.From, out.To, clr
        end
        updateLine(crosshairLines.R, crosshairOutlines.R, 1, 0)
        updateLine(crosshairLines.L, crosshairOutlines.L, -1, 0)
        updateLine(crosshairLines.T, crosshairOutlines.T, 0, -1)
        updateLine(crosshairLines.B, crosshairOutlines.B, 0, 1)
    else
        for _, l in pairs(crosshairLines) do l.Visible = false end
        for _, l in pairs(crosshairOutlines) do l.Visible = false end
    end
end)
table.insert(getgenv().XenonConnections, mainRenderConn)

local noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if SETTINGS.NoClip and LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, v in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanCollide = false end end
    end
    if SETTINGS.Freeze and LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            pcall(function() hrp:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer) end)
            local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("FreezeVelocity")
            if bv then bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero end
        end
    end
end)

local bindsConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.V then
        setFreeze(not SETTINGS.Freeze)
        if UI_ELEMENTS.Freeze then UI_ELEMENTS.Freeze:Set(SETTINGS.Freeze) end
    elseif i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then 
        performLegitStop()
    elseif i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then 
        spawnPallet() 
    elseif SETTINGS.ResetKey and SETTINGS.ResetKey ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and i.KeyCode == SETTINGS.ResetKey then
        resetCharacter()
    end
end)
table.insert(getgenv().XenonConnections, noclipConn)
table.insert(getgenv().XenonConnections, bindsConn)

ActivateRealDonatorLine()
-- [ ПОЛНАЯ ВЫГРУЗКА СКРИПТА (CLEANUP ALL RESOURCES) ] --
local function CleanupXenonFull()
    pcall(function()
        -- Полная остановка и выгрузка звуковых движков (Трактор, Сани, Блуб, Стул)
        pcall(function()
            if getgenv()._XenonVehicleSeatedConn then
                getgenv()._XenonVehicleSeatedConn:Disconnect()
                getgenv()._XenonVehicleSeatedConn = nil
            end
            if getgenv()._XenonVehicleCharConn then
                getgenv()._XenonVehicleCharConn:Disconnect()
                getgenv()._XenonVehicleCharConn = nil
            end
            if getgenv()._XenonChairConn then
                getgenv()._XenonChairConn:Disconnect()
                getgenv()._XenonChairConn = nil
            end
            if getgenv()._XenonChairWSConn then
                getgenv()._XenonChairWSConn:Disconnect()
                getgenv()._XenonChairWSConn = nil
            end

            if VehicleMusicEngine then
                if VehicleMusicEngine.tractorSound then
                    pcall(function() VehicleMusicEngine.tractorSound:Stop(); VehicleMusicEngine.tractorSound:Destroy() end)
                    VehicleMusicEngine.tractorSound = nil
                end
                if VehicleMusicEngine.sledSound then
                    pcall(function() VehicleMusicEngine.sledSound:Stop(); VehicleMusicEngine.sledSound:Destroy() end)
                    VehicleMusicEngine.sledSound = nil
                end
                if VehicleMusicEngine.blobSound then
                    pcall(function() VehicleMusicEngine.blobSound:Stop(); VehicleMusicEngine.blobSound:Destroy() end)
                    VehicleMusicEngine.blobSound = nil
                end
            end

            if ChairSpawnAudioEngine then
                if ChairSpawnAudioEngine.soundInstance then
                    pcall(function() ChairSpawnAudioEngine.soundInstance:Stop(); ChairSpawnAudioEngine.soundInstance:Destroy() end)
                    ChairSpawnAudioEngine.soundInstance = nil
                end
            end

            for _, s in ipairs(SoundService:GetChildren()) do
                if s:IsA("Sound") and (s.Name:find("Xenon") or s.Name:find("Chushpany") or s.Name:find("Razjezd") or s.Name:find("Tractor") or s.Name:find("Sled") or s.Name:find("Blob")) then
                    pcall(function() s:Stop(); s:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end)

        if resetKeyConn then pcall(function() resetKeyConn:Disconnect() end); resetKeyConn = nil end
        if AntiLagEngine and AntiLagEngine.stop then pcall(AntiLagEngine.stop) end
        if SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEngine and SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEngine.stop then pcall(SETTINGS.AntiKickEspEngine.stop) end
        if SETTINGS.PcldEspEngine and SETTINGS.PcldEspEngine.stop then pcall(SETTINGS.PcldEspEngine.stop) end
        pcall(function()
            for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if d.Name == "XenonPcldTag" or d.Name == "XenonAntiKickBillboard" then d:Destroy() end
            end
        end)
        if RagdollKickEngine and RagdollKickEngine.stop then pcall(RagdollKickEngine.stop) end
        if LoopKillEngine and LoopKillEngine.stop then pcall(LoopKillEngine.stop) end
        if AntiKickEngine and AntiKickEngine.stop then pcall(AntiKickEngine.stop) end
        if AntiInputEngine and AntiInputEngine.stop then pcall(AntiInputEngine.stop) end
        if TeamProtectEngine and TeamProtectEngine.stop then pcall(TeamProtectEngine.stop) end
        if ANIM_SYSTEM and ANIM_SYSTEM.stop then pcall(ANIM_SYSTEM.stop) end
        if cleanupTrail then pcall(cleanupTrail) end
        if removeAccessory then pcall(removeAccessory) end
        if removeAura then pcall(removeAura) end
        if Sense and Sense.Unload then pcall(function() Sense.Unload() end) end

        if getgenv().XenonConnections then
            for _, conn in pairs(getgenv().XenonConnections) do
                pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
            end
            getgenv().XenonConnections = {}
        end

        if getgenv().XenonTasks then
            for _, t in pairs(getgenv().XenonTasks) do
                pcall(function() task.cancel(t) end)
            end
            getgenv().XenonTasks = {}
        end

        local holders = {}
        if gethui then pcall(function() table.insert(holders, gethui()) end) end
        pcall(function() table.insert(holders, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
        local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if lp and lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") then
            table.insert(holders, lp.PlayerGui)
        end

        local guiNames = {
            "XenonClickGui_Screen",
            "XenonModal_Screen",
            "XenonFriendNoticeGui",
            "XenonStatusHUDGui",
            "CardinalIslandGui",
            "XenonHUD",
            "XenonCornerSpamGui",
        }
        for _, h in ipairs(holders) do
            for _, name in ipairs(guiNames) do
                local g = h:FindFirstChild(name)
                if g then pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end
            end
            for _, g in ipairs(h:GetChildren()) do
                if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and (g.Name:find("Xenon") or g.Name:find("Cardinal") or g.Name:find("Zenith")) then
                    pcall(function() g:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end
        if Window and Window.ScreenGui then
            pcall(function() Window.ScreenGui:Destroy() end)
        end

        if TargetVisualsEngine then
            pcall(function()
                TargetVisualsEngine.clearHighlight()
                if TargetVisualsEngine.tracer then
                    pcall(function() TargetVisualsEngine.tracer:Destroy() end)
                    TargetVisualsEngine.tracer = nil
                end
            end)
        end
        if HalloweenEngine then
            pcall(function() HalloweenEngine.stop() end)
        end

        if crosshairLines then
            for _, l in pairs(crosshairLines) do pcall(function() l:Destroy() end) end
        end
        if crosshairOutlines then
            for _, l in pairs(crosshairOutlines) do pcall(function() l:Destroy() end) end
        end

        local blur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("XenonClickGuiBlur")
        if blur then pcall(function() blur:Destroy() end) end

        if lp then
            lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
            lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 0.5
            lp.CameraMode = defaultCameraMode or Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
        end

        if lp then
            pcall(function()
                local tf = workspace:FindFirstChild(lp.Name .. "SpawnedInToys")
                if tf then
                    for _, o in ipairs(tf:GetChildren()) do
                        if o.Name == "CreatureBlobman" then
                            pcall(function() game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MenuToys.DestroyToy:FireServer(o) end)
                            pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        getgenv().CleanupXenonFull = nil
    end)
end
getgenv().CleanupXenonFull = CleanupXenonFull

-- Автозапуск AntiLag и TargetVisuals при инициализации скрипта
if SETTINGS.AntiLag then
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.1)
        pcall(function() AntiLagEngine.start() end)
    end)
end
pcall(function() TargetVisualsEngine.init() end)

pcall(function() setupTabHoverAnimations() end)
pcall(function() updateAllGuiElements() end)
pcall(function() runStartupBorderGlow() end)

-- Инициализация активного стиля меню при запуске
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(0.2)
    if SETTINGS.ActiveMenuStyle == "Columns" then
        if Window and Window.Hide then pcall(function() Window:Hide() end)
        elseif Window and Window.MainFrame then Window.MainFrame.Visible = false end
        if SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui and not SETTINGS.IsClickGuiOpen then
            pcall(function() SETTINGS.ToggleClickGui() end)
        end
        if Window and Window.Notify then
            pcall(function()
                Window:Notify({ 
                    Title = "Xenon/Project Loaded", 
                    Content = "Columns ClickGUI (с блюром) готов! Скрыть/Открыть: RightShift", 
                    Duration = 5 
                })
            end)
        end
    else
        if Window and Window.Notify then
            pcall(function()
                Window:Notify({ 
                    Title = "Xenon/Project Loaded", 
                    Content = "Zenith Window готов! Скрыть/Открыть: RightShift", 
                    Duration = 5 
                })
            end)
        end
    end
end)
